before.en: Shah Abbas I moved the Safavid capital to Isfahan in 1597–1598 and reshaped the city through a new ceremonial square, connected bazaars and major buildings. Royal audience space, mosques and the entrance to the commercial district placed several institutions of government and urban life around one public setting. Court sponsorship also supported painting, manuscripts and decorative arts. The design made connections between commerce and royal authority visible, while the older city remained part of the larger urban system. Construction continued beyond Abbas’s reign, so the square’s surviving ensemble should be read as a developing project rather than a single finished moment.
before.zh: 阿拔斯一世于1597—1598年将萨法维都城迁至伊斯法罕，并通过新礼仪广场、相连的集市及大型建筑重塑城市。王室觐见空间、清真寺和商业区入口，把政府与城市生活的多种机构汇聚在同一公共环境中。宫廷也赞助绘画、手稿和装饰艺术。规划使商业与王权之间的联系可见，而旧城仍属于更大的城市体系。工程在阿拔斯统治结束后继续，因此现存广场建筑群应被视为逐步发展的项目，而非一个瞬间完成的整体。

after.en:

The design made connections between commerce and royal authority visible, while the older city remained part of the larger urban system. Construction continued beyond Abbas’s reign, so the square’s surviving ensemble should be read as a developing project rather than a single finished moment.

Luigi Pesce photographed the square in 1858 using a paper negative. The surviving salted-paper print sets the open space against arcades, entrances, a dome and minarets. Its much later date separates the Safavid building project from the nineteenth-century city that photography could record.

路易吉·佩谢于1858年以纸负片拍摄广场。存世盐纸照片将开放空间与连拱、入口、圆顶和宣礼塔并置。拍摄年代远晚于萨法维建设工程，因而呈现的是摄影所能记录的十九世纪城市。

before.en:
Greek works reached Arabic readers through several routes, often involving Syriac versions, revisions and the labor of more than one translator. Scholars selected, compared and adapted texts for new audiences. The resulting movement depended on patrons and scholarly communities whose religious affiliations and languages were varied, rather than a single homogeneous group preserving a fixed body of knowledge.

Attributions can be uncertain: a work credited to one translator may survive only in another person’s revision, or be known through a bibliographic notice after the text itself has been lost. Such distinctions matter for understanding intellectual change. This entry therefore describes a network of activity and avoids treating every translation as a product of one institution called the House of Wisdom. Translation made new arguments possible; it was not merely the physical transportation of books.
before.zh:
希腊著作通过多种途径到达阿拉伯语读者，常涉及叙利亚语版本、修订及不止一位译者的劳动。学者选择、比较和调整文本，以面对新读者。这一运动依赖宗教归属和语言各异的资助者与学术社群，而非一个同质群体保存固定知识。

译者归属有时不确定：署于一人名下的作品，可能只留下他人修订本，或原文已失、仅见书目记载。这些区别关系到如何理解思想变化。本条因此描述活动网络，不把每次翻译都归于一所名叫“智慧宫”的机构。翻译使新论证成为可能，不只是书籍的实物搬运。

一份1224年的迪奥斯科里德斯阿拉伯文插图手稿，为这条传播链提供后世实物见证。归于巴格达的场景中，人物在器皿架下制备蜂蜜药物。抄写、绘图与阅读使译介知识在初译之后长期被使用；此页并非原译者亲笔稿。

before.en:
A Marshallese navigation chart can look unlike a paper map. Curved sticks and shells bring relationships among swells and islands into a form that a learner can study. Navigators memorized such charts on land; the objects were not simply carried aboard as route maps.

The Library of Congress holds three examples made in Majuro during the 1920s. A mattang teaches wave–island relationships, while rebbelib and meddo charts show broader or more limited island groups. They should not be read as scale drawings or interchangeable keys to every Pacific navigation tradition.

This is living knowledge as well as museum history. Waan Aelõñ in Majel documents Marshallese teaching through canoe work and navigation, including Captain Joel Korent using charts with learners. The making date of an object is not the beginning or end of the knowledge it helps transmit.
before.zh:
马绍尔群岛的航海图，可能完全不像纸上的地图。弯曲枝条与贝壳，将涌浪和岛屿之间的关系变成可以学习的形式。航海者在陆上记忆这类图表，而不是简单地把它们带上船当作航线图。

美国国会图书馆保存三件1920年代在马朱罗制作的例子。mattang用于教学，呈现波浪与岛屿的关系；rebbelib和meddo则描绘较广或较小的岛群范围。它们不应被当作按比例绘制的图，也不能用来概括所有太平洋航海传统。

这既是馆藏历史，也是活态知识。Waan Aelõñ in Majel记录了通过独木舟制作与航海开展的马绍尔教学，其中包括船长Joel Korent用图表指导学员。文物的制作年代，并不代表它所传授知识的起点或终点。

before.en:
Jayavarman VII ruled in the Angkorian world and supported Mahayana Buddhist patronage. Sculptural programs associated with his reign placed Buddhist imagery within royal landscapes. Their interpretation requires attention to temples, patrons and changing religious purposes rather than assuming that every surviving face is a portrait of the king.

A fragmentary Buddha sheltered by a naga, discussed by the Metropolitan Museum, provides evidence for the patronage environment, not a complete biography. Angkor’s broader remains place that object within a landscape of capitals and monumental construction. Together they show how royal representation drew on religious forms and skilled production. The surviving image world makes certain aspects of authority visible while leaving much of the labor and negotiation sustaining the court less directly recorded.
before.zh:
阇耶跋摩七世统治于吴哥世界，并支持大乘佛教资助。与其在位阶段相关的造像体系，把佛教形象置于王室景观之中。解释时应注意寺院、施主及变化的宗教用途，不能假定每张存世面孔都是国王肖像。

大都会博物馆讨论的一件龙王护佛残像，提供资助环境的证据，而非完整传记。吴哥更广的遗存使这件器物进入都城与大型营建景观。两者共同显示，王权表象如何依靠宗教形式与专业生产。存世图像使权威的某些方面可见，支撑宫廷的许多劳动和协商却较少被直接记录。

after.en:
Jayavarman VII supported Mahayana Buddhism in the Angkorian world. Temples and sculptural programs placed Buddhist imagery within royal landscapes.

A sandstone Buddha fragment sheltered by seven naga heads (Met 36.96.5) dates to the late twelfth–early thirteenth century. The museum connects this fragment with the artistic environment of his Buddhist patronage at Angkor Thom. It represents the Buddha, not a portrait of the king.
after.zh:
阇耶跋摩七世在吴哥世界支持大乘佛教。寺院与造像体系将佛教形象置于王室景观之中。

一件七首那伽护佑的砂岩佛像残件（大都会36.96.5），年代为十二世纪晚期至十三世纪初。馆方将它与吴哥通城中这一国王资助佛教的艺术环境联系起来。造像表现的是佛陀，并非国王肖像。

before.en:
An Ainu robe in the Metropolitan Museum is made from elm fiber, with applied cloth and embroidery shaping its surface. The nineteenth-century garment brings work into view: obtaining bark, preparing thread, weaving, cutting and stitching. The museum describes women’s central roles in designing and making such robes. The object’s individual maker is unrecorded, but that absence need not make the labor invisible.

Clothing also belonged to a changing landscape. The Ainu Association describes the colonial administration established in Hokkaido in 1869 and the subsequent taking of Ainu land. The robe preserves material knowledge carried through those changes. Reading it beside Chiri Yukie’s later work with oral tradition connects different forms of cultural expression while keeping cloth, language and their makers’ histories distinct.
before.zh:
大都会艺术博物馆收藏的一件阿伊努长衣，以榆树纤维织成，再用贴布与刺绣组织表面纹样。这件十九世纪衣物让多道劳动进入视野：取得树皮、制线、织布、裁剪、缝制。馆方介绍女性在设计和制作此类衣物中的重要作用。具体制作者的姓名没有记录，劳动本身却仍能从材料和针脚中读出。

衣物也属于不断变化的社会环境。北海道阿伊努协会记述了1869年北海道殖民行政机构的设立，以及此后阿伊努土地被夺取的过程。长衣保存了穿越这些变化的材料知识。把它与知里幸惠后来整理口述传统的工作并读，可以联系不同的文化表达，同时保留织物、语言及其传承者各自的历史。

after.en:
An Ainu robe (Met 1999.247.1), shown here from the back, is made from elm fiber, with applied cloth and embroidery shaping its surface. The nineteenth-century garment brings work into view: obtaining bark, preparing thread, weaving, cutting and stitching. The museum describes women’s central roles in designing and making such robes. The individual maker’s name is unrecorded.

Clothing also belonged to a changing landscape. The Ainu Association describes the colonial administration established in Hokkaido in 1869 and the subsequent taking of Ainu land. The robe preserves material knowledge carried through those changes.

before.en:
Hunayn ibn Ishaq was a Christian scholar whose translation and medical work linked Greek, Syriac and Arabic learned traditions. His activity involved the comparison of texts and collaboration with pupils and associates, including his son Ishaq. A translation could be revised or transmitted through another language before reaching the version known to later readers.

The history therefore requires attention to particular works and uncertain attributions, rather than treating every later medical text as his direct product. His contribution sits within a larger network of patrons, physicians and readers. Linking this biography to the Abbasid and translation entries makes intellectual exchange a form of sustained labor. It also shows that religious diversity and cooperation existed within scholarly settings without implying that social relations were universally equal or free of conflict.
before.zh:
侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格是一位基督教学者，其翻译和医学工作连接希腊语、叙利亚语和阿拉伯语的学问传统。活动涉及文本比较，也涉及与学生、同事及其子伊斯哈格合作。译本可能经过修订或另一语言中转，才成为后世读者所知的版本。

因此需要关注具体作品和不确定的译者归属，不能把后来的每部医学文本都视为他直接完成。他的贡献位于资助者、医生和读者构成的更大网络。与阿拔斯、翻译运动条目相连，可把思想交换理解为持续劳动，也显示学术环境中的宗教多样性与合作，而不暗示社会关系普遍平等或没有冲突。

after.en:
Hunayn ibn Ishaq was a Christian scholar whose translation and medical work linked Greek, Syriac and Arabic learned traditions. His activity involved the comparison of texts and collaboration with pupils and associates, including his son Ishaq. A translation could be revised or transmitted through another language before reaching the version known to later readers.

A later Latin witness survives as Wellcome MS.390, an early-fourteenth-century copy of the Isagoge in Tegni Galeni attributed to Johannitius, Hunayn’s Latin name. Red initials distinguish sections, while marginal notes preserve later readers’ engagement. Its medieval copying and annotation belong to the text’s transmission history, not to Hunayn’s own hand.
after.zh:
侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格是一位基督教学者，其翻译和医学工作连接希腊语、叙利亚语和阿拉伯语的学问传统。活动涉及文本比较，也涉及与学生、同事及其子伊斯哈格合作。译本可能经过修订或另一语言中转，才成为后世读者所知的版本。

以侯奈因的拉丁名约翰尼提乌斯署名的《盖伦医术导论》，存有惠康MS.390这一十四世纪初拉丁文抄本。红色首字母区分段落，页边注释留下后世读者阅读的痕迹。这些中世纪抄写与批注属于文本传播史，并非侯奈因本人的手迹。

items.rationale: Replace generic interpretive framing with a specific attributed manuscript and its later readers; preserve collaborative translation context.

before.en: Physician Li Shizhen completes Compendium of Materia Medica in Qizhou after twenty-seven years of work
before.zh: 李时珍历二十七载三易其稿，于蕲州撰成药物学巨著《本草纲目》

after.en:
Physician Li Shizhen completes Compendium of Materia Medica in Qizhou after twenty-seven years of work

Plant illustrations preserved in an 1883 edition show the book’s later visual life. Four labelled panels compare leaves, flowers, bulbs and roots. Wellcome identifies these as pages from a later edition, distinct from the work’s first publication in 1596 and from Li Shizhen’s earlier manuscript.
after.zh:
李时珍历二十七载三易其稿，于蕲州撰成药物学巨著《本草纲目》

1883年版本保存的植物插图，展示这部著作后来的图像面貌。四个标注名称的图栏并置叶、花、鳞茎与根。惠康将其明确标为后世版本，不能与1596年首刊本或李时珍此前完成的原稿混为一谈。

items.rationale: Show a specific later textual witness, keeping it distinct from the original author’s manuscript and period.

before.en:
Ulugh Beg combined Timurid political authority with sustained interest in mathematical astronomy. The observatory associated with his court in Samarkand relied on several scholars, instruments, observations and calculations. Naming one ruler should not hide the work of colleagues such as al-Kashi and Qadi Zada or the institutional resources that made the project possible.

A star catalogue and astronomical tables were tools for subsequent calculation and comparison, not simply monuments to personal prestige. The conventional 1437 catalogue date supplies a useful anchor, while particular revisions and later circulation require more detailed textual study. Reading the biography with the existing observatory entry connects an individual with a place without duplicating its site history. His violent political end also warns against assuming that scholarly achievement guaranteed stable dynastic rule.
before.zh:
兀鲁伯把帖木儿政治权威与对数学天文的持续兴趣结合起来。撒马尔罕宫廷相关的天文台依赖多位学者、仪器、观测和计算。以一位统治者命名，不应遮蔽卡西、卡迪扎德等同事的工作，以及使计划成为可能的制度资源。

星表和天文表是后来计算、比较的工具，不只是个人声望的纪念物。惯用的1437年星表日期提供锚点，但具体修订与后续传播需要更细的文本研究。与已有天文台条目并读，可连接人物与地点而不重复遗址史。其暴力性的政治结局也提醒我们，学术成就不能保证王朝稳定。

after.en:
Ulugh Beg combined Timurid political authority with an interest in mathematical astronomy. His court’s observatory in Samarkand brought together scholars including al-Kashi and Qadi Zada, instruments and repeated calculations. Its star catalogue and astronomical tables supported later observation and comparison.

John Greaves published Epochae celebriores in London in 1650, drawing on chronology transmitted under Ulugh Beg’s name. The Persian-and-Latin edition names Greaves as editor and commentator: a surviving stage in the work’s passage from a Timurid scholarly setting to European readers.
after.zh:

约翰·格里夫斯1650年在伦敦刊行《著名纪元》，依据以兀鲁伯之名传承的年代学材料。波斯文与拉丁文版本列明格里夫斯的编辑与注释角色，保存了知识从帖木儿学术环境进入欧洲读者世界的一个环节。

before.en: Ibn Battuta left Tangier on pilgrimage in 1325 and continued travelling for many years through Africa and Asia. Legal training and shared religious institutions helped him find hospitality and employment, including service in Delhi. His experiences expose networks of scholars, merchants, pilgrims, rulers, and enslaved people rather than an empty world waiting to be discovered. After returning to Morocco, he related his travels to Ibn Juzayy, who shaped them into the Rihla. That collaboration matters: this is a retrospective literary narrative, and parts of its itinerary are disputed. It remains a rich starting point for asking what travellers observed, what they misunderstood, and how their expectations influenced the worlds they described.
before.zh: 伊本·白图泰于1325年离开丹吉尔朝觐，此后多年游历非洲与亚洲。法律知识和共同的宗教制度帮助他获得接待与工作，包括在德里任职。他的经历展示学者、商人、朝觐者、统治者与被奴役者的网络，而不是等待被“发现”的空白世界。回到摩洛哥后，他向伊本·朱扎伊口述经历，由后者整理成《游记》。这种合作十分重要：文本是回顾性的文学叙事，部分行程存在争议。它仍是思考旅行者看见了什么、误解了什么，以及期待如何影响描述的重要起点。

after.en:

Legal training and religious institutions helped him find hospitality and employment, including service in Delhi. His travels passed through networks of scholars, merchants, pilgrims, rulers and enslaved people. Back in Morocco, he related his experiences to Ibn Juzayy, who shaped them into the Rihla. The resulting account is retrospective and literary; parts of its itinerary are disputed.

Samuel Lee’s 1829 English title page identifies abridged Arabic manuscripts at Cambridge as the basis of his translation. The catalogue attributes the abridgment to Muhammad ibn Fath Allah al-Bayluni. The page makes an editorial chain visible: oral recollection, compilation, abridgment and translation.

塞缪尔·李1829年英译本的扉页说明，翻译依据剑桥所藏阿拉伯文节本手稿，目录将节本归于穆罕默德·伊本·法特赫·阿拉·拜卢尼。这一页呈现口述、编纂、节编与翻译相继发生的传播过程。

before.en:
Louis Riel became a spokesman for Métis resistance when Canadian expansion threatened Red River’s landholding and political arrangements. He headed a provisional government after the occupation of Upper Fort Garry in 1869. Negotiations helped establish Manitoba in 1870, but the settlement did not prevent conflict, displacement or the failure to secure all promised protections.

Riel’s career also involved the provisional government’s execution of Thomas Scott, exile in the United States and a return to the North-West in 1884. In 1885 he led resistance connected with Métis land grievances and was convicted and executed for treason. Different communities have interpreted his actions differently. His life joins constitutional negotiation to the social history of a people whose institutions existed before Canada’s claim to administer their homeland.
before.zh:
加拿大扩张威胁红河地区的土地与政治安排时，路易·里尔成为梅蒂斯抵抗的发言人。1869年上加里堡被占后，他领导临时政府。协商促成1870年马尼托巴省建立，但没有阻止冲突、迁离或承诺保护未能落实。

他的生涯还涉及临时政府处决托马斯·斯科特、流亡美国，以及1884年返回西北地区。1885年，他领导与梅蒂斯土地不满有关的抵抗，随后以叛国罪被定罪并处决。不同社群对其行动有不同解释。他的一生把宪制协商同梅蒂斯社会史相连：加拿大提出行政主张之前，这个民族已拥有自己的制度。

An 1870 group photograph preserved at Lakehead University places Riel among the provisional government’s councillors. Seated and standing figures share the frame; the archive identifies Riel at the centre.

before.en:
Sei Shōnagon’s Pillow Book gathers observations, lists, anecdotes and judgments from life around the Heian court. Attention to clothing, timing, conversation and poetry reveals how cultivated conduct helped make social distinctions. The writing is neither a continuous political chronicle nor a neutral survey of all Japanese society.

Her position as a court woman shaped what she could observe and whose conduct she judged. The work gives access to an authored perspective on aristocratic life while leaving farmers, laborers and many other people largely outside its frame. Comparing it with Murasaki Shikibu’s fiction exposes different literary ways of representing a related elite world. Uncertain life dates should not be replaced by invented precision; this entry follows the approximate period of the work.
before.zh:
清少纳言的《枕草子》汇集平安宫廷生活中的观察、清单、轶事与评价。对衣着、时机、谈吐和诗歌的关注，显示精致举止如何制造社会区分。它既不是连续的政治编年史，也不是对全体日本社会的中立调查。

宫廷女性的位置影响了她能观察什么、评价何人的行为。作品让读者接近一个关于贵族生活的作者视角，同时把农民、劳动者等许多人留在叙述框架之外。与紫式部小说比较，可看到表现相近精英世界的不同文学方式。其生卒年不应被虚构的精确日期取代，因此本条采用作品的大致时代。

after.en:
Sei Shōnagon’s Pillow Book gathers observations, lists, anecdotes and judgments from the Heian court. Clothing, conversation and poetry reveal how cultivated conduct marked social distinctions within aristocratic life.

A seventeenth-century painting by Tosa Mitsuoki turns one literary exchange into a visible gesture. In the episode identified by the Japanese museum record, the empress asks about the snow on Incense-Burner Peak, alluding to a poem by Bai Juyi; Sei answers by raising a blind. The painted figure belongs to the work’s later reception, not a contemporary portrait of its author.
after.zh:

土佐光起的十七世纪绘画把一次文学问答化为可见动作。日文馆藏记录所指的段落中，中宫以白居易诗句问及“香炉峰之雪”，清少纳言便卷起帘子作答。画中形象属于著作的后世接受史，并非作者生前的肖像。

before.en:
Gaya comprised several polities in the southern peninsula rather than a single centralized kingdom. Their cemeteries shared forms of stone-lined chambers and pottery while retaining local differences. The combination allows archaeologists to investigate both connections and political autonomy. Burial similarities alone do not demonstrate one government.

Pottery and other specialized products circulated through regional relationships. Elite cemeteries occupied prominent positions near local centers, making authority visible in the landscape. Silla’s expansion brought the independent Gaya polities under its control by the middle of the sixth century. A confederated political history therefore sits beside the histories of larger kingdoms and challenges a map that fills all early Korea with only three uniform blocks.
before.zh:
伽耶由半岛南部的多个政体构成，并非单一中央集权王国。各地墓园共享石室结构与陶器形式，同时保留地方差异。考古学因此能够同时研究彼此联系和政治自主；葬俗相似本身不能证明存在统一政府。

陶器等专业产品通过区域关系流通。精英墓园常位于地方中心附近的显著位置，使权威在景观中可见。至六世纪中叶，新罗扩张逐渐结束了各伽耶政体的独立地位。这样的联盟型政治史应与较大王国并列，提醒我们不能只用三个整齐色块表现早期半岛历史。

A fifth-century long-necked jar in the Metropolitan Museum (1997.34.4) is attributed specifically to Great Gaya. Raised bands and textured strips divide its tall neck above a rounded body.

before.en:
A small scorpion-like mark on a cloth's hem can preserve authorship even when a name has been lost. Two hand-painted àdìrẹ cloths collected in Ibadan in the 1960s carry such a signature. Women painted cassava-starch resist onto cotton before indigo dyeing, leaving pale designs when the protected areas were revealed. Other makers tied or stitched the cloth to resist the dye.

Patterns responded to the city and to customers. One celebrated Ibadan through the columns of Mapo Hall; another design was described to collectors as the fashionable cloth of 1964. Imported factory cotton became a material for local invention. These textiles connect Nigeria's political milestones to working knowledge, changing taste and women's businesses. The signature invites recognition of a maker without supplying a name that the collection cannot establish.
before.zh:
衣边一个像蝎子的标记，即使姓名失传，也可能保存作者身份。二十世纪六十年代在伊巴丹购藏的两件手绘阿迪雷布，带有这样的署名。女子在棉布上涂木薯淀粉防染，再浸入靛蓝，受到保护的部分形成浅色纹样。其他制作者则通过扎结或缝缀防染。

图案回应城市生活与顾客需求。一种用马波市政厅的柱子歌咏伊巴丹；另一种被当地卖家称为1964年的流行布样。进口机制棉布成为本地创新的材料。这些织物把尼日利亚的政治节点与实作知识、品味变化及女子经营联系起来。署名让人看到制作者，却不能补出馆藏尚未确定的姓名。

Patterns responded to the city and to customers. One celebrated Ibadan through the columns of Mapo Hall; another design was described to collectors as the fashionable cloth of 1964. Imported factory cotton became a material for local invention. These textiles connect Nigeria's political milestones to working knowledge, changing taste and women's businesses. The signature invites recognition of a maker without supplying a name that the collection cannot establish.

A separate wrapper at Princeton, dated around 1960, offers another example of the Ibadan design. Its patterned squares include Mapo Hall, while its border bears two maker marks. The museum leaves open whether two women painted it. Comparing the cloths brings individual signatures and variations within a shared design into view.

before.en:
Over the second to fourth centuries, Jewish and Christian communities developed institutions and identities in different settings. Markus Tiwald’s essay argues that differentiation was prolonged and uneven, and reads later writers as evidence that some relationships and contested practices continued. That is a scholarly interpretation of selected texts, not proof of one timetable applying everywhere.

The Metropolitan Museum discusses a third-century synagogue at Dura-Europos near a Christian meeting house. These buildings are material evidence for particular communities, not proof that every Jew and Christian shared the same relationships. Judaism and Christianity both continued to develop after the end of this editorial window.
before.zh:
公元二至四世纪，犹太与基督徒社群在不同环境中发展制度和身份。马库斯·蒂瓦尔德的文章认为，二者分化漫长且各地不一，并把后世作者的文字视为某些关系和有争议实践仍然存在的证据。这是对部分文本的学术解释，不证明各地都遵循同一时间表。

大都会艺术博物馆讨论了杜拉欧罗普斯一座公元三世纪会堂及其附近的基督徒聚会场所。这些建筑是特定社群的物质证据，不证明每个犹太人与基督徒之间的关系都相同。犹太教与基督教在本编辑时段之后均继续发展。

The Metropolitan Museum discusses a third-century synagogue at Dura-Europos near a Christian meeting house.

A Roman gold-glass bowl dated 300–350 preserves a different kind of evidence: an open Torah ark and ritual implements rendered in gold leaf. The Metropolitan Museum identifies menorahs, a shofar and a citron. The fragile fragments make Jewish imagery visible within Roman material culture, alongside the architectural evidence from Dura-Europos.

一件公元300至350年的罗马金箔玻璃碗，保存了另一类证据：以金箔描出的敞开经柜与仪式器物。大都会博物馆识别出烛台、羊角号和香橼。脆弱残片让罗马物质文化中的犹太图像变得可见，与杜拉欧罗普斯的建筑证据相互参照。

before.en:
Wollstonecraft argued that women’s apparent dependence should be examined through education, social expectations and material relationships. Her political writing belonged to debates about virtue, commercial society and the French Revolution, not only to a later history of voting rights. Criticism of inherited privilege and the condition of women formed connected parts of her thought.

A Vindication of the Rights of Woman appeared in 1792. It challenged forms of education that cultivated display and dependence rather than reason and responsibility. The work’s later reception changed: private-life controversy affected her reputation, while readers in different countries returned to her arguments for their own purposes. Her biography connects authorship and intellectual labor with questions about family, livelihood and citizenship. It does not assume that an eighteenth-century writer anticipated every position later associated with feminism, or that publication itself produced equal rights for her contemporaries.
before.zh:
沃斯通克拉夫特主张，应通过教育、社会期待和物质关系来考察女性表现出的依附状态。她的政治写作属于关于德性、商业社会及法国革命的争论，而不只是后来投票权历史的一部分。批评世袭特权与分析女性处境，是其思想中相互联系的内容。

《女权辩护》于1792年出版，挑战培养装饰性表现与依附、却不培养理性和责任的教育方式。作品的接受后来发生变化：私生活争议影响声誉，不同国家的读者又为各自目的重读其论证。她的传记把写作及知识劳动，与家庭、生计和公民身份联系起来。本条不假定十八世纪作者已经预见后来所有女性主义立场，也不把出版等同于同时代女性立即取得平等权利。

before.en:
Al-Biruni worked on astronomy, mathematics, chronology and the comparison of religious and intellectual traditions. His life crossed changes of political patronage in Khwarazm and the Ghaznavid world. Observations and dated statements in his own works provide anchors that are more secure than some reconstructions of his movements.

His account of Indian knowledge involved language learning, comparison and efforts to understand systems different from his own. Such work should not be reduced either to an isolated genius or to a claim that every description was impartial. Scholars can identify both methods and the limits of available evidence. Linking this biography with Aryabhata and Ibn Sina situates intellectual exchange across regions, while the representative pin does not imply a permanent residence or a continuous, independently surveyed route.
before.zh:
比鲁尼研究天文、数学、编年，并比较宗教和思想传统。生涯跨越花剌子模与伽色尼世界中政治资助者的变化。其本人著作中的观测和纪年，为生平提供比某些迁移重建更稳固的锚点。

对印度知识的叙述涉及语言学习、比较以及理解不同体系的努力。这些工作不能缩为孤立天才的故事，也不表示每项描述都不带立场。研究者可以同时辨析方法与现有证据局限。与阿耶波多、伊本·西那相连，可以把思想交换置于跨区域环境；代表性点位不表示永久居所或连续、独立测绘的路线。

after.en:
Al-Biruni worked on astronomy, mathematics, chronology and the comparison of religious and intellectual traditions. His life crossed changes of political patronage in Khwarazm and the Ghaznavid world. His account of Indian knowledge drew on language learning and comparison across intellectual traditions.

A later manuscript at Princeton preserves Ibn Sina’s letter addressed to al-Biruni. Its catalogue identifies two sequences of ten and seven philosophical questions and answers. Copied in a manuscript dated 1279, the opening page makes their scholarly exchange visible as a text transmitted between generations.
after.zh:
比鲁尼研究天文、数学、编年，并比较宗教与思想传统。其生涯跨越花剌子模与伽色尼世界中政治资助者的变化；对印度知识的叙述则依靠语言学习与不同思想传统之间的比较。

普林斯顿保存的一部后世手稿收录伊本·西那致比鲁尼的书信。目录指出其中有两组哲学问答，分别包含十问与七问。目录定年为1279年的手稿开篇，让这场学术交流以历代传抄的文本形式呈现在眼前。

items.rationale: Replace generic caveats with specific scholarly work and a dated manuscript witness; retain original biographical sources and identify the later copy.

before.en:
The Sulalat al-Salatin, commonly known as the Malay Annals, assembled stories of kings and political ancestry connected with Melaka and its successors. Work associated with the Johor court in 1612 took place amid repeated attacks and relocation. A prestigious past could provide a language for claiming authority when control of the present was insecure.

The text exists in multiple versions, and attribution to Tun Sri Lanang involves questions of compiling and editing earlier material. It should not be treated as a modern single-author chronicle whose every episode has the same evidential status. Stories, genealogy and political memory require comparison with other sources. Reading the work as a courtly intervention preserves its historical value without converting legitimizing legend into a literal map of early states.
before.zh:
通常称为《马来纪年》的《诸王世系》，汇集同马六甲及其继承者有关的君王和政治祖系故事。1612年同柔佛宫廷相关的编纂，发生于反复进攻和迁移之中；在现实控制不稳时，显赫过去可为权威诉求提供语言。

文本存有多个版本，敦斯里拉囊的归属还涉及对早期资料的汇编与编辑，不能视为现代单一作者的编年史，并把每个情节赋予同样证据地位。故事、谱系与政治记忆需要同其他资料比较。将作品理解为宫廷干预，可保留历史价值，又不把合法化传说变成早期国家的字面地图。

after.en:
The Malay Annals joins royal genealogy with stories of Melaka and its successors. Tun Sri Lanang is associated with Johor’s 1612 compilation, in a court repeatedly displaced by conflict. Multiple versions preserve a layered work shaped by earlier writings and later editors.

The surviving 1821 London title page opens John Leyden’s English translation, introduced by Stamford Raffles. Its named translator, publisher and date show another stage of transmission, far removed from the seventeenth-century court.
after.zh:
《马来纪年》将王室谱系与马六甲及其继承者的故事相连。敦斯里拉囊同柔佛1612年的编纂相关，当时宫廷因战争反复迁移。存世多个版本叠合了早期书写与后世编辑。

1821年伦敦版扉页开启约翰·莱登的英译本，斯坦福·莱佛士作序。其译者、出版者与日期呈现了远离17世纪宫廷的又一传播阶段。

items.rationale: Replace generic cautionary prose with the specific later edition or manuscript while retaining meaningful source distinctions.

before.en:
Tun Sri Lanang served as Johor’s bendahara, a senior court office, during struggles with Aceh and Portuguese Melaka. He is associated with the compilation of the Malay Annals, although multiple textual versions make simple claims of sole authorship uncertain. His political position and literary activity belonged to the same courtly world.

A commission in 1612 was followed by Aceh’s attack and his capture in 1613. Accounts connect later work on the text with those circumstances. The narrative of royal descent could help sustain Johor’s claim to Melaka’s inheritance amid displacement. NLB’s discussion also questions older assumptions about his later life. This biography consequently follows a documented activity window rather than assigning unverified birth and death dates or treating a court text as a complete personal autobiography.
before.zh:
敦斯里拉囊在柔佛同亚齐及葡属马六甲竞争期间担任高级宫廷官职“班达哈拉”。他同《马来纪年》的编纂相关，但多个文本版本使“唯一作者”的简单判断存在不确定性。政治职位与文学活动属于同一个宫廷世界。

1612年的编纂委托之后，亚齐于1613年进攻，他被俘获；有关记载把后续写作与这些处境相连。王室血统叙事可以在迁徙中维持柔佛继承马六甲的诉求。新加坡国家图书馆的讨论也质疑了对其晚年的旧假设。因此本传采用有文献支持的活动窗口，不给出未经核实的生卒年，也不把宫廷文本视为个人完整自传。

after.en:
Tun Sri Lanang served as Johor’s bendahara, a senior court official. A 1612 commission to compile the Malay Annals was followed by the Acehnese attack and his capture in 1613. His association with the work includes the compilation and editing of earlier material.

The 1821 English edition shown here is a later translation, not a surviving page in his hand. Read its title page alongside the court story to distinguish compilation, translation and publication as separate moments.
after.zh:
敦斯里拉囊任柔佛高级宫廷官职班达哈拉。1612年受命编纂《马来纪年》后，1613年亚齐进攻，他遭到俘获。他同作品的关系也涉及对早期资料的汇编和编辑。

这里展示的是1821年英译本，并非他的亲笔遗页。将扉页与宫廷故事并读，可分辨编纂、翻译与出版这几个不同阶段。

items.rationale: Replace generic cautionary prose with the specific later edition or manuscript while retaining meaningful source distinctions.

before.en:
Nguyễn Du lived through the collapse of an older political order, Tây Sơn upheaval and the establishment of the Nguyễn dynasty. His movement between elite family settings, periods of insecurity and official service gave his writing a context shaped by political change. Entering Nguyễn service in 1802 did not erase those earlier experiences.

The Tale of Kiều used Vietnamese literary expression in a character-based writing tradition and became a work repeatedly copied, printed and interpreted. Its story of a woman’s constrained choices should not be mistaken for a transparent transcript of one historical life. Manuscripts and printed objects preserve the work’s transmission as well as its words. His biography therefore links court service, language and literary memory without assigning one undisputed composition year to the poem.
before.zh:
阮攸经历旧政治秩序瓦解、西山动荡与阮朝建立。他在精英家族环境、不安定生活及官职之间的转移，为写作提供了政治变化塑造的语境。1802年进入阮朝仕途，并未抹去此前经历。

《金云翘传》以字喃等字符传统表达越南语，后来不断被抄写、刊印和解释。作品描绘女性受约束的选择，但不能把文学故事当作某个历史人物生平的直接记录。抄本与印本既保存文字，也保存传播过程。因此，传记把仕途、语言与文学记忆相连，不为长诗强加一个毫无争议的写成年份。

after.en:
Nguyễn Du lived through Tây Sơn upheaval and the establishment of the Nguyễn dynasty, entering Nguyễn service in 1802. His Tale of Kiều became a major work of Vietnamese literature, continually copied, printed and interpreted.

A British Library manuscript from the second half of the nineteenth century pairs the story with illustrations. Its opening places three figures below the title; handwritten annotations and a library stamp record later encounters with the book. This is a copy made after the poet’s death, not his autograph.
after.zh:
阮攸经历西山动荡与阮朝建立，于1802年进入阮朝仕途。《金云翘传》成为越南文学重要作品，不断被抄写、刊印与诠释。

大英图书馆收藏的一部19世纪后半叶抄本，将故事与插图结合。卷首题名下绘有三个人物，手写批注与馆藏印章记录了书籍后来的流转。这是诗人去世后的抄本，而非亲笔原稿。

items.rationale: Replace generic cautionary prose with the specific later edition or manuscript while retaining meaningful source distinctions.

before.en: Indigenous communities in the Ohio River watershed created enormous geometric earthworks for ceremonial gatherings and the treatment of the dead. Circles, squares and other forms required shared measurements and coordinated labor, while some alignments followed solar and lunar cycles. Objects made from materials reaching Ohio from distant regions reveal connections extending toward Florida and the Yellowstone basin. These were networks of communities rather than evidence of one centrally ruled empire. “Hopewell” is a modern archaeological label, taken from a later landowner’s name. The earthworks preserve Indigenous achievements in engineering, astronomy, art and collective organization that preceded European arrival by many centuries.
before.zh: 俄亥俄河流域的原住民社区营建巨大的几何土筑设施，用于仪式集会和安葬。圆形、方形等结构需要共同尺度与协调劳动，部分布局与日月周期相应。远方材料制成的器物显示，联系延伸至佛罗里达和黄石流域。这些证据反映社区网络，而非一个中央集权帝国。“霍普维尔”是现代考古名称，来自后来地主的姓氏，并非已知古代自称。土筑遗存记录原住民在欧洲人到来数百年前的工程、天文、艺术与集体组织成就。

after.en: Indigenous communities in the Ohio River watershed created enormous geometric earthworks for ceremonial gatherings and the treatment of the dead. Circles, squares and other forms required shared measurements and coordinated labor, while some alignments followed solar and lunar cycles. Objects made from materials reaching Ohio from distant regions reveal connections extending toward Florida and the Yellowstone basin. These were networks of communities rather than evidence of one centrally ruled empire. “Hopewell” is a modern archaeological label, taken from a later landowner’s name. The earthworks preserve Indigenous achievements in engineering, astronomy, art and collective organization that preceded European arrival by many centuries. At Mound City Group, reconstructed mounds and an enclosing earth bank preserve the layout of one ceremonial complex. The accompanying photograph shows this site, separate from the Hopewell Mound Group marked on the map.
after.zh: 俄亥俄河流域的原住民社区营建巨大的几何土筑设施，用于仪式集会和安葬。圆形、方形等结构需要共同尺度与协调劳动，部分布局与日月周期相应。远方材料制成的器物显示，联系延伸至佛罗里达和黄石流域。这些证据反映社区网络，而非一个中央集权帝国。“霍普维尔”是现代考古名称，来自后来地主的姓氏，并非已知古代自称。土筑遗存记录原住民在欧洲人到来数百年前的工程、天文、艺术与集体组织成就。 在芒德城土丘群，重建土丘与围合土堤保留了一处仪式建筑群的布局。配图展示这一遗址，与地图所标的霍普维尔土丘群分属不同地点。

items.rationale: Add source-backed photographed-site context while preserving chronology and original narrative.

before.en: Ancestral Pueblo communities made Chaco a centre for ceremony, exchange and political activity. Large masonry buildings and roads to outlying settlements reveal organization across a region. As Chaco's role changed, people moved and other centres developed. Pueblo peoples maintain connections with this landscape, including its place in sacred migration histories.
before.zh: 普韦布洛人的祖先使查科成为仪式、交流与政治活动的中心。大型石砌建筑以及连接外围聚落的道路，呈现了区域性的组织。随着查科的地位改变，人们迁移，其他中心逐渐发展。普韦布洛人与这片景观仍保持联系，其中包括神圣迁徙历史中的记忆。

after.en: Ancestral Pueblo communities made Chaco a centre for ceremony, exchange and political activity. Large masonry buildings and roads to outlying settlements reveal organization across a region. As Chaco's role changed, people moved and other centres developed. Pueblo peoples maintain connections with this landscape, including its place in sacred migration histories. At Pueblo Bonito, traces of theobromine in three tested pottery sherds provide evidence of cacao reaching Chaco. Their decorative styles place them around 1000–1125. The chemical finding establishes cacao use; proposals about who drank it and its ritual role go beyond the test itself.
after.zh: 普韦布洛人的祖先使查科成为仪式、交流与政治活动的中心。大型石砌建筑以及连接外围聚落的道路，呈现了区域性的组织。随着查科的地位改变，人们迁移，其他中心逐渐发展。普韦布洛人与这片景观仍保持联系，其中包括神圣迁徙历史中的记忆。 在普韦布洛博尼托，三件受检陶片中的可可碱残留提供了可可传入查科的证据，纹饰将其年代定位于约1000—1125年。化学检测支持可可的使用；饮用者身份及其仪式作用，则仍是超出检测本身的解释。

before.en: This corridor linked Chinese capitals with trading settlements and routes reaching Central Asia. It carried more than goods: religious ideas, scientific knowledge, techniques and artistic practices also travelled through its connected communities. The surviving evidence includes cities, cave temples, passes, towers and posthouses. The map marker represents an eastern anchor of a changing network; it should not be read as the origin of every exchange or as a single fixed road.
before.zh: 这一廊道把中国都城与通向中亚的商贸聚落和道路连接起来。流动的不只是货物，还有信仰、知识、技术和艺术。城市、石窟寺、关隘、烽燧与驿站留下了不同类型的证据。地图上的标记只是不断变化的路网东端之一，不代表所有交流的起点，也不表示丝路是一条固定道路。

after.en: Caravans, envoys and monks travelling between Chang’an and the Tianshan passes linked Chinese capitals with oasis markets across Central Asia. Alongside silk, horses, glass and paper moved Buddhist scriptures, astronomical tables, musical instruments and mural techniques, still visible in walled towns, cave temples, beacon towers and desert posthouses. Rather than one fixed highway with a single starting gate, the corridor operated through shifting branches that rose and shifted with water, garrison security and oasis politics.
after.zh: 往来于长安与天山山口之间的商队、使节与僧侣，把中原都城同中亚绿洲市集连接起来。与丝绸、马匹、玻璃和纸张一同西东流转的，还有佛经、历算、乐器与壁画技法，至今仍留存于古城、石窟寺、烽燧与驿站遗迹之中。这条廊道并非自唯一起点延伸的单一固定官道，而是随水源、戍防与绿洲政局不断分合改道的路网。

items.rationale: Replace map-marker meta-commentary with concrete historical goods, travellers and shifting oasis routes.

before.en: The Mughal emperor Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal at Agra as a mausoleum for his wife. White marble, a planned garden setting and an ordered architectural composition made remembrance visible in the landscape. This entry focuses on the main construction phase given by UNESCO. Studying the monument invites questions about the relationship between personal memory, imperial resources and the work of the many makers involved in a large building project.
before.zh: 莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗下令在阿格拉为妻子修建泰姬陵。白色大理石、园林布局与有序的建筑构图，把纪念之情转化为景观。本条目聚焦来源给出的主体营造阶段。观察这座陵墓，也可以思考个人记忆、帝国资源和大型工程中众多建造者的劳动之间有什么联系。

after.en: Commissioned at Agra by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan for his consort Mumtaz Mahal, the Taj Mahal set a white Makrana marble mausoleum inlaid with semi-precious stones at the riverfront end of a walled quadripartite garden. Calligraphers, stonemasons, pietra dura Lapidaries and hydraulic engineers drawn from across South, Central and West Asia turned imperial grief and courtly revenue into a carefully proportioned landscape along the Yamuna.
after.zh: 莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗为爱妃姬蔓·芭奴在阿格拉营建泰姬陵，将镶嵌宝石的马克拉纳白大理石陵寝置于亚穆纳河畔四分对称园林的尽端。汇聚自南亚、中亚与西亚的书法家、石匠、硬石镶嵌艺人及水利工师协同劳作，将帝王哀思与帝国财力化作秩序严整的河畔纪念景观。

items.rationale: Replace UNESCO/study-prompt meta-talk with the actual makers, materials and riverfront setting.

before.en: Mao Zedong proclaimed the People’s Republic of China in Beijing after Communist victories in the civil war. The Nationalist government retreated to Taiwan, and the political division continued beyond the proclamation. Years of war, mobilization and competing programs of social change shaped the outcome. International recognition and alliances became part of the emerging Cold War. This entry marks a change of government and political order, not the beginning of Chinese society or a resolution of every territorial question. Comparing it with 1911 highlights how ending one regime and consolidating another can be separate historical processes.
before.zh: 毛泽东在共产党取得内战优势后，于北京宣布中华人民共和国成立。国民党政府退至台湾，政治分裂并未随宣告而结束。长期战争、社会动员及不同社会改革方案共同塑造结果，国际承认与联盟也卷入冷战。本条目记录政权和政治秩序的转折，不将其视为中国社会的起点，也不暗示所有领土问题已获解决。

after.en: On 1 October 1949 Mao Zedong proclaimed the People’s Republic of China in Beijing after Communist armies prevailed across mainland battlefields in the civil war. Chiang Kai-shek’s Nationalist government retreated to Taipei, leaving rival governments across the Taiwan Strait as Cold War recognition and alliances hardened. Decades of wartime devastation, rural land mobilization and competing blueprints for modern statehood now turned from military conquest to the harder task of building new governing institutions.
after.zh: 1949年10月1日，在内战大陆战场取得决定性胜利后，毛泽东于北京宣告中华人民共和国成立。蒋介石领导的国民党政府退往台北，海峡两岸的政治对峙在冷战阵营与外交承认格局中延续。历经长期战乱、农村动员与不同建国方案的较量后，新政权随即从军事夺权转入重塑国家与基层制度的阶段。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry marks..." and "Comparing it with 1911..." meta-prose in favor of direct historical narrative.

before.en: Ghana became independent on 6 March 1957. Its new foreign ministry and diplomatic service were part of the institutions needed to conduct relations with other states. Kwame Nkrumah connected foreign policy with a vision of African unity, and an African Affairs Secretariat became one expression of that aim. The entry focuses on independence and institution-building; it should not be used to claim that Ghana was the first independent African country.
before.zh: 加纳于1957年3月6日独立。新的外交部和外交机构，是开展国家间关系所需制度的一部分。夸梅·恩克鲁玛把外交政策与非洲团结的愿景联系起来，非洲事务秘书处体现了这一方向。本条目聚焦独立与机构建设，并不宣称加纳是非洲第一个独立国家。

after.en: On 6 March 1957 the former British colony of the Gold Coast became independent as Ghana, the first sub-Saharan African colony to break European rule in the postwar era (though sovereign African states such as Ethiopia, Liberia and Egypt already stood in the United Nations). Prime Minister Kwame Nkrumah built a new foreign service alongside an African Affairs Secretariat in Accra, turning independence at home into an organizing hub for continental liberation movements.
after.zh: 1957年3月6日，原英属黄金海岸殖民地正式独立并定名加纳，成为二战后撒哈拉以南非洲率先摆脱欧洲殖民统治的国家（当时埃塞俄比亚、利比里亚、埃及等非洲主权国已先期存在）。总理夸梅·恩克鲁玛在阿克拉组建外交部与非洲事务秘书处，使本国独立成为声援全非解放运动的枢纽。

items.rationale: State the historical distinction directly instead of writing "The entry focuses on... it should not be used to claim...".

before.en: The Khmer Rouge attempted to remake Cambodia into an agrarian society through coercion, forced labor and extreme political control. Mass executions, persecution, hunger and the destruction of ordinary social life caused immense suffering and death. The regime’s ideological promises cannot be separated from the institutions and choices that imposed these conditions on people. Evidence preserved by Cambodian documentation projects and museums helps recover victims’ experiences and identify responsibility. The fall of the regime in Phnom Penh did not end Cambodia’s conflict or its survivors’ losses. This entry marks the years of national rule, within a longer history of war and recovery.
before.zh: 红色高棉通过强制、强迫劳动和严密政治控制，企图把柬埔寨重塑为农业社会。大规模处决、迫害、饥饿与日常社会生活的破坏造成巨大苦难。意识形态承诺不能脱离实施压迫的制度和具体选择。柬埔寨文献机构与博物馆保存证据，重建受害者经历并确认责任。金边政权倒台没有结束全部冲突或幸存者损失；本条目聚焦全国统治时期，并置于更长期战争与恢复之中。

after.en: Between April 1975 and January 1979 the Khmer Rouge emptied Phnom Penh and other towns at gunpoint, attempting to force Cambodia into a collectivized agrarian order under extreme surveillance. Summary executions, political purges, exhausting labour quotas, untreated disease and engineered famine killed well over a million people and shattered families across the country. Although Vietnamese-backed forces drove the regime from Phnom Penh in 1979, border warfare, displacement and the long work of documenting victims’ fates continued for decades.
after.zh: 1975年4月至1979年1月间，红色高棉以武力驱空金边等城镇居民，企图在严密监控与强迫劳动下将柬埔寨彻底改造为集体农耕社会。处决、清洗、超负荷劳役、缺医少药与饥荒夺走逾百万人生命，令无数家庭破碎。1979年金边政权倒台后，边境战事、难民流离以及幸存者搜集证据追寻亲人下落的努力仍延续数十年。

items.rationale: Replace abstract meta-sentences ("This entry marks...") with concrete chronology and survivor realities.

before.en: South Sudan separated from Sudan on 9 July 2011 following an internationally monitored referendum in January. The vote formed part of the peace process established by the 2005 Comprehensive Peace Agreement. South Sudan joined the United Nations on 14 July. Independence changed the international political map, but should not be read as proof that all border questions or political conflicts were settled. A map of 2011 needs a date within the year to show this change accurately.
before.zh: 南苏丹在1月举行国际监督的公投后，于2011年7月9日从苏丹独立。公投属于2005年《全面和平协议》建立的和平进程。南苏丹于7月14日加入联合国。独立改变了国际政治地图，却不等于所有边界问题或政治冲突都已解决。2011年的地图必须说明年内具体日期，才能准确呈现这一变化。

after.en: Following the 2005 Comprehensive Peace Agreement that ended decades of civil war, voters in southern Sudan backed secession in an internationally monitored January 2011 referendum. On 9 July 2011 the Republic of South Sudan declared independence in Juba and entered the United Nations five days later on 14 July—redrawing Africa’s international map mid-year while leaving Abyei, oil transit revenues and internal power-sharing unresolved.
after.zh: 依据结束数十年内战的2005年《全面和平协议》，苏丹南部选民在2011年1月国际监督公投中压倒性支持分立。2011年7月9日，南苏丹共和国在朱巴宣告独立，并于7月14日加入联合国；这一年中政治版图改写的同时，阿卜耶伊归属、石油过境收益与国内权力分配争议仍悬而未决。

items.rationale: Replace map-making instructions with concrete unresolved border and political issues.

before.en: The Yemen Arab Republic and the People’s Democratic Republic of Yemen merged on 22 May 1990 to form the Republic of Yemen. They had previously held separate memberships in the United Nations, dating from 1947 and 1967. The unified state continued their international relationships and treaty obligations. This record concerns the 1990 constitutional union; it does not describe later military control or imply that subsequent political conflict disappeared.
before.zh: 阿拉伯也门共和国与也门民主人民共和国于1990年5月22日合并为也门共和国。此前，两国分别自1947年和1967年起拥有联合国会员资格。统一后的国家延续了它们的国际关系与条约义务。本条目讨论1990年的国家统一，不用于描绘后来的军事控制，也不意味着此后的政治冲突已经消失。

after.en: On 22 May 1990 the Yemen Arab Republic in the north and the People’s Democratic Republic of Yemen in the south merged constitutionally to form the Republic of Yemen, combining two separate United Nations seats held since 1947 and 1967. While treaties and diplomatic representation fused under one flag in Sanaa, rival military commands and party networks remained intact, foreshadowing civil war within four years.
after.zh: 1990年5月22日，北方的阿拉伯也门共和国与南方的也门民主人民共和国依宪合并为也门共和国，合二为一承接两国分别自1947年与1967年拥有的联合国席位。尽管外交代表与条约义务统一于萨那政府旗帜之下，南北各自的军队指挥体系与政党网络并未真正融合，四年后即再度爆发内战。

items.rationale: Remove "This record concerns..." and state the institutional tension that followed 1990 directly.

before.en: Representatives of dozens of Indigenous nations and the governor of New France concluded the Great Peace of Montréal after years of diplomacy. The agreement addressed warfare and relationships among peoples whose networks extended far beyond the French colony's towns. Indigenous delegates acted as political negotiators, not simply as subjects appearing before a European government. Their pictographic marks on the treaty preserve an unusual visual record of participation. The document makes diplomacy visible across a region often reduced on maps to competing colonial colours, while reminding readers that a treaty records negotiated commitments rather than guaranteed harmony forever.
before.zh: 经过多年外交协商，数十个原住民族群代表与新法兰西总督缔结《蒙特利尔大和平条约》。协议处理战争及不同群体之间的关系，其网络远超法国殖民城市。原住民代表是政治谈判者，并非只是向欧洲政府呈见的臣民。条约上的图像标记保存了独特的参与记录。在常被地图简化为殖民势力色块的地区，这份文件使外交网络重新可见，同时提醒我们，条约记录协商承诺而非永远和谐的保证。

after.en: In the summer of 1701 roughly 1,300 delegates from nearly forty Indigenous nations gathered at Montréal with Governor Hector de Callières of New France to end decades of Beaver Wars conflict across the Great Lakes and St Lawrence basin. Acting as sovereign diplomats rather than colonial subjects, Haudenosaunee, Anishinaabe and allied speakers negotiated prisoner returns, hunting grounds and French mediation, sealing the treaty parchment with clan pictographs of turtle, bear, crane and beaver.
after.zh: 1701年夏，来自近四十个原住民族群的约一千三百名代表齐聚蒙特利尔，与新法兰西总督卡利耶尔缔结《蒙特利尔大和平条约》，结束五大湖与圣劳伦斯流域旷日持久的战乱。豪德诺索尼、阿尼希纳贝及各族使节以主权谈判者身份议定战俘交换、猎场共享与调停机制，并在羊皮纸盟约上绘下龟、熊、鹤、河狸等氏族图腾印记。

items.rationale: Replace colonial-map meta-talk with the actual 1701 gathering, nations and clan pictographs.

before.en: Bronze drums associated with Đông Sơn culture provide material evidence of connections across mainland and island Southeast Asia and southern China. Their decoration includes animals and human activity, while large drums and small models invite different questions about performance, status and burial practices. A clay drum model in the Metropolitan Museum’s collection illustrates how an object’s form could continue in another material and setting. The exact purposes of particular drums remain debated, so their distribution should not be turned into a map of one empire. Comparing casting, decoration and archaeological contexts helps reconstruct exchange without assuming that every community used these objects in the same way.
before.zh: 与东山文化相关的铜鼓，为东南亚大陆、岛屿地区及中国南方之间的联系提供了实物证据。鼓面装饰包含动物与人的活动；大型铜鼓和小型模型又让我们提出有关演奏、地位及丧葬的不同问题。大都会艺术博物馆收藏的一件陶鼓模型，显示同一种器物形式可以进入不同材质与使用环境。具体铜鼓的用途仍存在讨论，不能把分布范围直接画成一个帝国的疆域。比较铸造、纹饰与出土背景，有助于重建交流，同时尊重各社群使用方式的差异。

after.en: Lost-wax bronze drums cast in northern Vietnam and southern China carried feathered-warrior processions, longboats, stilt granaries and flying herons across river mouths and sea lanes from Yunnan to Java and eastern Indonesia. Massive ceremonial drums sounded at feasts and funerals, while miniature ceramic or bronze models—like a clay drum model now in the Metropolitan Museum—went into graves as portable emblems of rank. Shared drum styles traced vigorous riverine and maritime trade among autonomous chiefdoms rather than a single territorial empire.
after.zh: 在越南北部与中国南方以失蜡法铸造的东山铜鼓，将羽冠武士、长舟、干栏谷仓与翔鹭纹饰沿河口与海路传布至云南、爪哇及印度尼西亚东部。巨型铜鼓在宴饮与葬礼上轰鸣立威，而如大都会艺术博物馆所藏陶鼓模型般的小型明器则随葬墓中象征身份。相似铜鼓的广布映照出独立酋邦间活跃的水陆交换网络，而非单一帝国疆域。

items.rationale: Cut classroom prompt language ("invite different questions") and bring forward bronze casting and imagery.

before.en: Halin, Beikthano and Sri Ksetra preserve the remains of cities that developed within the dry zone of the Ayeyarwady basin. Walls and moats enclosed substantial settlements supported by reservoirs, channels and cultivated land. Craft production and long-distance exchange connected these communities with wider routes, while monasteries and stupas show the growing importance of Buddhism. The evidence concerns several cities with distinct histories, not a single capital occupied unchanged for a millennium. Their landscapes make the link between urban growth and water management visible. They also remind us that the adoption of religious ideas involved local communities, technologies and institutions.
before.zh: 哈林、毗湿奴城和室利差呾罗保存了伊洛瓦底江流域干旱地区发展起来的古城遗存。城墙与壕沟围绕规模可观的聚落，水库、渠道及农田为其提供支撑。手工业生产和远距离交换将这些社群连接到更广阔的交通网络，寺院与佛塔则显示佛教日益重要。这里呈现的是历史各异的数座城市，而非一座千年不变的都城。其景观清楚显示城市发展与水利的关系，也提醒我们宗教传播需要经过本地社群、技术与制度的转化。

after.en: Across the dry central plain of the Ayeyarwady basin, walled brick cities at Halin, Beikthano and Sri Ksetra flourished for centuries by trapping seasonal stream runoff inlinked tanks, weirs and feeder canals. Inside curved moats and fortified gates, carnelian-bead drillers, silver coin-minters and ironsmiths traded overland toward Yunnan and by sea toward South India, while brick stupas and Pali inscriptions anchored early Theravada and Sanskritic Buddhist monastic life across separate city-polities.
after.zh: 在伊洛瓦底江中游干旱平原上，哈林、毗湿奴城与室利差呾罗等砖墙古城借蓄水池、堰坝与引水渠拦蓄季节性溪流，延续数百年繁荣。弧形护城河与城门之内，红玉髓珠匠、银币铸工与铁匠北通云南、南接印度洋航路，砖塔与巴利文铭刻则见证佛教寺院传统在各自独立的城邦间扎根。

items.rationale: Remove "reminds us that..." and specify the dry-zone hydraulic, craft and Buddhist evidence.

before.en: Northern rangatira signed He Whakaputanga at Waitangi on 28 October 1835, asserting their authority and proposing collective arrangements for law, peace and trade. The declaration also sought protection from the British king while rejecting government imposed without the chiefs’ authorization. Its Māori wording and the English version associated with James Busby need to be read with attention to language and political context. Thirty-four chiefs initially signed, with more signatures added later. The document reveals Indigenous diplomatic initiative before the Treaty of Waitangi. It should not be treated as proof that every Māori community had joined one centrally governed modern state.
before.zh: 1835年10月28日，新西兰北部毛利首领在怀唐伊签署《独立宣言》，申明自身权威，并提出共同处理法律、和平与贸易事务的安排。宣言也寻求英国国王保护，同时拒绝未经首领授权而强加的政府。理解毛利语文本与詹姆斯·巴斯比相关英文版本，需要注意语言和政治背景。最初有34位首领签署，后来继续增加。文件呈现了《怀唐伊条约》之前原住民的外交行动，却不能证明所有毛利社群都已加入一个中央集权的现代国家。

after.en: On 28 October 1835 thirty-four northern rangatira met British Resident James Busby at Waitangi and signed *He Whakaputanga o te Rangatiratanga o Nu Tireni*, proclaiming the sovereign authority (*mana* and *kingitanga*) of the hereditary chiefs and proposing annual assemblies at Waitangi to frame laws and keep peace. More signatures through 1839 brought the roll to fifty-two chiefs across the North Island, asserting Māori diplomatic standing internationally while each hapū retained autonomous self-rule on the ground.
after.zh: 1835年10月28日，三十四位北部毛利首领在怀唐伊与英国驻扎官詹姆斯·巴斯比会面，签署《新西兰独立宣言》（He Whakaputanga），申明世袭首领的最高权威（mana），倡议每年在怀唐伊集会立法维和，并拒绝任何未经首领授权的外部管治。至1839年续签首领增至五十二人，既在国际间宣示毛利外交主体地位，又保留各氏族部落（hapū）的地方自治。

items.rationale: Replace "should not be treated as proof..." with direct explanation of rangatira diplomacy and hapū autonomy.

before.en: The Buddhist anthology Jikji was printed with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa in Cheongju in 1377. A surviving second volume provides direct physical evidence for the technique in late Goryeo Korea. The text compiled teachings used in Buddhist learning, reminding us that printing technology developed within communities with particular educational and religious needs. Jikji is described as the oldest surviving dated evidence of this metal-type process; earlier Korean metal-type printing is known from references in other books. That distinction matters. It should not be treated as the invention of all printing, or as proof of an undocumented line of transmission to Gutenberg’s later European workshop.
before.zh: 1377年，佛教选集《直指》在清州兴德寺以金属活字印刷。现存下卷为高丽晚期使用该技术提供了直接实物证据。书中汇集用于佛教学习的教诲，提醒我们印刷技术是在具有具体教育与宗教需求的社群中发展的。《直指》被视为现存最早有日期的金属活字印刷证据，而更早的高丽金属活字活动见于其他文献记载。这一区别十分重要：它并不等于所有印刷术的发明，也不能证明存在一条通往古腾堡欧洲作坊而尚无文献支持的传播路线。

after.en: In July 1377 monks at Heungdeoksa, a Buddhist temple outside Cheongju in late Goryeo Korea, cast bronze characters and printed *Baegun Hwasang Chorok Buljo Jikji Simche Yojeol* (*Jikji*), a Zen anthology compiled by the monk Baegun for students of meditation. Sponsored by the nun Myodeok, its surviving second volume is the oldest extant dated book printed with movable metal type—confirming a Korean metal-foundry tradition already mentioned in thirteenth-century Goryeo texts and developed independently of Johannes Gutenberg’s fifteenth-century Mainz press.
after.zh: 1377年7月，高丽晚期清州城外兴德寺的僧侣铸造金属活字，由比丘尼妙德施资印成白云和尚编纂的禅宗选集《白云和尚抄录佛祖直指心体要节》（简称《直指》）。现存下卷是世界上已知最早署有确切年份的金属活字印本实物，印证了十三世纪高丽文献已载的铸字传统，且独立于十五世纪古腾堡在美因茨创制的欧洲活字工坊。

items.rationale: Replace defensive "reminds us / should not be treated as" language with concrete 1377 Heungdeoksa production facts.

before.en: Under Justinian, imperial officials assembled and reorganized Roman legal material into the compilation later known as the Corpus Juris Civilis. The work connected lawmaking with the emperor’s wider effort to strengthen government, taxation and authority. It was an intellectual and administrative project as well as an assertion of power: inherited texts had to be selected and arranged for use. Its later history was equally important, as medieval scholars studied, interpreted and taught the material. The compilation therefore links the ancient Roman legal world with later legal learning. Its promulgation should not be mistaken for proof that one identical legal practice immediately operated everywhere in the empire.
before.zh: 查士丁尼统治下，帝国官员汇集并重新组织罗马法律材料，形成后来被称为《民法大全》的编纂成果。这项工作把立法与加强政府、税制和皇权的更广泛努力联系起来。它既是权力宣示，也是知识与行政工程：既有文本必须经过选择和整理，才能用于实践。其后续历史同样重要，中世纪学者对这些材料进行研究、解释和教学。因此，法律编纂把古罗马法律世界与后来的法学教育连接起来。但颁布法律不能被视为帝国各地立即实行完全相同法律实践的证明。

after.en: Between 529 and 534 Emperor Justinian I charged jurist Tribonian and small commissions in Constantinople with sifting centuries of imperial edicts and classical Roman jurists’ opinions into the *Codex*, *Digest* and *Institutes*—later known together with his subsequent *Novels* as the *Corpus Juris Civilis*. Intended to streamline courtroom citation and tighten fiscal and religious administration across the Eastern Roman Empire, the Latin compilation coexisted with Greek and provincial custom in practice before igniting university legal study in medieval Italy five centuries later.
after.zh: 529至534年间，东罗马皇帝查士丁尼一世命法学家特里波尼安率编纂委员会在君士坦丁堡删繁就简，将数百年帝国敕令与古典法学家学说汇编为《法典》《学说汇纂》与《法学阶梯》，连同其后颁行的《新律》合称《民法大全》。这部旨在统一法庭援引、强化财税与宗教治理的拉丁文法典，在帝国境内与希腊语敕令及行省习惯法并行运作，五百年后更成为中世纪意大利大学法学复兴的基石。

items.rationale: Replace abstract commentary ("should not be mistaken for proof...") with Tribonian, components, and provincial reality.

before.en:
Wu Zetian founded her own Zhou dynasty after exercising power during the reigns of Tang emperors. Her reign as emperor from 690 to 705 interrupts the usual Tang 618–907 bar. A readable dynasty timeline can preserve Tang as a broader historical frame while making this change of ruling house visible.

The episode also connects political authority with textual memory. The Chinese University of Hong Kong notes that her collected works no longer survive as a complete collection, while poems and essays remain in later Tang anthologies. That distinction matters: the survival of later compilations is different from possessing an author’s original collection. This entry follows the dynasty and its evidence, not a reconstructed travel itinerary or a claim that every frontier changed in 690.
before.zh:
武则天在唐帝在位期间掌握权力，继而建立自己的周朝。690—705年的称帝时段，构成通常“唐618—907年”这一长条中的统治家族变化。可读的朝代时间线应保留唐的大历史框架，同时让武周的中断可见。

这一事件也涉及政治权威与文本保存。香港中文大学资料指出，她的作品集《垂拱集》已佚，部分诗文仍保存在后来的唐代总集中。“后世汇编仍存”与“拥有作者原集”是不同的证据状态。本条关注王朝和史料，不重建个人旅行路线，也不主张690年所有边界随之改变。

after.en: After governing behind the throne under Tang Gaozong and two sons, Wu Zetian proclaimed her own Zhou dynasty at Luoyang in 690—ruling in her own right as female *huangdi* (emperor) until palace conspirators forced her abdication in 705 and restored the Li house of Tang. She expanded civil-service examinations to recruit officials outside entrenched northwestern aristocracies and sponsored Buddhist statecraft. Although her vast literary collection (*Chuigong ji*) later disappeared as a separate work, surviving poems and edicts in Tang anthologies preserve her political voice.
after.zh: 在唐高宗及两子在位期间长期执掌朝政后，武则天于690年在洛阳改唐建周，以女性身份正式称“皇帝”亲政，直至705年宫廷政变迫使其退位、李唐复辟。她在位期间大力扩充科举取士以制衡关陇门阀，并借佛教营造天命正统；其个人文集《垂拱集》原编虽已散佚，存世唐代总集收录的诏敕与诗文仍留存其执政手笔。

items.rationale: Cut timeline-bar and entry-scope meta-talk ("interrupts the usual Tang bar", "This entry follows...").

before.en:
Qarakhanid rulers connected the Tarim Basin and Transoxiana within a Turkic Muslim political world. Their origins and internal history are difficult to reconstruct because few narrative works written within the dynasty survive. Coins, inscriptions and outside accounts therefore carry unusual importance.

In 999 they took Bukhara as the Samanid dominions were divided with the Ghaznavids. Later eastern and western branches had different political histories, including subordination to stronger neighbors. This entry treats them as a related dynastic sequence, not one centralized kingdom whose borders remained the same throughout.
before.zh:
喀喇汗统治者把塔里木盆地与河中地区连接在一个突厥穆斯林政治世界中。由于王朝内部撰写的叙事著作少有存世，其起源和内部历史难以完整重建。钱币、铭文和外部记载因此尤其重要。

999年，他们取得布哈拉，并与伽色尼瓜分萨曼领地。此后东西支系经历不同政治进程，包括臣属于更强邻国。本条目将其视为有关联的王朝序列，而不是疆界始终相同的单一中央集权国家。

after.en: Emerging from Karluk and allied Turkic confederations across the Tian Shan and Tarim Basin, Qarakhanid rulers embraced Islam in the tenth century and in 999 marched into Bukhara, partitioning Samanid Transoxiana with the Ghaznavids. Because few court chronicles written inside the realm survive, silver and copper coins, brick minarets and Arabic–Turkic works such as Yusuf Khass Hajib’s *Kutadgu Bilig* and Mahmud al-Kashgari’s dictionary anchor our view of a dynasty soon split into autonomous eastern and western khanates.
after.zh: 兴起于天山与塔里木盆地葛逻禄等突厥部族联盟的喀喇汗统治者，于十世纪改奉伊斯兰教，并于999年攻入布哈拉，与伽色尼王朝瓜分萨曼王朝河中故地。由于王朝内部编年史少有传世，钱币铭文、砖砌宣礼塔以及优素福·哈斯·哈吉甫《福乐智慧》与麻赫穆德·喀什噶里辞书成为核心见证；王族后亦分立为各自演进的东西两支汗国。

items.rationale: Replace "This entry treats them as..." with concrete Qarakhanid coins, monuments, and split khanates.

before.en:
After the Mongol conquests, the dynasty descended from Jochi ruled the western steppe and exercised power over neighboring principalities. The Golden Horde was one of several Mongol successor states, alongside the Chagatai realm, the Ilkhanids and the Yuan. They shared ancestry without functioning as a single unchanging administration.

Its cities and courts participated in commerce, diplomacy and artistic exchange across Eurasia. Political fragmentation produced successor khanates over time, so the final date of the Great Horde should not be read as the disappearance of every related state. Comparison with the Ilkhanids reveals both connections and rivalry within the post-conquest world.
before.zh:
蒙古征服之后，术赤后裔统治西部草原，并对邻近公国行使权力。金帐汗国与察合台、伊儿汗、元朝同属蒙古继承国家。共同祖源并不意味着它们始终属于一个不变的行政体系。

其城市与宫廷参与横跨欧亚的贸易、外交和艺术交流。政治分裂逐渐产生继承汗国，因此大帐末期的终点不能被理解为所有相关国家同时消失。与伊儿汗国比较，可以看见征服后世界内部的联系与竞争。

after.en: Founded on the western Kipchak steppe by Batu and the house of Jochi after the Mongol campaigns of 1236–1242, the Ulus of Jochi (later called the Golden Horde) collected tribute from Rus’ principalities while building riverine capitals along the lower Volga at Sarai. Italian Black Sea galleys, Khwarazmian caravans and Mamluk envoys converged on its Islamized courts to trade furs, grain, horses and captives—and to coordinate war against rival Ilkhanid cousins in Iran. Fifteenth-century succession struggles fractured its steppe power into the Crimea, Kazan, Astrakhan and Kazakh khanates long before the Great Horde’s collapse in 1502.
after.zh: 1236—1242年蒙古西征后，拔都等术赤后裔在钦察草原建立术赤兀鲁思（后世习称金帐汗国），向罗斯诸公国征取贡赋，并在伏尔加河下游营建萨莱等商贸都城。热那亚与威尼斯黑海商船、花剌子模驼队及埃及马穆鲁克使节汇聚于渐次伊斯兰化的汗廷，交易毛皮、谷物、马匹与人口，并结盟牵制南方的伊儿汗国宗亲。十五世纪汗位纷争使其先后析出克里米亚、喀山、阿斯特拉罕等继承汗国，延续至1502年大帐汗国覆亡之后。

items.rationale: Remove "should not be read as..." and specify Sarai, Volga trade, Mamluk-Ilkhanid rivalry and successor khanates.

before.en:
Merovingian kings ruled Frankish kingdoms that emerged from the former Roman province of Gaul. Political change did not remove Roman practices overnight: administration, Latin learning and artistic techniques continued in changing forms. Royal conversion and aristocratic patronage strengthened Christian institutions.

Monasteries and churches became centers of learning, wealth and authority. The networks built in this period later supported Carolingian government. Divisions among rulers mean that a single dynastic bar should not be mistaken for one continuously united territory. This entry supplies the political context behind the later story of Charlemagne.
before.zh:
墨洛温诸王统治从罗马高卢演变而来的法兰克王国。政治更替并未一夜抹去罗马实践：行政、拉丁学问和艺术技法以变化的形式继续存在。王室改宗与贵族资助增强了基督教机构。

修道院和教堂成为知识、财富与权威中心。这一时期形成的网络后来支撑加洛林治理。由于统治者之间反复分割，单一王朝时间条不能被误读为疆域始终统一。本条目为后来的查理曼历史补上政治背景。

after.en: As imperial control faded in fifth-century Gaul, Merovingian Frankish kings led by Clovis forged successor realms that adapted late Roman tax registers, Latin charters and urban bishoprics rather than sweeping Roman administration away. Because Frankish royal inheritance divided kingdoms among surviving sons—splitting Neustria, Austrasia and Burgundy before periodic reunifications—power increasingly flowed through aristocratic mayors of the palace and wealthy rural monasteries that laid the institutional groundwork for Carolingian rule.
after.zh: 五世纪罗马帝国在高卢的统治瓦解后，克洛维等墨洛温家族法兰克诸王建立新政权，沿用并改造晚期罗马的税册、拉丁文特许状与城市主教辖区。由于法兰克王室惯将国土分封诸子，纽斯特里亚、奥斯特拉西亚与勃艮第屡经分合，实权渐向贵族出身的宫相及坐拥田产书卷的修道院集中，为日后加洛林王朝的兴起奠定基础。

items.rationale: Cut "single dynastic bar" and "This entry supplies..." meta-talk; explain partible inheritance and palace mayors directly.

before.en:
The state conventionally called Tarascan, also associated with Purépecha peoples, developed in western Mexico. Tzintzuntzan became its major capital. It was a contemporary of the Mexica Triple Alliance, not a province of that empire.

Research on ceramics, metallurgy and production examines how political authority coordinated regional resources without assuming that every workshop was directly managed by the court. This provides a comparison with Andean and central Mexican states. Spanish conquest changed its political institutions, while Purépecha communities and languages continued. The end of the state is therefore not an endpoint for the people.
before.zh:
通常称为塔拉斯坎、并与普雷佩查民族相关的国家，在墨西哥西部发展。钦聪灿成为重要首都。它与墨西加三方同盟同时存在，而不是那个帝国的一个省。

关于陶器、冶金和生产的研究，考察政治权威如何协调区域资源，同时不假定所有工坊都由王室直接管理。这为比较安第斯和墨西哥中部国家提供材料。西班牙征服改变了政治机构，但普雷佩查社区和语言继续存在。因此国家终结不是人民历史的终点。

after.en: Centered on Lake Pátzcuaro and its terraced ceremonial capital of Tzintzuntzan (*yácatas*) in Michoacán, the Purépecha (Tarascan) state stood as western Mesoamerica’s fiercest independent rival to the Mexica Triple Alliance, repeatedly defeating Aztec armies with copper-bronze weaponry along fortified frontier garrisons. While court tribute officials mobilized obsidian, lake fish, feathers and smelted metal, village potters and smiths maintained distinct local workshops—and Purépecha communities and language endured long after Spanish forces executed the last *irecha* Tangáxuan II in 1530.
after.zh: 以米却肯帕茨夸罗湖及拥有扇形石筑祭台（yácatas）的都城钦聪灿为中心，普雷佩查（塔拉斯坎）国家是中美洲西部唯一长期抗衡墨西加三方同盟的独立强权，曾凭青铜兵器与边境要塞屡次击退阿兹特克大军。王廷贡赋官统筹黑曜石、湖产、羽饰与冶金，各地村落陶工与铜匠亦保持地方工坊传统；1530年西班牙殖民者处决末代君主唐加苏安二世后，普雷佩查社群与语言依然世代延续。

items.rationale: Replace abstract comparative meta-notes with Lake Pátzcuaro, bronze weapons, and Purépecha continuity.

before.en:
The Nyiginya kingdom developed through changing relations between the royal court, local authorities and communities engaged in farming and cattle keeping. Its authority expanded unevenly; the borders of the present republic should not be projected backward as the territory of an unchanged early kingdom. Oral traditions preserve political memories but were also shaped by later disputes over legitimacy and rank.

A critical history separates these changing relationships from the colonial claim that Hutu and Tutsi were fixed racial populations. German and then Belgian rule transformed institutions and hardened classifications, rather than merely recording an unchanging society. Studying court expansion alongside land, cattle and local resistance helps explain why later national accounts disagree about the precolonial past. This entry ends at the beginning of the German colonial phase and does not collapse the kingdom, colonial state and modern republic into one continuous political system.
before.zh:
尼吉尼亚王国在王廷、地方权威以及从事农业和畜养的社区之间不断变化的关系中发展。其权力扩展并不均匀，不能把今天共和国的边界倒投为古代王国始终不变的疆域。口述传统保存政治记忆，也受到后来有关合法性和等级的争论影响。

批判性的历史研究需要把这些关系，同殖民者将胡图和图西视作固定种族的主张区分开来。德国及随后的比利时统治改变了制度并强化分类，而非只是记录不变的社会。把宫廷扩张与土地、牛群及地方抵抗一起研究，有助理解后来的民族历史为何对前殖民时期意见不一。本条止于德国殖民阶段的开始，不把王国、殖民国家与现代共和国混为同一制度。

after.en: Expanding outward from central highland pastures from the seventeenth century onward, the Nyiginya royal court (*mwami*) built uneven authority across hills where farming and cattle-keeping lineages retained varied autonomy and fought back against tribute demands. Court ritualists transmitted dynastic poetry and esoteric codes shaped by rivalries at court, long before German (from 1897) and Belgian colonial administrations froze fluid social ranks of Hutu, Tutsi and Twa into rigid racial identity cards and redrew territorial frontiers.
after.zh: 自十七世纪起从中部高地牧场向外扩展的尼吉尼亚王廷（姆瓦米），在农耕与畜牧宗族交错的丘陵间建立起深浅不一的统治，不少边缘地区长期保持自治并抵制贡赋。王廷礼官借王朝诗歌与仪轨传述受宫廷派系塑造的政治记忆；直至1897年德国及随后的比利时殖民当局介入，原本具有社会流动性的胡图、图西与特瓦身份才被强行固化为身份证上的种族分类。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry ends at..." and state the precolonial court vs colonial racial classification distinction directly.

before.en:
Burundi’s royal-drum tradition brings political history into a performance space. Drumming is combined with dance, poetry and song, while the organization of performers makes collective coordination visible. The term royal points to a historical relationship with kingship, but the practice cannot be reduced to a list of monarchs. Training, making and maintaining instruments, remembering repertories and organizing ceremonies are also forms of historical work.

UNESCO’s 2014 inscription documents the tradition as living heritage. It is a useful dated milestone for recognition and safeguarding, not evidence that the tradition began that year. Reading this entry alongside nearby kingdoms helps distinguish political institutions from practices that can survive institutional rupture. A performance also requires interpretation: its present form does not provide a verbatim record of a ceremony several centuries earlier. The selected window follows modern documentation rather than asserting a continuous, precisely dated royal ritual.
before.zh:
布隆迪王鼓传统把政治历史带入表演空间。鼓乐与舞蹈、诗歌和歌唱结合，演奏者的组织方式让集体配合得以呈现。“王鼓”这一名称指向它与历史王权的联系，但不能将传统简化为君主名单。训练、制作和维护乐器、记忆曲目以及筹办仪式，本身也是传承历史的劳动。

联合国教科文组织2014年的列入记录了这项活态遗产，是承认和保护的年代节点，并不意味着传统于该年产生。与邻近王国对读，可以区分政治机构和在制度断裂后仍可能延续的实践。表演也需要解释：今天的形态不是数百年前仪式的逐字记录。本条采用现代记录窗口，不主张精确编年、从未中断的王室仪式史。

after.en: Carved from hollowed *umuvugangoma* tree trunks andarranged around a central *inkiranya* drum, Burundi’s *karyenda* and *ingoma* ensembles once announced royal coronations, seasonal sowing festivals and court decrees through thunderous, athletic choreography combining percussion, dance and praise poetry. Sustained by hereditary sanctuary families who guarded drum groves and repertories even after the monarchy’s abolition in 1966, the living performance art gained UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage recognition in 2014 as an evolving communal practice.
after.zh: 由整段原木掏空蒙皮制成、围绕主鼓“因基拉尼亚”列阵的布隆迪王鼓乐队，昔日以融合击鼓、腾跃舞蹈与赞美诗的恢宏仪典宣告国王加冕、播种节令与朝廷政令。世代守护鼓林与曲谱的世袭家族在1966年君主制废除后仍延续这门技艺；2014年联合国教科文组织将其列入非物质文化遗产，见证这项在当代社区中不断演进的活态传统。

items.rationale: Remove "Reading this entry..." and "selected window" meta-talk; explain the drums, 1966 transition, and 2014 recognition directly.

before.en:
Kasubi joins architecture, cultivated land and political memory in one landscape. The palace constructed in 1882 was converted into a royal burial place in 1884. Its principal building used wood, reeds, thatch and barkcloth rather than monumental stone. These materials demanded continuing work, so the survival of the place depended on the skills of craftspeople and the care of its custodians.

The burial ground also became a spiritual center associated with the kabakas of Buganda. Royal tombs, ritual practices and surrounding agriculture cannot be separated into a simple opposition between a historic monument and ordinary life. The site remains meaningful to a living community. Its history helps explain why conserving a thatched building involves maintaining knowledge and social relationships as well as replacing physical fabric. This entry dates the palace-to-burial transition and does not claim that all structures or ceremonies remained unchanged afterward.
before.zh:
卡苏比把建筑、耕地与政治记忆结合在同一景观中。1882年建成的王宫于1884年改作王室墓地。主建筑采用木、芦苇、茅草和树皮布，而不是巨型石材。这些材料需要持续维护，因此场所的存续依靠工匠的知识及守护者的照料。

墓地也成为与布干达卡巴卡相关的精神中心。王陵、仪式与周边农业不能简单分为历史古迹和普通生活两个对立领域。对活着的社区而言，这里仍有意义。它的历史说明，保护茅草建筑不只需要更换物料，也需要维系知识与社会关系。本条日期标记王宫转为墓地的阶段，不宣称此后所有建筑或仪式始终不变。

after.en: Built in 1882 on Kasubi hill as the hilltop palace of Kabaka Muteesa I of Buganda, the circular vaulted hall *Muzibu Azaala Mpanga* became his royal mausoleum upon his death in 1884 and subsequently sheltered three succeeding kabakas. Woven from wooden columns, reed rings, barkcloth curtains and steep grass thatch surrounded by cultivated banana and barkcloth plots, the living sanctuary relies on clan guilds of builders, thatchers and royal widows whose inherited craft knowledge proved indispensable when reconstructing the dome after fire.
after.zh: 1882年布干达国王穆特萨一世在卡苏比山丘营建圆形穹顶王宫“穆齐布·阿扎拉·姆潘加”，1884年驾崩后即改作王陵，其后又安葬三代卡巴卡。这座由木柱、芦苇环、树皮布帷幔与厚重茅草顶构筑的建筑环绕在香蕉园与树皮布林地之间，世代仰赖各氏族营造匠人、铺草师与王室守护妇人维系修缮，使手艺传承与精神祭祀融为一体。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry dates..." and highlight Muteesa I, Muzibu Azaala Mpanga, and clan craft guilds.

before.en:
A lukasa is a memory board associated with Luba historical knowledge. Its signs are not a self-sufficient written text that any observer can decode. Trained specialists connect the object with oral performance and knowledge of people, places and political relationships. Meaning therefore depends on expertise, context and interpretation. This challenges the assumption that historical records exist only where alphabetic documents survive.

The Mbudye association maintained histories relevant to Luba rulers and communities. Objects and performance could organize memory while allowing historical precedent to be interpreted in changing circumstances. Museum examples provide material evidence, but removing a board from its setting can hide the social work that made it useful. Comparing this entry with court histories makes both visible: the institutions that claimed authority and the people who remembered, explained or contested their pasts. The dates are a nineteenth-century object-and-context focus, not an origin date for the tradition.
before.zh:
卢卡萨是与卢巴历史知识相关的记忆板。它的符号并非任何观察者都能自行解读的完整文字。受过训练的专家把物件同口头表演，以及人物、地点和政治关系的知识相连。意义依赖专门知识、场景和解释，因而挑战只有字母文书留存之处才存在历史记录的假设。

姆布迪耶协会保存与卢巴统治者及社区有关的历史。物件和表演可以组织记忆，也让历史先例在变化环境中重新获得解释。博物馆实例提供实物证据，但物件脱离原来环境，也可能遮蔽使它发挥作用的社会劳动。与宫廷史对读，可以同时看见声称权威的制度，以及记忆、解释或争论过去的人。本条日期是十九世纪物件及背景的研究窗口，不是传统起源日期。

after.en: Carved into an hourglass-shaped wooden tablet studded with coloured beads, cowrie shells and incised ridges, a Luba *lukasa* memory board worked not as fixed alphabetic script but as a tactile map read aloud by trained *Mbudye* historians in central Africa. Running fingers across bead clusters and shell lines, narrators recited royal genealogies, spirit capitals, migration paths and clan alliances—adapting political precedent to each audience long before nineteenth-century collectors separated surviving boards from the performances that gave them voice.
after.zh: 雕成束腰木板、缀满彩珠与货贝并刻有沟纹的卢巴“卢卡萨”记忆板，并非静态的字母书卷，而是中非“姆布迪耶”学会史官在吟诵时抚触讲演的立体图谱。诵史者指尖划过珠群与贝列，依现场听众铺陈王室谱系、灵都方位、迁徙路线与氏族盟约；十九世纪入藏欧美博物馆的实物虽存留物质形态，原本赋予其意义的口头展演与礼仪社群才是其灵魂所在。

items.rationale: Replace "Comparing this entry..." and "The dates are..." with how Mbudye specialists actually read a lukasa.

before.en:
Hausa-speaking cities and their surrounding communities formed a connected commercial world without constituting one uniform state. Kano, Katsina and other centers linked urban markets with rural production and wider routes. Political competition coexisted with the circulation of goods, religious learning and languages. Treating each city simply as a dot on an imperial route obscures the farming, craft work and household enterprise that supplied its markets.

Research on Hausa diasporas also follows enslavement and forced movement, reminding us that mobility was not always voluntary. Studies of less visible commerce draw attention to women and transactions beyond official market accounts. The nineteenth-century jihads changed the political order, but did not invent commerce or erase earlier local identities. This entry provides social and economic context for the separate Sokoto political overview; it does not assign all Hausa-speaking populations to a single pre 1804 territorial empire.
before.zh:
豪萨语城市及周围社区形成了相连的商业世界，却并不构成统一国家。卡诺、卡齐纳等中心把城市市场、乡村生产和更远的路线相连。政治竞争与物品、宗教学问和语言的流动同时存在。若只把每座城市当作帝国商路上的一个点，就会遮蔽支撑市场的农业、手工劳动和家庭经营。

豪萨离散研究也追踪奴役与强迫迁移，提醒我们流动并非总是自愿。关于较少被看见的商业的研究，则把妇女及官方市场记录之外的交易纳入视野。十九世纪的圣战改变了政治秩序，却没有发明商贸，也未抹去原来的地方认同。本条为另列的索科托政治概述提供社会经济背景，不把1804年前所有豪萨语人口归入一个疆域帝国。

after.en: Across the savanna of northern Nigeria and southern Niger, walled Hausa city-states—Kano, Katsina, Zaria, Gobir and their rivals—linked irrigated dye-pits, leather tanneries, iron furnaces and cotton weavers in surrounding villages to trans-Saharan and forest-zone caravans without uniting under a single monarch. Free artisans, rural women traders and enslaved labourers alike moved goods, Arabic scholarship and Hausa speech across competing courts well before Usman dan Fodio’s 1804 jihad reshaped the region into the Sokoto Caliphate.
after.zh: 在尼日利亚北部与尼日尔南部的萨瓦纳草原上，卡诺、卡齐纳、扎里亚、戈比尔等城墙环绕的豪萨城邦各自为政、彼此竞逐，同时将周边村落的蓝靛染坑、皮革作坊、冶铁炉与棉织户联入跨撒哈拉及南方森林商路。自由工匠、乡村女商贩乃至遭强迫迁徙的受奴役者在列国间传递货物、阿拉伯学问与豪萨语，构成1804年奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥圣战建立索科托哈里发国之前深厚的城市与商业基底。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry provides..." and name Kano, Katsina, dye-pits, leatherwork and pre-1804 autonomy directly.

before.en:
Trans-Saharan exchange connected communities on both sides of the desert through routes that depended on knowledge of water, seasons and local political conditions. Gold, salt and other goods moved through networks of producers, carriers and merchants. The prosperity of Sahelian courts was one result, but the story also includes the labour of supplying caravans and the power of communities controlling stages of a journey.

Religious learning, texts and artistic forms circulated with people and commerce. Enslavement and forced movement were also part of these networks and must remain visible beside accounts of wealth and cosmopolitanism. Ghana/Wagadu, Mali, Songhai and Kanem–Borno occupied different regions and periods; their participation does not make the entire Sahara one trading state. The map point marks a broad corridor for comparison, not a verified stop, a direct documented route or a permanent road across an otherwise empty desert.
before.zh:
跨撒哈拉交换通过依赖水源、季节与地方政治知识的路线，连接沙漠两侧社区。黄金、盐及其他物品经生产者、运输者与商人的网络流动。萨赫勒宫廷的繁荣是结果之一，故事也包括供应商队所需的劳动，以及控制途中节点的社区权力。

宗教学问、文本与艺术形式随人口和商业一起流传。奴役和强迫迁移同样属于这些网络，不能被财富与多元交流的叙述遮蔽。瓦加杜／加纳、马里、桑海及卡涅姆—博尔诺分属不同区域与时期；参与贸易不意味着整个撒哈拉是一国。本图点位标记用于比较的宽泛走廊，不是已核实停靠点、直接文献路线，或穿越“空旷”沙漠的永久道路。

after.en: Crossing the Sahara required oasis hydraulic skill, seasonal star-reckoning and negotiated passage with Amazigh and Toubou communities who controlled wells and salt pans such as Taghaza and Bilma. Northbound gold dust, kola nuts, ostrich feathers, leatherwork and enslaved captives met southbound rock salt, Maghrebi horses, copperware and paper reams that stocked libraries across Wagadu, Mali, Songhai and Kanem–Borno—linking shifting desert corridors rather than a single paved imperial highway.
after.zh: 穿越撒哈拉的商队仰赖绿洲水源知识、季节星象导航，以及同掌控塔加扎、比尔马等盐场与水井的阿马齐格及图布社群达成的通行协议。北运的金砂、可乐果、鸵鸟羽、皮革与被贩奴隶，同南下的岩盐、马格里布战马、铜器及大批纸张交汇，充实了瓦加杜、马里、桑海与卡涅姆—博尔诺诸国的府库与书院，织成随水草政局变迁的多线沙漠走廊。

items.rationale: Replace "The map point marks..." with concrete Sahara goods, oasis communities, and multi-polity networks.

before.en:
The Middle Kingdom followed the political fragmentation after the Old Kingdom and brought renewed royal authority into a changing institutional landscape. Kingship drew upon earlier models while rulers, officials and artists reworked how power was represented. Administrative careers and provincial relationships mattered alongside royal monuments, so reunification should not be read as the disappearance of local society.

Objects made for officials and families reveal forms of patronage extending beyond the royal household. Egyptian activity in Nubia, including fortresses near the Second Cataract, also connected administration to access to resources and military power. Reading this phase between the pyramid-building Old Kingdom and the later New Kingdom helps explain change without treating all pharaonic Egypt as one unvarying state. The chronological label is a scholarly period convention; the power exercised by particular dynasties and communities did not begin or end everywhere in the same year.
before.zh:
中王国承接古王国之后的政治分化，在变化的制度环境中重建王权。君主借用早期模式，统治者、官员和艺术家也重新塑造权力的表现。行政仕途及地方关系与王室古迹同样重要，因此重新统一不应理解为地方社会的消失。

为官员和家庭制作的物件，显示王室之外的资助形式。埃及在努比亚的活动，包括第二瀑布附近堡垒，也把行政同资源获取及军事力量连接起来。将这一阶段放在金字塔时代的古王国与后来的新王国之间，可以解释变化，而不是把法老埃及视作始终不变的国家。编年名称是学术分期惯例；特定王朝及社区的权力并未在各地同年开始或结束。

after.en: Reuniting Upper and Lower Egypt around 2030 BCE under Mentuhotep II of Thebes after generations of provincial rivalry, Middle Kingdom pharaohs of the Eleventh and Twelfth Dynasties governed alongside powerful regional nomarchs, salaried scribes and newly assertive middle-ranking officials whose stelae crowded Abydos. Twelfth-Dynasty rulers shifted their administrative residence north to Itjtawy near the Faiyum, reclaimed marshland for grain, pushed mudbrick fortresses past the Second Cataract into Nubia for gold access, and patronized classical Egyptian narrative literature.
after.zh: 约公元前2030年底比斯君主门图霍特普二世重新统一上下埃及后，第十一与第十二王朝法老在治理中既重塑王权，也与实力雄厚的地方州长、职业书吏及在阿拜多斯纷纷立碑的中层官员共处。第十二王朝将行政中心北迁至法尤姆附近的伊特塔威，开垦湖沼农田，并在努比亚第二瀑布一带筑起巨型泥砖要塞以控制黄金通道，同时催生了古典埃及文学的繁荣。

items.rationale: Remove "Reading this phase..." and "scholarly period convention" boilerplate; add Mentuhotep II, Itjtawy, Abydos and Nubian forts.

before.en:
Harar’s historic town shows how an urban Muslim society developed in the eastern Horn of Africa. Walls, mosques, shrines and domestic buildings organize a landscape of religious practice and everyday work. Connections with African and Islamic traditions shaped the city, while later Indian-influenced houses added further layers. These overlapping forms resist a picture in which cultural influence only traveled in one direction.

The interior organization of houses matters as much as their exterior facades: domestic space preserves choices about social relationships and use.
