Reading Harar alongside highland royal and monastic centers places neighboring histories in conversation without making them identical. The focus ends with the nineteenth-century political transition under Ethiopian expansion, but the town’s life continued. Its buildings should be used as evidence of changing urban practices, not as a complete reconstruction of an unchanged medieval city or a boundary polygon for a kingdom.
before.zh:
哈勒尔古城展示了非洲之角东部穆斯林城市社会的发展。城墙、清真寺、圣祠与住宅组织起宗教实践和日常劳动的景观。非洲及伊斯兰传统塑造城市，后来受印度影响的住宅又增添新层次。这些重叠形式反对文化影响只能单向传播的图景。

住宅内部组织与外立面同样重要：家庭空间保存对社会关系和使用方式的选择。与高地王室及修道院中心并读，可以让邻近历史彼此对话，而不把它们视为相同。本条关注期止于十九世纪埃塞俄比亚扩张下的政治转折，但城市生活仍继续。建筑应作为城市实践变化的证据，而非一座不变中世纪城市的完整复原，更不是王国的疆界多边形。

after.en: Enclosed within its sixteenth-century *Jugol* stone wall pierced by five gates, the eastern Ethiopian plateau town of Harar (*Gey*) wove over eighty mosques and neighborhood saint shrines into dense alleyways linking highland coffee, grain and khat growers with Red Sea and Gulf of Aden ports at Zeila and Berbera. Inside whitewashed courtyards, traditional *gegar* houses—later joined by veranda-fronted merchants’ homes built by Indian craftsmen—hung woven baskets and manuscript niches to organize family rank, hospitality and Quranic study across centuries, continuing vibrant urban life after Egypt’s brief occupation and Menelik II’s conquest in 1887.
after.zh: 环绕在十六世纪筑成、辟有五门的“朱戈尔”石砌城墙之内，埃塞俄比亚东部高原古城哈勒尔将八十余座清真寺与街坊圣祠嵌入曲折巷弄，把高地咖啡、谷物产区同红海及亚丁湾的泽拉、柏培拉商港紧密相连。白墙庭院内的传统民居（后又融入印度工匠营建的木廊商宅）以彩编挂篮与经卷壁龛排布家户礼序与古兰经诵习；历经1887年孟尼利克二世并入埃塞俄比亚的政治剧变后，这座高地穆斯林古城的日常烟火依然延续。

items.rationale: Cut "The focus ends with..." and "boundary polygon" meta-prose; foreground Jugol walls, gegar interiors and Zeila trade.

before.en:
Songo Mnara helps shift the history of the Swahili coast from ports as trade symbols to towns where people lived. Mosques, domestic buildings and open spaces were built with coral stone, wood and lime. Their arrangement makes it possible to investigate households and public life alongside the long-distance exchanges better known from nearby Kilwa.

Participation in Indian Ocean commerce did not make coastal communities mere extensions of Arabia, India or China. Local social organization and African connections remained central to how towns developed. At the same time, imported goods and architectural evidence help situate the coast within wider networks. This entry links a bounded archaeological phase to those connections without turning the existence of two ports into proof of a direct voyage between them. Ruins are also uneven evidence: surviving stone structures should not be assumed to represent every building or every resident of a settlement.
before.zh:
松戈姆纳拉让斯瓦希里海岸史从象征商贸的港口转向人们实际生活的城镇。清真寺、住宅及开放空间采用珊瑚石、木材和石灰建造。其布局使研究者可以在邻近基尔瓦较为人熟知的远程交换之外，考察家庭与公共生活。

参与印度洋商贸，并不使海岸社区仅成为阿拉伯、印度或中国的延伸。地方社会组织和非洲内部联系，仍是城镇发展的核心。同时，舶来物与建筑证据也将海岸置于更广网络。本条把有范围的考古阶段同这些联系相接，不把两个港口的存在误当作直接航行的证明。遗址证据也不均衡：留存石建筑不能被假定代表聚落所有建筑或居民。

after.en: Built of coral rag and mangrove timber on an island just south of Kilwa Kisiwani and occupied intensively across the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, Songo Mnara preserves six mosques, walled cemeteries, an open central green and more than forty multi-roomed houses where families spun cotton, smelted iron, hosted guests and displayed imported Chinese celadon and glazed Persian bowls in plaster wall niches. Alongside stone mansions stood earth-and-thatch dwellings detected through soil chemistry and postholes, revealing a Swahili town rooted in East African household life as much as Indian Ocean shipping.
after.zh: 坐落于基尔瓦岛南邻小岛、集中繁荣于十四至十五世纪的松戈姆纳拉，保留了由珊瑚石与红树林木料筑成的六座清真寺、墓园、中央草坪及四十余座多居室石宅；居民在屋内纺棉、冶铁、款待宾客，并将中国青瓷与波斯釉陶陈列于灰泥壁龛之中。土壤化学分析与柱洞遗迹还揭示出石屋之间分布着木骨泥墙茅顶民居，展现出既植根东非本土家户结构、又联通季风海贸的斯瓦希里城镇面貌。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry links..." and add archaeological household details (coral rag, wall niches, earth-and-thatch houses).

before.en:
Khami helps explain what followed the political prominence of Great Zimbabwe. Stone-built terraces and other surviving remains belong to a later regional center rather than to the disappearance of complex society in southern Africa. Archaeological layers and evidence of exchange make it possible to ask how authority, settlement and commercial relationships changed across the transition.

The site’s significance also depends on what survives undisturbed. Stratigraphy can establish sequences that a striking wall alone cannot reveal, while the pattern of buildings can connect political rank to the organization of space. Reading Khami with Mapungubwe and Great Zimbabwe creates a succession of regional histories without assuming that every community belonged to the same dynasty. The dates mark a broad phase of prominence. They do not identify the lifespan of every structure, establish a precise frontier or imply that stone construction was the only form of architecture in the region.
before.zh:
卡米有助解释大津巴布韦政治兴盛之后的发展。石砌台地及其他遗存属于较晚的区域中心，并不代表南部非洲复杂社会的消失。考古地层与交换证据，使研究者能够追问这一转折中权威、聚落及商业关系如何变化。

遗址意义也取决于哪些部分未经扰动地保存下来。地层可以建立一面醒目石墙本身无法揭示的序列，建筑分布则将政治等级同空间组织相连。把卡米与马蓬古布韦、大津巴布韦并读，能形成区域历史的连续讨论，而不假设所有社区属于同一王朝。日期标记宽泛的兴盛阶段，不确定每座建筑的寿命，也不确立精确疆界，更不意味着石建筑是当地唯一建筑形式。

after.en: Rising along the Khami River in western Zimbabwe as the capital of the Torwa dynasty during the fifteenth to seventeenth centuries, Khami succeeded Great Zimbabwe without abandoning dry-stone monumentality—adapting it instead to steep granite hillsides through tiered retaining walls patterned in chevron and chequered courses that supported elite earthen house platforms (*dhaka*). Excavated Ming blue-and-white porcelain, Portuguese silverware, copper cross ingots and local ivory carvings trace wide regional tribute and Indian Ocean trade across communities living mostly in surrounding timber-and-dhaka homesteads.
after.zh: 十五至十七世纪在津巴布韦西部卡米河畔兴起的托尔瓦王朝都城卡米，承接大津巴布韦衰落后的高原政局，顺应花岗岩山坡筑起饰有折线与棋盘格纹的层叠干砌石挡墙，托起王公居住的红土夯筑房台（dhaka）。地层出土的明代青花瓷、葡萄牙银器、十字铜锭与本地象牙雕件，印证了这座石台王城及周边广大木土村落同印度洋商路的深远联系。

items.rationale: Cut "Reading Khami with..." and "They do not identify..." meta-lines; name the Torwa dynasty, dhaka platforms and trade finds.

before.en:
The General Peace Agreement signed in Rome on 4 October 1992 established a framework for ending the war between Mozambique’s government and RENAMO. The agreement addressed a ceasefire, military arrangements, political parties, elections and implementation guarantees. Peace was therefore a sequence of institutional and social tasks, not only a ceremony or the signature of two leaders.

The United Nations operation ONUMOZ supported implementation and monitoring as the country moved toward elections in 1994. Communities also faced the work of returning, rebuilding livelihoods and accommodating people whose wartime experiences differed. A signed agreement did not erase loss or guarantee that future disputes would remain peaceful. Reading the protocols beside later implementation helps distinguish a negotiated commitment from its practical results. The map point marks Mozambique’s national political setting; Rome was the signing venue, and the human consequences of the war extended across the country.
before.zh:
1992年10月4日在罗马签署的《和平总协定》，为结束莫桑比克政府与抵运之间的战争建立框架。协定涉及停火、军事安排、政党、选举及执行保证。因此，和平是一连串制度与社会任务，不只是仪式或两位领袖签字。

联合国莫桑比克行动支持执行和监督，国家随后走向1994年选举。社区也面临返乡、重建生计，以及接纳战争经历不同人群的工作。签署协定没有抹去损失，也不保证未来争议都能和平处理。把协议条款与后续实施并读，有助区分谈判承诺及实际结果。点位标记国家政治背景，会签地点则是罗马；战争的人道后果遍及全国。

after.en: Signed in Rome on 4 October 1992 after two years of mediation hosted by the Community of Sant’Egidio, Mozambique’s General Peace Agreement ended a sixteen-year civil war between the FRELIMO government and RENAMO insurgents. Backed by United Nations ONUMOZ peacekeepers, the protocols organized troop demobilization, a unified army, multiparty registration ahead of 1994 elections, and the return of millions of displaced villagers to mined roads and shattered rural clinics—turning a diplomatic text in Italy into years of contested local reconstruction across Mozambique.
after.zh: 经圣艾智德团体两年斡旋，莫桑比克政府（解阵）与全国抵抗运动（抵运）于1992年10月4日在罗马签署《和平总协定》，结束长达十六年的内战。在联合国莫桑比克行动（ONUMOZ）监督下，协议推进武装复员、组建统一国防军、筹备1994年多党大选，并协助数百万流离失所的村民重返遍布地雷与残破诊所的乡土，使一纸罗马盟约化作漫长而艰难的社会重建。

items.rationale: Replace "The map point marks..." with Sant’Egidio mediation, FRELIMO/RENAMO demobilization, and rural return.

before.en:
In 1994, genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda destroyed families and communities through organized persecution and mass killing. Hutu people who opposed the perpetrators were also killed. The violence cannot be explained as an inevitable eruption of ancient ethnic hatred: colonial classification, political exclusion, civil war, propaganda and deliberate choices formed part of its historical setting.

The international response exposed failures of protection, including the limits of the United Nations mission. Reconstructing events requires testimony and documentary evidence while keeping distinct the genocide, the surrounding civil war and other atrocities. Survivors’ experiences of loss, displacement and rebuilding extend beyond the calendar year shown here. Linking this entry to the earlier kingdom helps investigate changing institutions and identities without treating precolonial social categories as a direct or sufficient cause of genocide. The concise account avoids a single exact death toll and does not reduce people’s lives to the statistics of violence.
before.zh:
1994年，卢旺达针对图西人的种族灭绝，通过有组织的迫害和大规模杀戮摧毁家庭与社区。反对施害者的胡图人也遭杀害。暴力不能被解释为远古族群仇恨必然爆发：殖民分类、政治排斥、内战、宣传与蓄意选择，共同构成历史环境。

国际反应暴露保护失败，包括联合国任务的局限。重建事件需要证言和文献，同时区分种族灭绝、周边内战及其他暴行。幸存者的丧失、流离失所与重建经历超出这里显示的单一年份。将本条与早期王国相连，可以考察制度和身份的变化，而不把前殖民社会类别当作种族灭绝的直接或充分原因。简要叙述不采用单一精确死亡数字，也不把人的生活缩减为暴力统计。

after.en: Over roughly one hundred days beginning in April 1994, extremist leaders within Rwanda’s interim government, army and *Interahamwe* militias carried out a systematic genocide against the Tutsi population while also murdering Hutu politicians, journalists and neighbours who refused to participate or sheltered the hunted. Far from an eruption of timeless tribal hatred, the slaughter mobilized colonial-era racialized identity cards, state radio propaganda (*RTLM*), civil-war fear and local administrative lists as United Nations peacekeeping forces were drawn down—leaving survivors to confront mass bereavement, refugee flight and decades of community justice and recovery.
after.zh: 自1994年4月起的约百日内，卢旺达临时政府极端势力、军方与“联攻派”民兵有组织地对图西人实施种族灭绝，同时杀害拒绝同流合污或冒险藏匿受难者的胡图族政界人士、记者与邻里。这场浩劫并非所谓远古部族仇恨的自然爆发，而是动用了殖民时期固化的族群身份证、千丘自由广播电台仇恨煽动、内战恐慌与基层户籍名册，且恰逢联合国维和兵力缩减；浩劫过后，幸存者仍须面对漫长的亲人追思、难民危机与社区司法重建。

items.rationale: Remove "Linking this entry..." and "The concise account avoids..." meta-talk; name Interahamwe, ID cards, RTLM, and survivors.

before.en:
Wall paintings inside Goguryeo tombs depict selected activities, figures and beliefs within a funerary setting. They offer evidence about dress, ritual and the environments that patrons wished to recreate for the dead. Tomb architecture and painted surfaces worked together; the burial was a constructed social world rather than an unfiltered picture of daily life.

Only a portion of known tombs preserves murals, and preservation and earlier disturbance shape what survives. Elite patrons are disproportionately visible. Comparing images with architecture can therefore reveal historical choices without assuming that every household shared the same resources or beliefs. The tombs also connect sites on both sides of present borders, while each cemetery retains its own archaeological context.
before.zh:
高句丽墓室壁画在丧葬环境中描绘特定活动、人物与信仰。它们提供衣着、仪式以及施主希望为死者重建何种生活环境的线索。墓室建筑与绘画共同发挥作用；陵墓是经过构造的社会世界，而非日常生活的未经筛选的照片。

已知墓葬中只有部分保存壁画，保护状况和早期扰动影响了今天可见的内容，精英施主也更容易留下形象。因此，将图像同建筑相互比较，可以识别历史选择，而不假设每个家庭拥有相同的资源与信仰。这些墓葬跨越现代国界，但各墓园仍有独立的考古语境。

after.en: Inside stone-chambered earthen mounds scattered around Ji’an on the Yalu River and Pyongyang on the Taedong, fourth-to-seventh-century Goguryeo painters covered plastered walls and corbelled ceilings with mounted archers hunting deer, wrestlers, kitchen servants, lotus blossoms, constellations and the Four Directional Deities. Commissioned for royal and aristocratic burials across territories now split by modern borders, these vivid funerary chambers staged an idealized elite household and cosmic protection for the dead rather than a census of ordinary village life.
after.zh: 在鸭绿江畔集安与大同江流域平壤一带的四至七世纪高句丽封土石室墓中，画工在抹灰墓壁与抹角叠涩藻井上绘出骑射逐鹿、角抵百戏、庖厨备宴、莲花星象与四神图景。这些跨越今日国界分布的王室与贵族墓葬，在地下构建起护佑亡灵的理想化门阀生活与宇宙秩序。

items.rationale: Tighten funerary-world insight and remove repetitive preservation disclaimers.

before.en:
Ryukyuan political centers developed within island networks linking different parts of East and Southeast Asia. Castles known as gusuku, royal monuments and sacred places show that government and religious authority occupied connected but distinct spaces. The surviving heritage is not adequately explained by treating Okinawa as a marginal extension of another court.

Maritime exchange connected local institutions with wider diplomatic and commercial worlds. Imported objects and architectural choices could be adapted to island needs, while sacred landscapes preserved particular traditions. The focus here is the late-medieval and early-modern court world represented by the sites, not the entire history of Ryukyuan people. Later political incorporation and wartime destruction changed the landscape; modern restoration must be distinguished from surviving original material.
before.zh:
琉球政治中心在连接东亚与东南亚不同地区的岛屿网络中发展。称为“城”的堡垒、王室纪念物与祭祀场所，显示政府和宗教权威占据相互联系却有区别的空间。不能只把冲绳视为另一宫廷的边缘延伸来解释这些遗产。

海上交换把本地制度同更广泛的外交、商业世界相连。外来器物与建筑选择可以适应岛屿需求，而神圣景观又保存独特传统。本条关注遗址所呈现的中世纪晚期与近世宫廷世界，并非琉球人的全部历史。后来的政治纳入及战争破坏改变了景观，现代修复材料也须与原存部分区分。

after.en: From hilltop coral-limestone fortresses (*gusuku*) culminating in Shuri Castle on Okinawa, the unified Ryukyu Kingdom (from 1429) turned its island chain into an entrepôt linking Ming and Qing tribute ports with Japan, Korea, Siam, Melaka and Java. Court officials conducted diplomacy in literary Chinese while priestesses led by the royal *kikoe-ōgimi* tended forested *utaki* shrines—sustaining an autonomous island monarchy that weathered Satsuma’s 1609 invasion until Meiji annexation in 1879 and devastating wartime destruction in 1945.
after.zh: 依托冲绳岛首里城及各处珊瑚石灰岩山城（御城），1429年统一后的琉球王国将弧形群岛经营为连接明清朝贡口岸与日本、朝鲜、暹罗、马六甲及爪哇的海上转运枢纽。王府文官以汉文往来外交表章，以闻得大君为首的祝女体系则主持林间“御岳”祭祀，维系着独特的岛屿王权，直至经历1609年萨摩入侵、1879年明治吞并及1945年冲绳战役的重创与战后重修。

items.rationale: Remove "The focus here is..." and add Shuri, Ming/SE Asia entrepôt trade, kikoe-ōgimi/utaki, 1609 and 1879.

before.en:
Lan Xang’s royal centers developed in a mountainous region connected by the Mekong and its tributaries. Luang Prabang’s position and sacred landscape joined political authority with religious institutions and routes of exchange. Rivers could support connection without producing one uniform culture or an easily surveyed state boundary.

Relations with Đại Việt included both political and economic cooperation and episodes of conflict. A modern account emphasizing only friendship would conceal that variation. Regional alliances changed with rulers, resources and disputes. The focus here follows the late-medieval court world rather than claiming exact founding and dissolution dates for every part of the kingdom. Linking Lan Xang with neighboring courts fills a mainland sequence while keeping Laos’s regional history distinct from a single modern national map.
before.zh:
澜沧的王室中心在山地环境中发展，由湄公河及其支流连接。琅勃拉邦的位置与神圣景观，将政治权威同宗教机构及交换路线结合。河流能够支持联系，却不产生单一文化或可轻易测绘的国家边界。

同大越的关系既有政治、经济合作，也有冲突；只强调友好的现代叙述会遮蔽这种变化。区域联盟随统治者、资源和争端调整。本条关注中世纪晚期的宫廷世界，不为王国每一部分断言精确建国与解体日期。把澜沧连接邻近宫廷，可以补充大陆政治序列，同时保留不同于现代国界的老挝区域史。

after.en: Consolidated along the middle Mekong around Xiang Dong Xiang Thong (Luang Prabang) in the mid-fourteenth century and later anchored downriver at Vientiane, Lan Xang (“Million Elephants”) linked upland forest products—benzoin resin, sticklac, ivory and cardamom—with lowland Theravada monasteries and riverine caravan trails. Its rulers alternated marriage alliances and trade with neighbouring Lanna, Ayutthaya and Đại Việt with fierce border wars, governing through autonomous *mueang* principalities before dynastic splits around 1707 divided the Mekong realm into Luang Prabang, Vientiane and Champasak.
after.zh: 十四世纪中叶沿湄公河中游在川铜（今琅勃拉邦，后迁都万象）整合兴起的澜沧王国（意为“百万象之国”），将高地森林出产的安息香、紫胶、象牙与豆蔻同低地南传佛教寺院及水陆商路相连。历代君主依托半自治的“勐”（mueang）体系施政，与兰纳、阿瑜陀耶及大越时而联姻通商、时而兵戎相见，直至1707年前后王族分立为琅勃拉邦、万象与占巴塞三部。

items.rationale: Replace "The focus here follows..." with Luang Prabang/Vientiane, forest trade, mueang governance, and the 1707 split.

before.en:
Subak institutions connect irrigated rice cultivation with water temples, cooperation and rules for sharing resources. Canals and weirs are only part of the system: maintenance, mutual assistance, conflict resolution and ritual also require coordination among people. A landscape of rice terraces therefore embodies social decisions rather than engineering alone.

The tradition has a long history, while particular canals, fields and temples have their own dates. Communities continued to adapt practices under changing political and economic conditions. Modern heritage designation selects particular examples and does not make all farming in Bali identical. This entry uses a historical window to explore the institutions, not to claim that they ended in 1900. Living users and ongoing pressures remain part of the landscape’s history.
before.zh:
苏巴克制度把水田稻作同水庙、合作以及资源共享规则相连。渠道和堰坝只是体系的一部分：维护、互助、冲突解决与仪式，也需要人与人之间协调。因此，梯田景观体现社会决策，而不仅是工程。

传统拥有较长历史，具体渠道、田地和寺庙却有各自年代。社区在政治、经济条件变化中持续调整实践。现代遗产指定选择特定实例，并不使巴厘所有农业相同。本条用历史窗口探讨制度，不表示它在1900年终结。现实使用者与持续压力，仍属于景观历史的一部分。

after.en: Across Bali’s volcanic slopes, *subak* farmers’ associations channel river water from crater lakes through tunnels, bamboo-and-stone weirs and terraced paddies governed by shared assemblies and water temples (*pura ulun danu*). Coordinated planting schedules synchronize irrigation flows while starving rice pests across whole watersheds, binding hydraulic engineering to temple offerings and collective labour duties that Balinese villages have continually adapted from precolonial kingdoms through Dutch rule and modern tourism pressures.
after.zh: 在巴厘岛火山坡地上，由稻农自治组成的“苏巴克”水利社通过隧洞、分水堰与层叠梯田引火山湖溪水入田，并依托水神庙（Pura Ulun Danu）议事会统筹分水规则。上下游协同安排插秧与休耕节律，既均衡水量又阻断虫害蔓延，将水利工程、庙宇祭仪与义务修渠劳作紧密结合，在历经前殖民王国、荷属时期与当代旅游开发的变迁中持续运转。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry uses a historical window..." and explain pest-control synchronization and temple water-sharing directly.

before.en:
Seventeenth-century Aceh was governed by a succession of sultanahs. Their rule requires analysis of political institutions and relationships rather than a presumption that female sovereignty necessarily weakened a state. The contrast with Iskandar Muda’s expansionist reputation has shaped later interpretations of the period.

Modern scholarship questions measures of success that equate power only with conquest or one ruler’s personal command. Courts could operate through negotiation and relations among officeholders, merchants and other authorities. This entry introduces that historiographical problem rather than supplying a uniform judgment on every reign. It also distinguishes a scholarly reassessment from the court praise preserved in royal literature. Women’s political history becomes part of institutional analysis, not an exceptional footnote added to a male ruler sequence.
before.zh:
十七世纪亚齐先后由多位女苏丹统治。分析她们的统治，需要研究政治制度与关系，不能预设女性主权必然削弱国家。同伊斯坎达尔·穆达扩张声誉的对照，长期影响对此时期的解释。

现代研究质疑仅用征服或个人号令衡量成功的尺度。宫廷可以通过官员、商人及其他权威之间的协商运作。本条介绍这一史学问题，而不是对每段统治给出同样评价；同时区分学术重估与王室文学保存的赞颂。女性政治史因而进入制度分析，不只是男性君主序列之外的例外注脚。

after.en: Between 1641 and 1699 four successive female rulers—beginning with Sultanah Taj al-Alam Safiatuddin Syah, daughter of the conqueror Iskandar Muda—governed the cosmopolitan pepper-and-tin sultanate of Aceh at the northern tip of Sumatra. Rather than ruling through Iskandar Muda’s bloody court purges and costly sieges of Portuguese Melaka, the sultanahs presided over consultative councils of *orangkaya* nobles, Islamic jurists and multilingual harbour officials, keeping Aceh independent and commercially prosperous against Dutch East India Company pressure.
after.zh: 1641至1699年间，自名王伊斯坎达尔·穆达之女萨菲亚图丁·沙阿起，苏门答腊北端的胡椒与锡贸强国亚齐连续由四位女苏丹执政。不同于先王酷烈清洗贵族、屡兴大军围攻马六甲的集权路线，女苏丹们借重“奥朗卡亚”贵族议事会、伊斯兰法学家与多语港务官协商施政，在荷兰东印度公司步步紧逼下维系了亚齐的主权独立与商港繁荣。

items.rationale: Replace historiographical meta-prose ("This entry introduces...") with Safiatuddin Syah, orangkaya councils, and VOC diplomacy.

before.en:
Introduced in 1830, the Dutch colonial Cultivation System obliged Javanese cultivators to produce goods for European markets and deliver them through governmental arrangements at fixed prices. Agricultural work was connected to colonial budgets and commercial transport, rather than being a voluntary exchange among equal parties.

The Nationaal Archief’s catalog records crop production, land, labor obligations and administrative finance. Such archives expose the categories through which officials managed resources, but their accounting viewpoint does not describe every cultivator’s experience. The selected nineteenth-century window follows the system’s principal period without claiming that coercive labor relations ended in 1870. Connecting this record to Batavia and Indonesian independence explains economic institutions between the founding of a colonial center and the much later end of colonial rule.
before.zh:
1830年引入的荷兰殖民强制种植制度，要求爪哇耕作者为欧洲市场生产作物，并通过政府安排按固定价格交付。农业劳动同殖民预算和商业运输相连，并非平等主体之间的自愿交换。

荷兰国家档案馆目录记录作物生产、土地、劳动义务与行政财政，显示官员管理资源的分类，但账目视角无法描述每位耕作者的经历。所选十九世纪窗口关注制度的主要时期，不表示强制劳动关系于1870年结束。将本条连接巴达维亚和印度尼西亚独立，可以解释殖民中心建立与更晚殖民统治终结之间的经济制度。

after.en: Introduced across Java in 1830 by Governor-General Johannes van den Bosch to rescue debt-ridden Dutch finances after the Java War, the *Cultuurstelsel* (Cultivation System) compelled villages to set aside arable land and unpaid labour days to grow state-monopoly coffee, sugar and indigo delivered at fixed prices through Dutch trading houses and Javanese regents (*bupati*). While remitting huge budget surpluses to Amsterdam, heavy corvée demands and lost rice acreage contributed to severe 1840s famines in Cirebon and Demak—and coerced plantation labour persisted in new corporate forms well past the system’s phased repeal after 1870.
after.zh: 1830年爪哇战争结束后，荷属东印度总督范登博斯为挽救荷兰本土财政危机推行“强制种植制度”（Cultuurstelsel），勒令爪哇村社划出耕地与无偿劳役日，通过荷兰商行与本土摄政贵族按官定低价交售咖啡、甘蔗与蓝靛。该制虽向阿姆斯特丹输送巨额财政盈余，沉重徭役与稻田缩减却在1840年代引发井里汶、淡目等地惨重饥荒；1870年后官营体制虽渐次废止，强制性种植园劳役仍在私营资本形态下长期延续。

items.rationale: Replace archive-catalog meta-prose with van den Bosch, coffee/sugar/indigo quotas, 1840s famines, and post-1870 labor reality.

before.en:
The restoration of a Lê court did not simply recreate the administrative conditions of the Early Lê dynasty. Rivals claimed legitimacy while powerful families exercised practical authority. A royal title and the capacity to command resources could belong to different institutions, so the continued dynasty name should not be read as uniformly centralized government.

The Mạc and Restored Lê phases overlapped, and later Trịnh–Nguyễn competition divided governing authority between northern and southern political worlds. Commercial centers and religious production continued through these conflicts. Keeping a separate restored phase fills the chronological gap between the Early Lê and Nguyễn entries without disguising factional government. The terminal date follows the National Museum’s 1788 convention; the final court’s collapse and subsequent claims can be dated differently in detailed accounts.
before.zh:
黎氏宫廷复立并非简单恢复黎初的行政状况。竞争者声称正统，强势家族则掌握实际权力。王号与调集资源的能力可能分属于不同机构，因此王朝名称延续不表示始终实行同样的中央集权。

莫氏与黎中兴阶段重叠，后来的郑、阮竞争又把实际治理分为南北不同政治世界。商业中心和宗教生产在冲突中继续存在。单列中兴阶段，可填补黎初与阮朝之间的编年空缺，同时不掩盖家族执政。终点采用国家历史博物馆1788年的分期；末代宫廷崩溃及后续主张，在更细研究中可能另有纪年。

after.en: After Mạc Đăng Dung usurped the throne in 1527, loyalists restored a Lê monarch in 1533, inaugurating two and a half centuries in which Lê emperors reigned in ceremony at Thăng Long while rival military houses governed in fact. Once the Mạc were pushed into Cao Bằng, Trịnh lords (*chúa*) ruled northern Đại Việt and Nguyễn lords carved out an expanding southern realm across Thuận Hóa and Quảng Nam—sustaining brisk maritime trade and village craft growth amid fortified north–south partition until the Tây Sơn uprising and Qing intervention brought the Restored Lê court down in 1788–1789.
after.zh: 1527年莫登庸代黎自立后，尊黎旧臣于1533年拥立黎室中兴，开启长达两个半世纪黎皇虚拱于升龙、实权归于武人世家的格局。莫氏退据高平后，北方由郑主执掌朝政，南方则由阮主在顺化、广南开拓新土，形成南北筑垒对峙而又各自通商兴业的局面，直至西山起义军兴及1788—1789年政局剧变终结黎廷。

items.rationale: Remove "Keeping a separate restored phase..." and explain Lê/Mạc/Trịnh/Nguyễn division directly.

before.en:
Vedic literature contains ritual verses, philosophical dialogues and instructions whose transmission depended on trained recitation. Teachers and pupils preserved patterns of pronunciation, accent and sequence through repeated oral practice. The collection emerged over a long period; neither its contents nor the communities that transmitted them can be reduced to a single founding event. Oral transmission was a form of skilled intellectual work, not evidence that its practitioners lacked systems for organizing knowledge.

This entry focuses on a late first-millennium-BCE context rather than dating the whole tradition. It invites comparison with Buddhist and Jain learning, whose texts and institutions developed through different combinations of speech, memory and writing. Later preservation does not imply that access was equal across gender or social groups, or that every transmitted passage remained unchanged.
before.zh:
吠陀文献包括仪式诗句、哲学对话和实践规程，其传承依靠受训练的诵读。师生反复学习发音、重音与次序，以口传技巧组织知识。这些文献形成于漫长时期，不能把内容与传授群体归结为一次建教事件；口传也不表示缺乏知识整理的方法。

本条聚焦公元前一千纪的部分语境，而非断定整个传统的起讫。与佛教、耆那教的学习方式并读，可以观察言说、记忆和书写的不同组合。后世的保存不等于各性别、社会群体均能平等参与，也不能证明每一段文本从未改变。

after.en: Across first-millennium BCE northern India, Brahmin priestly lineages preserved the *Rigveda* and later Vedic hymns, ritual formulas and *Upanishadic* dialogues without relying on written manuscripts—training pupils from childhood through intricate *pāṭha* recitation permutations that locked every syllable, pitch accent and word boundary against drift. Reserved largely to male twice-born initiates even as rare female sages such as Gargi Vachaknavi entered philosophical debate in the *Brihadaranyaka Upanishad*, this disciplined sonic architecture developed alongside early Jain and Buddhist monastic communities that organized memory, vernacular preaching and eventual writing in contrasting ways.
after.zh: 在公元前一千纪的北印度，婆罗门祭司世系不假手书卷，靠严密的口传诵习保存《梨俱吠陀》及后续仪式赞歌与《奥义书》哲思——学童自幼演练多种交叉复诵法（pāṭha），将每个音节、声调高低与连音边界精确锁定。这套声音记忆技艺主要限于再生族男性（《广林奥义书》亦载女哲人迦尔吉登坛论辩的罕例），并与同期兴起、采用方言宣讲和不同结集方式的耆那教与佛教僧团形成鲜明对照。

items.rationale: Cut "This entry focuses on..." and describe pāṭha recitation, Gargi, and Buddhist/Jain contrast directly.

before.en:
Sea routes linked Indian ports with the Persian Gulf, southern Arabia, the Red Sea and Mediterranean markets. Cotton textiles and other goods moved through chains of merchants, storage places and onward journeys. Finding an Indian product far away demonstrates exchange, but does not by itself identify a direct voyage, an individual trader or a political agreement between two empires.

Ports connected coastal activity with inland producers and overland routes. Their histories therefore include manufacture and labor as well as ships and rulers. This entry uses the early Common Era to connect the Kushan and Roman worlds already represented in the atlas. It avoids drawing one continuous, dated itinerary from scattered objects: a commercial network persisted through many journeys, changing intermediaries and unevenly preserved evidence.
before.zh:
海路把印度港口与波斯湾、阿拉伯南部、红海和地中海市场联系起来。棉织品等货物经过商人、仓储和后续运输构成的链条。远方发现印度制品可以证明交换，却不能单独确认一次直航、某位商人或两个帝国的政治协议。

港口连接沿岸活动、内陆生产者和陆路，历史因而也涉及制造与劳动。本条以公元初期为背景，联系图谱中的贵霜和罗马世界。零散遗物不能直接拼成一条精确编年的连续航线：商业网络通过许多航次、不断变化的中间环节和保存不均的证据而存在。

after.en: Riding seasonal monsoon winds across the Arabian Sea in the early centuries CE, stitched-plank and nailed merchant vessels carried Indian cotton muslins, black pepper, agate beads and spikenard from Bharuch, Muziris and Arikamedu to Red Sea berths at Berenike and Myos Hormos and Persian Gulf entrepôts, returning with Roman gold and silver coin, coral, wine amphorae and frankincense. Rather than single ships sailing end-to-end under imperial treaties, cargoes passed through multilingual port warehouses, inland bullock caravans, weaver guilds and maritime loan contracts spanning Kushan, Satavahana, South Arabian and Roman markets.
after.zh: 公元最初数世纪间，顺应阿拉伯海季风往返的缝合木船与商舶，将印度的细棉布、黑胡椒、玛瑙珠与甘松香自跋禄羯呫婆、穆济里斯及阿里卡梅杜运往红海贝雷尼凯港与波斯湾商埠，换回罗马金银币、红珊瑚、双耳酒罐与乳香。货物并非由单一帝国船队直航包办，而是经由贵霜、娑多婆诃那、南阿拉伯与罗马市场间的内陆牛车商帮、织工行会及海商借贷契约层层转手。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry uses..." and name Bharuch, Muziris, Berenike, monsoon winds, and merchant chains.

before.en:
Cotton cloth from South Asia circulated as ordinary goods and as luxury furnishings or clothing. Printed and painted textiles from the Coromandel coast were adapted to distant consumers, linking local skills with buyers across oceanic markets. A finished fabric therefore contains evidence of decisions by spinners, weavers, dyers, painters and merchants, not only the taste of a royal or European customer.

The expansion of European demand and Company power brought opportunities and coercive pressures that differed across producers and periods. Later industrial competition changed those relationships again. This entry uses textiles to connect economic change with everyday labor and the Indian Ocean network. It does not equate a trading company’s purchases with sovereign control, or assume that all Indian textile regions followed the same chronology of growth and decline.
before.zh:
南亚棉布既作为日常用品，也作为奢侈的服装和陈设流通。科罗曼德尔海岸的印染、彩绘织品适应远方消费者，把地方技艺与跨洋买家相连。一块成品布因此包含纺纱、织造、染色、绘制及贸易参与者的选择，而不只是王室或欧洲顾客的品味。

欧洲需求与公司权力增长，给不同时期、不同生产者带来机会和强制压力；后来的工业竞争再次改变这些关系。本条借织品把经济变化、日常劳动和印度洋网络连接起来，不把公司采购等同主权控制，也不假设印度各织品产区都经历相同的兴衰编年。

after.en: Along southeastern India’s Coromandel coast, specialized households spun cotton, wove fine *chintz* (*kalamkari*), and fixed vivid madder reds and indigo blues with mordants and resist wax—tailoring floral palampores for European parlours, ceremonial *patola*-inspired cloths for Aceh and Sulawesi spice courts, and striped checks for West African and Atlantic markets. As Dutch, English and French East India Companies shifted in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries from competitive coastal buying to coercive cash advances and monopoly weaver contracts, artisans intermittently deserted looms or protested price cuts long before British factory-spun yarn undercut export weaving.
after.zh: 在印度东南部的科罗曼德尔海岸，专业匠户纺棉织布，以媒染剂与防染蜡笔绘染出鲜亮耐洗的茜红与靛蓝印花棉布（kalamkari），既为欧洲宅邸定制花卉床帷，也为亚齐、苏拉威西香料王廷织造礼仪布匹，并销往西非与大西洋市场。十七至十八世纪荷、英、法东印度公司从竞价收购转向强制预付款与垄断包买后，织工曾以罢织迁徙抗议压价，其生计变迁远早于英国机器棉纱倾销的冲击。

items.rationale: Cut "This entry uses textiles..." and bring out kalamkari mordant craft, Indonesian/European buyers, and weaver resistance.

before.en:
Pakistan’s 1956,1962 and 1973 constitutions organized executive authority and representation in different ways. These changes followed independence but did not resolve debates about the state’s Islamic character, regional identity and the distribution of power. Constitutional history includes interruptions and exclusions as well as the adoption of legal documents.

After the 1971 separation of Bangladesh, members elected from former West Pakistan participated in a new constitutional settlement. The 1973 framework introduced a bicameral federal parliament, but agreement about a constitution did not imply equal satisfaction among provinces or uninterrupted civilian government. Reading parliamentary commemoration beside constitutional scholarship helps separate the institutions described in a text from political bargaining and coercion. This entry ends at the 1973 settlement and makes no claim that constitutional practice stayed unchanged afterward.
before.zh:
巴基斯坦1956、1962和1973年的宪法以不同方式组织行政权和代表制度。独立后的这些变化并未消除关于国家伊斯兰性质、区域身份和权力分配的争论。宪政史既包括法律文件的制定，也包括中断与排除。

1971年孟加拉国独立后，原西巴基斯坦选出的议员参与新的制宪安排。1973年框架确立联邦两院制议会，但对宪法的协议不表示各省同样满意，也不表示文官统治未曾中断。把议会纪念叙事与宪政研究并读，可以区分文本制度、政治议价和强制。本条止于1973年的安排，不主张后来的实践保持不变。

after.en: Following independence in 1947, Pakistan wrestled for decades over parliamentary versus presidential rule, the constitutional place of Islam, and representation between populous Bengali-speaking East Pakistan and the four provinces of West Pakistan. A first parliamentary republic adopted in 1956 fell to military coup in 1958, and Ayub Khan’s 1962 presidential charter collapsed amid mass protests in 1969. After civil war and Bangladesh’s independence in 1971, elected legislators from the remaining western provinces enacted the 1973 Constitution creating a bicameral federal parliament—a legal touchstone repeatedly suspended and amended under subsequent military and civilian governments.
after.zh: 1947年独立后，巴基斯坦长期围绕议会制与总统制取舍、伊斯兰宪制地位，以及人口占优的孟加拉语东巴基斯坦与西巴四省之间的代表权展开博弈。1956年首部议会制宪法于1958年因军事政变废止，阿尤布·汗1962年颁行的总统制宪章又在1969年民众抗议中瓦解。经历1971年内战与孟加拉国独立后，原西巴基斯坦民选议员制定1973年宪法，确立两院制联邦议会框架，但其后仍屡经军政更迭与修宪折冲。

items.rationale: Remove "Reading parliamentary commemoration..." and "This entry ends at..." in favor of concrete 1956/1962/1973 constitutional history.

before.en:
Bangladesh’s constitution was adopted on 4November 1972 and came into force on 16December. It translated independence after the liberation war into a legal framework of government, rights and public responsibilities. A constitution is evidence of the order its authors sought to create, not proof that wartime displacement, social inequality or institutional conflict had already been resolved.

Later amendments changed important provisions, so a modern consolidated copy must be read with attention to the dates of its wording. The adoption event and the longer history of constitutional government are related but distinct. Linking this entry to the language movement and the 1971 war helps explain how cultural claims, political struggle and legal design intersected, while avoiding the assumption that one constitutional text captures all viewpoints within the new country.
before.zh:
孟加拉国宪法于1972年11月4日通过，12月16日生效。它把解放战争后的独立转化为政府、权利与公共职责的法律框架。宪法显示制定者希望建立的秩序，却不能证明战争流离、社会不平等或制度冲突已经解决。

后来的修宪改变了重要条款，阅读现代合订文本时必须注意措辞所属年代。宪法通过事件与更长的宪政历史相关，但并不相同。与语言运动和1971年战争条目相连，可以解释文化诉求、政治斗争与法律设计如何交汇，同时避免认为一部文本涵盖新国家内部所有观点。

after.en: Less than a year after emerging from the devastating 1971 liberation war, Bangladesh’s Constituent Assembly adopted a new constitution on 4 November 1972 that took effect on 16 December—the first anniversary of victory—framing a parliamentary republic around nationalism, socialism, democracy and secularism while enshrining Bengali language rights born in the 1952 movement. Drafted amid ruined bridges, millions of returning refugees and acute rural scarcity, its text soon underwent sweeping constitutional amendments as coups, martial-law administrations and multiparty struggles reshaped Bangladeshi politics over the following decades.
after.zh: 自惨烈的1971年解放战争诞生不足一年，孟加拉国制宪会议便于1972年11月4日通过新宪法，并在胜利一周年纪念日12月16日正式施行，确立议会共和制与源自1952年母语运动的孟加拉语国家地位。这部诞生于桥梁尽毁、千万难民返乡与物资匮乏之中的根本大法，此后在政变、军法管制与多党竞争中历经多次重大修正。

items.rationale: Remove "Linking this entry..." and "modern consolidated copy" meta-prose; anchor in 1972 reconstruction and later amendments.

before.en:
India, Pakistan and the World Bank signed the Indus Waters Treaty in 1960 after extended negotiations. The agreement allocated use of the eastern and western river groups, with specified exceptions, and created procedures for information exchange and disagreements. It concerned uses of an interconnected river system, not the creation of physically separate watersheds or a new sovereign border.

The Bank’s role was limited and procedural; it was not a general guarantor empowered to decide every legal dispute. That distinction matters when interpreting later accounts of the treaty. This entry focuses on the agreement’s historical design and avoids claiming that the arrangement operates unchanged today. Linking it to Partition and agricultural change shows how political boundaries, irrigation infrastructure and food production became interdependent without reducing water history to diplomatic ceremony alone.
before.zh:
印度、巴基斯坦和世界银行于1960年在长期谈判后签署《印度河用水条约》。协议在规定例外的情况下分配东、西两组河流的使用，并设立信息交流与分歧处理程序。它针对相互联系的水系用途，并非建立彼此隔绝的流域或划定新主权边界。

世界银行的角色有限且具有程序性，不是能够裁决一切法律争端的总体担保人。理解后世叙述时，这一区别重要。本条聚焦协议的历史设计，不声称安排至今未变。与分治和农业变化相连，可以说明政治边界、灌溉设施与粮食生产如何相互依赖，而不把水史缩为外交仪式。

after.en: After the 1947 Partition sliced directly across the irrigated Punjab plain—leaving headworks in India and downstream canals in Pakistan—nine years of technical talks mediated by the World Bank produced the Indus Waters Treaty, signed in Karachi on 19 September 1960 by Jawaharlal Nehru and Ayub Khan. The pact allocated full use of the three eastern tributaries (Ravi, Beas, Sutlej) to India and the three western rivers (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab) largely to Pakistan, backed by international financing for massive link canals and dams such as Mangla and Tarbela, while assigning the World Bank strictly defined procedural duties in appointing neutral experts rather than sovereign arbitration.
after.zh: 1947年印巴分治将旁遮普灌溉平原一分为二，上游渠首多归印度而下游灌渠多在巴基斯坦。经世界银行斡旋九年，尼赫鲁与阿尤布·汗于1960年9月19日在卡拉奇签署《印度河用水条约》，将东三河（拉维河、比亚斯河、萨特莱杰河）主要划归印度使用，西三河（印度河干流、杰赫勒姆河、杰纳布河）主要划归巴基斯坦，并筹资兴建曼格拉、塔贝拉大坝与跨河引水渠；世界银行仅承担指派中立专家的程序性职责，而非凌驾主权的总担保人。

items.rationale: Cut "This entry focuses on..." and name Karachi 1960, eastern/western rivers, Mangla/Tarbela, and exact Bank role.

before.en:
Qanats carried water through underground channels using gradients rather than pumps. Their technical design supported settlement and agriculture in dry environments, while maintenance and allocation required organized social relationships. Shafts, channels, reservoirs and associated structures formed a system extending beyond a single monumental entrance.

A working water system depended on repeated labor and agreements across users; engineering and communal management cannot be separated into unrelated histories. Comparing qanats with South Asian stepwells shows different architectural responses to access and storage. It does not establish a single direct line of invention between the two. The broad focus period is chosen to connect several atlas eras, while the technology’s origin and the histories of particular systems require more precise local evidence than a general map pin can provide.
before.zh:
坎儿井依靠坡度而非水泵，通过地下渠道输水。技术设计支持干旱环境中的聚落与农业，维护和分配则需要有组织的社会关系。竖井、渠道、水库和配套设施构成超出某一纪念性入口的系统。

水系持续运行依赖反复劳动和使用者之间的约定，工程与共同管理不能拆成不相关的历史。与南亚阶井比较，可以看到取用和储存的不同建筑办法，却不能据此证明两者之间有单一的直接发明谱系。较宽时段用于连接图谱多个时代；技术起源及具体水系的历史，仍需要比一般地图点位更精细的地方证据。

after.en: Across the arid piedmonts of Iran, Central Asia and neighboring drylands, *qanat* (*karez*) builders sank lines of vertical ventilation and spoil shafts down into alluvial fans, connecting them underground by gently sloping tunnels that tapped mountain aquifers and carried cool water tens of kilometres to oasis towns and orchards by gravity alone—preventing evaporation under desert sun. Keeping tunnels clear of silt collapse and dividing water shares by timed intervals demanded village councils, hereditary *muqanni* tunnel specialists and water-rights ledgers sustained across generations.
after.zh: 在伊朗高原、中亚及邻近干旱山前冲积扇地带，匠人向下开凿成排竖井，在地下贯通坡度精密的暗渠（坎儿井），无需水泵便借重力引高山含水层清泉潜行数十公里直抵绿洲城镇与果园，免受烈日蒸发之耗。清掏塌方淤泥与按时辰分水灌溉，世代仰赖专业掏井匠人（muqanni）、村社水规与用水簿册的协同维系。

items.rationale: Remove "general map pin" and "broad focus period" meta-prose; explain aquifers, gravity tunnels, evaporation and muqanni guilds.

before.en:
The Chagatai ruling line formed part of the Mongol successor world across Central Asia. Its authority involved both pastoral groups and wealthy settled regions, whose institutions and religious practices could create tensions as well as cooperation. Urban administration and dynastic authority were not always concentrated in the same hands.

By the mid-fourteenth century, eastern and western political formations followed different paths; recognition of a ruler in the east in 1347 is one marker of that differentiation. Later Chagatai-descended rulers continued, so the end of this early-phase overview must not be mistaken for the extinction of the dynasty. Reading the entry beside the Timurids and earlier regional courts makes political transformation visible without treating all Central Asian societies as a single unchanging nomadic or urban category.
before.zh:
察合台统治系属于中亚的蒙古继承世界。权威同时涉及游牧群体与富裕定居地区，不同制度和宗教实践既可能带来紧张，也可能促成合作。城市行政与王朝权威并不总掌握在同一批人手中。

至十四世纪中叶，东、西政治形态走上不同路径，1347年东部君主获得承认，是分化的一个标志。后来的察合台后裔仍继续统治，因此这一早期概览的终点不能被误读为王系灭绝。与帖木儿及更早区域宫廷并读，可看见政治转型，而不把中亚社会视为不变的单一游牧或城市类别。

after.en: Carved from the central Eurasian appanage of Genghis Khan’s second son Chagatai, the Chagatai ulus straddled two contrasting worlds: mobile Mongol-Turkic horsemen pasturing across Semirechye and the Ili valley, and rich Persian- and Turkic-speaking oasis cities in Transoxiana and the Tarim Basin taxed by Muslim merchant administrators. Disputes over urban Islamization and steppe custom split the realm by the 1340s—marked by Tughlugh Timur’s 1347 enthronement in eastern Moghulistan while western Transoxiana passed to *amir* kingmakers culminating in Timur, even as Chagatai-descended khans reigned in the east for centuries.
after.zh: 源自成吉思汗次子察合台封地的察合台汗国，横跨两种截然不同的社会：七河流域与伊犁河谷逐水草而居的蒙突骑牧部族，以及河中与塔里木盆地由穆斯林商贾文官征税治理的富庶绿洲城郭。围绕定居伊斯兰化与草原旧制的冲突在14世纪40年代促成汗国东西分途——1347年秃忽鲁帖木儿在东察合台（蒙兀儿斯坦）即位，西部河中实权则落入异密贵族之手并孕育出帖木儿帝国，而察合台黄金家族后裔仍在东方延续统治数百年。

items.rationale: Remove "Reading the entry beside..." and name Semirechye/Transoxiana, 1347 Tughlugh Timur, Moghulistan and Timur.

before.en:
The emergence of Kazakh political formations in the later fifteenth century involved groups separating from an existing Uzbek ruler’s authority and establishing new alliances. Steppe power depended on relationships among leaders and communities, access to pasture and connections with cities. A khan’s influence could expand, fragment or be contested without following the assumptions of a modern centralized state.

Diplomatic evidence links Kazakh rulers to wider Eurasian worlds, challenging the image of pastoral societies as isolated. The early-phase endpoint used here introduces changing relations with Russia; it does not mark the disappearance of Kazakh khans or a whole people’s simultaneous submission. Reading the entry with neighboring khanates highlights differences among mobile and settled political arrangements while avoiding the reduction of later national identity to one precisely dated founding ceremony.
before.zh:
十五世纪后期哈萨克政治形态的兴起，涉及脱离既有乌兹别克统治权威的群体及新联盟。草原权力依赖领袖与社群关系、牧地获取和城市联系。汗的影响能够扩展、分裂或受到争夺，不必遵循现代中央集权国家的假设。

外交证据把哈萨克统治者与更广的欧亚世界联系起来，挑战牧民社会孤立的印象。本条早期阶段的终点用于引入与俄国关系的变化，不表示哈萨克诸汗消失，或所有人同时归附。与邻近汗国并读，可以观察游牧、定居政治安排的差异，而不把后来的民族身份缩成一次精确纪年的建国仪式。

after.en: Around the 1460s the Chinggisid princes Kerei and Janibek broke away from the Uzbek ruler Abu’l-Khayr Khan with allied pastoral clans into Zhetysu (Mogulistan’s western marches), forging the Kazakh Khanate across seasonal steppe corridors linking summer highland pastures (*jailau*) with winter river shelters along the Syr Darya. Under rulers such as Kasym Khan, mounted confederations traded tens of thousands of horses, hides and wool into oasis markets at Sighnaq, Tashkent and Bukhara and exchanged envoys with Muscovy, Safavid Iran and Central Asian courts—governing through three autonomous *zhuz* hordes whose shifting diplomacy with the Russian Empire began in the 1730s without ending khanly contests across the steppe.
after.zh: 15世纪60年代前后，成吉思汗后裔克列与贾尼别克率部脱离乌兹别克汗阿布海尔，迁入七河西部草场结成新盟，奠定哈萨克汗国之基，贯通高山夏牧场与锡尔河冬营地之间的游牧走廊。至哈斯木汗等君主在位时，草原骑兵联盟将大批战马、毛皮输入塞格纳克、塔什干与布哈拉城郭集市，并与莫斯科公国、萨法维伊朗往来通使；其后形成的三大玉兹在18世纪30年代开启对俄外交折冲，草原诸汗与部族的竞逐仍长期延续。

items.rationale: Cut "The early-phase endpoint used here..." and name Kerei, Janibek, Kasym Khan, Syr Darya cities and the three zhuz.

before.en:
After the Ottoman Empire’s dissolution, the League of Nations mandate system gave Britain and France formal administrative roles in several West Asian territories. Its legal language distinguished provisional recognition of communities from the powers exercised by outside administrators. A mandate was therefore neither the continuation of an unchanged Ottoman province nor the same thing as completed national independence.

Iraq, Syria and Lebanon, and Palestine and Transjordan followed different institutional paths. Legal documents explain the terms administrators claimed to follow, but do not establish that local populations accepted the system or experienced it uniformly. This entry uses a bounded early 1920s documentary focus to connect imperial dissolution with later state histories. It avoids treating a modern map of countries as proof that all political boundaries and national claims were settled at once.
before.zh:
奥斯曼帝国瓦解后，国际联盟委任统治制度赋予英国和法国在多个西亚地区的正式行政角色。法律语言把对共同体的临时承认，与外部管理者行使的权力区别开来。因此委任统治既不是奥斯曼省份原封不动的延续，也不等同已完成民族独立。

伊拉克、叙利亚和黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和外约旦走上不同制度路径。法律文件说明管理者声称遵循的条件，却不能证明地方居民接受该制度或具有相同经验。本条以1920年代初的有限档案范围，连接帝国解体与后来的国家史，不把现代国界图当作全部边界和民族主张一次性解决的证据。

after.en: Following Ottoman defeat in the First World War, Article 22 of the League of Nations Covenant and the 1920 San Remo conference handed Class A mandates across the Arab provinces to Britain (Iraq, Palestine and Transjordan) and France (Syria and Lebanon)—declaring local populations provisionally independent on paper while empowering European high commissioners to draw frontiers, command garrisons and veto parliaments. Armed uprisings from Iraq in 1920 and Syria in 1925–1927 to Palestine in 1936–1939 forced divergent constitutional concessions: Iraq entered the League in 1932, Lebanon and Syria won full troop withdrawal in 1946, and Mandate Palestine spiralled toward partition and war.
after.zh: 第一次世界大战奥斯曼帝国战败后，国际联盟盟约第22条与1920年圣雷莫会议将阿拉伯诸省划为甲类委任统治地，分交英国（伊拉克、巴勒斯坦与外约旦）和法国（叙利亚与黎巴嫩）管辖——条文虽在纸面上承认当地社会“临时独立”，实则赋予英法高级专员划界、驻军与否决议会的实权。从1920年伊拉克起义、1925—1927年叙利亚大起义到1936—1939年巴勒斯坦抗争，各地风起云涌的反抗迫使委任体制走向迥异结局：伊拉克于1932年独立入盟，黎叙于1946年迫使法军撤离，巴勒斯坦则陷入分治与战火。

items.rationale: Replace "This entry uses a bounded early 1920s..." with San Remo, Article 22, 1920/1925 uprisings and divergent mandate outcomes.

before.en:
The 1978–1979 revolution overthrew Iran’s monarchy and brought an Islamic republic, but the coalition opposing the shah did not share one political program. The proliferation of political publications around the revolution reveals the range of competing organizations and arguments. Changes in control of institutions and the press shaped which voices could remain public.

Economic disruption followed political upheaval, while the subsequent war with Iraq and changes in oil markets also affected society. Those influences should not all be attributed to the revolution as though it were the only cause. This entry follows the transition into the early 1980s to connect mobilization with institutional consolidation. It does not treat a change of regime as evidence that every supporter achieved the outcome they sought, or that all later economic conditions can be explained by one event.
before.zh:
1978—1979年革命推翻伊朗君主制并建立伊斯兰共和国，但反对沙的联盟并不分享同一政治纲领。革命前后政治刊物的增多，显示相互竞争的组织和论辩。机构与报刊控制权的变化，影响哪些声音能够继续公开表达。

政治动荡后经济受扰，随后的两伊战争和石油市场变化也影响社会，不能把这些作用都归给革命。本条延伸至1980年代初，将动员与制度巩固相连，不把政体变化当作每位支持者都实现目标的证据，也不以一个事件解释所有后来经济状况。

after.en: Mass strikes by bazaar merchants, oil workers, clerics, students and leftist activists toppled Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi in early 1979 and ushered in an Islamic Republic under Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, even though the revolutionary coalition held sharply competing visions of constitutional authority. For brief months in 1978–1979 Tehran kiosks overflowed with hundreds of independent, Marxist, liberal, Kurdish, women’s and Islamist newspapers before press closures, institutional purges and wartime mobilization after Iraq’s September 1980 invasion narrowed public political space and reshaped Iran’s economy alongside volatile global oil markets.
after.zh: 巴扎商贾、石油工人、宗教人士、学生与左翼活动家掀起的全国罢工与示威于1979年初推翻巴列维王朝，在霍梅尼领导下建立伊斯兰共和国，但反王权联盟内部对宪政未来抱有截然不同的主张。1978至1979年间德黑兰街头报亭一度涌现数百种独立、左翼、自由派、库尔德、妇女与伊斯兰派刊物；随后报禁收紧、机构整肃以及1980年9月两伊战争爆发带来的战时动员与油价剧变，深刻重塑了伊朗的公共空间与社会经济。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry follows..." and vividly depict the 1978-79 kiosk press explosion, coalition splits, and 1980 war impact.

before.en:
The Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd and its Dependencies adopted the name Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932. Diplomatic recognition could precede the new name: the United States had recognized the earlier kingdom in 1931. Separating those dates prevents a state’s formal title, territorial consolidation and foreign relations from being collapsed into one event.

The name change belonged to a longer political process in the Arabian Peninsula, where different regional histories and institutions were brought into a common sovereign framework. A one-year event provides an anchor, not a complete explanation of how rule was established or experienced. This entry avoids projecting later oil wealth and governmental institutions backward into 1932. It connects state formation with the post-Ottoman regional setting while keeping dynastic claims and diplomatic records distinct from every community’s perspective.
before.zh:
1932年，汉志和内志及其属地王国采用“沙特阿拉伯王国”名称。外交承认可能早于新名：美国已于1931年承认前一王国。区分这些日期，可避免把正式国号、领土整合与外交关系压缩为同一事件。

更名属于阿拉伯半岛更长的政治过程，不同区域历史和制度被纳入共同主权框架。单年事件提供锚点，并不完整解释统治如何建立或被经历。本条不把后来的石油财富和政府机构投射回1932年，并在后奥斯曼区域背景中连接国家形成，同时区分王朝主张、外交记录与各社群视角。

after.en: By royal decree on 23 September 1932, Abd al-Aziz ibn Saud unified the dual Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd and its Dependencies under a single title: the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Decades of oasis warfare since seizing Riyadh in 1902—and the 1924–1925 conquest of cosmopolitan Red Sea Hejaz with its pilgrimage cities of Mecca and Medina—brought regions with distinct legal habits, merchant guilds and tribal confederations under Al Saud rule; foreign powers such as the United States had already extended diplomatic recognition in 1931, six years before commercial oil struck at Dammam in 1938 transformed royal revenues.
after.zh: 1932年9月23日，阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·伊本·沙特颁布王室敕令，将“汉志—内志及其属地王国”正式合称为沙特阿拉伯王国。自1902年夺取利雅得起历经三十年征战——包括1924—1925年并入拥有麦加、麦地那两圣城与红海商帮的汉志——不同法律传统与部落联盟被纳入沙特家族统治；美国等外国已于更名前的1931年予以承认，而足以重塑国家财政的达曼商业油田则要到六年后的1938年方才喷涌。

items.rationale: Replace "This entry avoids projecting later oil wealth..." with the concrete 1931 recognition, 1932 decree, and 1938 Dammam oil timeline!

before.en:
In 1947 the UN General Assembly recommended partition of the British Mandate territory into Arab and Jewish states with a special arrangement for Jerusalem. The recommendation was followed by war, the end of British rule and Israel’s declaration of establishment in May 1948. The military outcome did not simply implement the proposed map.

Palestinians experienced mass displacement and dispossession, remembered as the Nakba, while Israeli state institutions emerged amid war and competing claims to sovereignty. A founding declaration records one political project; it does not resolve the history or rights of every population affected. This entry connects the events without treating refugee displacement as an incidental footnote or presenting 1949 armistice lines as universally agreed permanent borders. Source perspectives and the difference between proposals, declarations, control and recognition remain visible.
before.zh:
1947年联合国大会建议将英国委任统治地区分为阿拉伯国和犹太国，并为耶路撒冷设置特别安排。随后发生战争、英国统治结束，以及以色列于1948年5月宣布建国。军事结果并非简单落实建议地图。

巴勒斯坦人遭受大规模流离和财产剥夺，以“纳克巴”即灾难记忆；以色列国家机构则在战争及相互竞争的主权主张中形成。建国宣言记录一种政治计划，不能解决所有受影响人口的历史或权利。本条把事件联系起来，既不把难民流离视为附带脚注，也不把1949年停战线当作普遍同意的永久边界，并保留建议、宣告、控制与承认之间的区别。

after.en: In November 1947 UN General Assembly Resolution 181 recommended partitioning British Mandate Palestine into Arab and Jewish states with an internationalized Jerusalem, immediately triggering intercommunal fighting that escalated into regional war when British rule ended and Israel declared independence in May 1948. By the 1949 armistice agreements, Israeli forces controlled territory well beyond the UN proposal while Jordan held the West Bank and East Jerusalem and Egypt administered Gaza—and more than 700,000 Palestinians fled or were expelled from homes and villages in the catastrophe remembered as the *Nakba*, leaving refugee return, dispossession and contested armistice lines at the heart of West Asian politics.
after.zh: 1947年11月联合国大会第181号决议建议将英属巴勒斯坦委任统治地分建阿拉伯国与犹太国并对耶路撒冷实行国际共管，随即引发族群武装冲突；1948年5月英国撤离、以色列宣布建国后更升级为全面战争。至1949年各项停战协定签署时，以色列实际控制区超出联大建议版图，约旦控制西岸与东耶路撒冷，埃及管辖加沙；逾七十万巴勒斯坦人在被称为“浩劫”（Nakba）的战乱中逃离或被逐出家园村落，难民回归权与未定停战线自此成为中东政局的核心症结。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry connects..." and state Resolution 181, May 1948, 1949 armistice control, and the Nakba directly.

before.en:
The Taif agreement offered a framework for ending Lebanon’s civil war and reforming its political institutions. It addressed the distribution of governmental responsibilities and the place of sovereignty and armed authority within the state. An agreement negotiated outside Lebanon was connected to decisions by Lebanese political actors and later constitutional implementation.

The 1989 document and the 1990 end-of-war transition are therefore related but different stages. A settlement text cannot by itself show that all disputes, armed relationships or experiences of violence were resolved. Reading it as a primary political agreement raises questions about who negotiated, which institutions changed and what remained outside the written framework. This entry provides a bridge into postwar history without describing peace as an automatic result of signing or assuming every community interpreted the settlement in the same way.
before.zh:
塔伊夫协议为结束黎巴嫩内战和改革政治机构提供框架，涉及政府职责分配，以及主权、武装权威在国家中的位置。在黎巴嫩境外协商的协议，同黎巴嫩政治行动者的决定及后来的宪法实施相连。

1989年文件与1990年战争结束转折因此相关，却是不同阶段。和解文本本身不能证明所有争议、武装关系或暴力经验已经解决。把它作为一手政治协议阅读，可以追问谁参与谈判、哪些机构改变、什么留在文字框架之外。本条为战后史提供衔接，不把和平写成签署的自动结果，也不假设各社群对安排理解相同。

after.en: Surviving deputies of Lebanon’s 1972 parliament met at Taif in Saudi Arabia in October 1989 to negotiate the Document of National Accord, recalibrating sectarian power-sharing to end nearly fifteen years of civil war. Implemented through 1990 constitutional amendments, Taif shifted executive authority from the Maronite presidency to the Council of Ministers, equalized Christian and Muslim parliamentary seats at 50:50, and called for militia disarmament—though Syrian military guardianship, Hezbollah’s armed status against Israeli occupation in the south, and unprosecuted wartime disappearances remained contested long after fighting halted in October 1990.
after.zh: 1989年10月，黎巴嫩1972年届议会的在世议员齐聚沙特阿拉伯塔伊夫签署《全国和解宪章》，借调整教派分权格局结束持续近十五年的内战。经1990年修宪落实，协议将行政实权由马龙派总统移交内阁会议，将议会基督徒与穆斯林席位由六比五改为对等平分，并规定解除各派民兵武装；但叙利亚驻军监护、南部抗击以军占领的武装存续及战时失踪人口追责等问题，在1990年停火后仍长期牵动政局。

items.rationale: Cut "Reading it as a primary political agreement..." and "This entry provides..." in favor of concrete Taif institutional terms.

before.en:
A US- and British-led coalition invaded Iraq in March 2003 and took Baghdad in April. The Coalition Provisional Authority became the occupying administration, while the UN Security Council addressed the authority’s responsibilities and a role for Iraqi institutions and the United Nations. A later resolution about occupation should not be read as a simple statement that the earlier decision to invade had been universally authorized or accepted.

In June 2004 authority was transferred to an Iraqi interim government and the CPA ceased to exist. That institutional event did not end violence or establish that sovereignty was experienced without external constraints. Reading the US diplomatic chronology alongside the contemporary UN record distinguishes invasion, occupation and formal transfer. It also leaves space for civilian experience and Iraqi political actors beyond the administrations named in official documents.
before.zh:
美国、英国主导的联盟于2003年3月入侵伊拉克，4月攻入巴格达。联盟临时管理当局成为占领管理机构，联合国安理会则处理其职责，以及伊拉克机构和联合国的作用。后来的占领决议不能简单解读为此前入侵已获得普遍授权或接受。

2004年6月，权力移交伊拉克临时政府，联盟临时管理当局停止存在。这一制度事件没有结束暴力，也不能证明主权实践已不受外部约束。把美国外交编年与同时代联合国记录并读，可以区分入侵、占领和正式移交，也为官方文件列名机构之外的平民经验及伊拉克政治行动者保留空间。

after.en: In March 2003 a coalition led by the United States and the United Kingdom invaded Iraq without a specific UN Security Council war authorization, capturing Baghdad in April and toppling Saddam Hussein’s Baʿathist regime. Ruling by decree until June 2004, the occupying Coalition Provisional Authority disbanded the Iraqi army and purged ministries—while UN Security Council Resolution 1483 recognized occupying-power obligations under international law without retroactively endorsing the invasion itself. Formal handover to an Iraqi interim government on 28 June 2004 ended the CPA on paper even as insurgency, sectarian bloodshed and foreign military operations escalated.
after.zh: 2003年3月，美英主导的联军在未获联合国安理会专门动武授权的情况下入侵伊拉克，4月攻占巴格达并推翻萨达姆·侯赛因政权。占领机构“联盟临时管理当局”执政期间解散伊拉克旧军队并清洗部委；安理会第1483号决议虽界定占领当局的国际法义务，并未追认入侵行动本身的合法性。2004年6月28日行政权移交伊拉克临时政府，占领当局虽告解散，武装反抗、教派流血冲突与外部军事干预却愈演愈烈。

items.rationale: State the Resolution 1483 distinction and June 2004 handover directly without meta-editorializing.

before.en:
Soviet troops entered Afghanistan in December 1979 after a period of Afghan political upheaval and growing Soviet involvement. The resulting war connected local struggles with Cold War intervention and outside support to opposing forces. Describing it only as a contest between superpowers would obscure Afghan political choices, coercion and the experiences of communities facing violence.

Refugee movement into Iran and other neighboring settings changed older patterns of labor migration. Departure, legal status and later return were different processes, and withdrawal of Soviet forces in 1989 did not end Afghanistan’s wars or automatically make return possible for everyone. This entry links political intervention to displacement while avoiding a single refugee count detached from date and place. The pin at Kabul marks one institutional setting, not the geographic extent of the conflict.
before.zh:
苏军于1979年12月进入阿富汗，此前经历阿富汗政治动荡和苏联介入加深。随后的战争把地方斗争同冷战干预及对反对武装的外部支持相连。若只写成超级大国竞争，就会遮蔽阿富汗政治选择、强制以及遭受暴力的社群经验。

流向伊朗等邻近地区的难民运动，改变了原有劳工迁移模式。离境、法律地位和后来的返乡是不同过程；1989年苏军撤出，没有结束阿富汗战争，也不使所有人自动能够返回。本条连接政治干预与流离，不采用脱离时间地点的单一难民总数。喀布尔点位只是一个制度环境，不是冲突的地理全域。

after.en: In late December 1979 Soviet airborne and motorized divisions entered Kabul, killed President Hafizullah Amin, and installed Babrak Karmal to prop up Afghanistan’s fractured People’s Democratic Party government. Over the next nine years, war between Soviet-backed state forces and diverse *mujahideen* factions armed via Pakistan, the United States, Saudi Arabia and China devastated rural irrigation and villages, driving millions of Afghans across borders into Iran and Pakistan. When the last Soviet columns crossed back over the Amu Darya in February 1989, civil war persisted and millions of refugees navigated precarious legal status rather than immediate return.
after.zh: 1979年12月下旬，苏联空降与摩托化部队进占喀布尔，击毙阿明并扶植卡尔迈勒执政，以挽救内部分裂的阿富汗人民民主党政权。此后九年间，苏军与阿政府军同获得巴基斯坦、美国、沙特及中国等外部援助的各派圣战者武装激战，乡村坎儿井与村落遭重创，数百万阿富汗平民越境涌入伊朗与巴基斯坦避难。1989年2月苏军撤回阿姆河彼岸后，阿富汗内战仍未平息，大批难民长期滞留异乡。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry links..." and "The pin at Kabul..." meta-prose; give concrete 1979-1989 history and refugee reality.

before.en:
Manoomin, wild rice, is a food and a relationship with waters and seasonal cycles for Ojibwe communities. Harvesting requires knowledge of ripening seeds and movement through shallow lakes. Preparing and sharing the crop connects practical work with family teaching and cultural responsibilities. The Leech Lake examples presented by the Smithsonian foreground community voices rather than treating rice as an anonymous commodity.

Markets and people whose identity and obligations are tied to its habitat can understand the same resource differently. Loss of rice waters therefore threatens more than an annual harvest. This record connects food, environmental change and continuing community action. Its historical window is an editorial focus, not a dated origin of the practice. Nor does one Leech Lake example establish that every Anishinaabe community shares an identical local history.
before.zh:
野米 manoomin 对奥吉布瓦社群既是食物，也是人与水域、季节循环的关系。采收需要了解种子何时成熟，以及如何穿行浅湖。加工与分享收成，把实际劳动同家庭教育和文化责任联系起来。史密森学会展示的利奇湖案例以社群成员的声音为中心，并不把野米当成没有来历的商品。

商业市场与身份、责任系于野米水域的人，可能对同一资源有不同理解。因此，生境丧失威胁的不止是一季收成。本条连接食物、环境变化与延续至今的社群行动。所选年代是编辑观察窗口，不是这一实践的起源时间；一个利奇湖案例也不能证明所有阿尼希纳贝社群拥有完全相同的地方史。

after.en: Across shallow glacial lakes and slow rivers of the Great Lakes and upper Mississippi watershed, Ojibwe (Anishinaabe) families glide in canoes each late summer as one partner bends tall *manoomin* (wild rice) stalks gently with cedar knocking sticks—letting ripe grain fall into the hull while reseeding the lakebed for next year. Parched over wood fires, danced in moccasins and winnowed in birchbark trays, *manoomin* anchors treaty rights, clan hospitality and ecological stewardship at places like Leech Lake in Minnesota against dam flooding, mining runoff and commercial paddy branding.
after.zh: 在北美五大湖与密西西比河上游浅水冰川湖泊间，奥吉布瓦（阿尼希纳贝）家庭每逢夏末乘独木舟穿行水草丛中，一人撑篙，一人用雪松木棒轻敲成熟的野米（manoomin）穗秆，令饱满谷粒落入舱中，同时让余粒撒回湖床繁衍来年新苗。经柴火焙炒、鹿皮靴踩脱壳与桦树皮盘扬簸的野米，在明尼苏达利奇湖等社区承载着条约权利、家族馈赠与护水责任，持续抵御水坝淹没与采矿污染的威胁。

items.rationale: Replace "This record connects..." and "editorial focus" boilerplate with cedar knocking sticks, reseeding, birching trays and treaty water stewardship.

before.en:
Potlatches make relationships, inherited responsibilities and public witnessing visible through speeches, gifts and ceremonial regalia. Canadian suppression targeted institutions rather than merely entertainment. After Dan Cranmer’s 1921 potlatch at Village Island, authorities arrested participants and forced families to surrender masks and other belongings under threat of imprisonment.

U’mista Cultural Centre recounts the confiscations from the perspective of communities whose property was taken. Decades of work to recover the collection eventually gave returned objects a home at Alert Bay. Repatriation belongs to the history of political authority, family rights and cultural transmission as well as museum display. This record distinguishes the Kwakwaka’wakw case from neighboring Northwest Coast traditions. The display window ends with U’mista’s opening, not completion of every return or the end of the potlatch.
before.zh:
赠礼宴通过演说、礼物与仪式用具，使亲属关系、世袭责任和公众见证成为可见的制度。加拿大的压制针对这些制度，并不只是禁止娱乐。丹·克兰默于1921年在维利奇岛举行赠礼宴后，当局逮捕参与者，并以监禁相威胁，迫使家庭交出面具及其他物品。

乌米斯塔文化中心从被剥夺财产的社群立场叙述没收事件。数十年的追索，使部分文物回到阿勒特湾。归还因此既是博物馆史，也是政治权威、家庭权利和文化传承的历史。本条区分夸夸嘉夸族与邻近西北海岸各族的传统；窗口终于乌米斯塔开放之年，不表示所有归还工作完成或赠礼宴传统终结。

after.en: In December 1921 Kwakwaka’wakw hereditary chief Dan Cranmer hosted a six-day potlatch on Village Island (*Mamalilikulla*) along the British Columbia coast, distributing flour, sewing machines, canoes and blankets to witness family names and prerogatives in defiance of Canada’s Indian Act ban. Royal Canadian Mounted Police arrested forty-five guests, sentencing twenty-two men and women to Oakalla Prison while coercing families into surrendering hundreds of carved masks, coppers and whistles to museums in Ottawa, Toronto and New York—sparking decades of Kwakwaka’wakw campaigning that dropped the statutory ban in 1951 and brought repatriated treasures home to the U’mista Cultural Centre at Alert Bay in 1980 and beyond.
after.zh: 1921年12月，不列颠哥伦比亚沿岸夸夸嘉夸族世袭首领丹·克兰默无视加拿大《印第安人法》禁令，在维利奇岛举行为期六天的盛大赠礼宴（potlatch），分发面粉、缝纫机、独木舟与毛毯以公证家族名号与世袭权利。皇家骑警随即逮捕四十五名与会者，将二十二名男女判入奥卡拉监狱，并以撤诉免刑相要挟迫使各家交出数百件木雕面具、盾形铜牌与哨具分藏加美各大博物馆；经族人数十年奔走追索，禁令于1951年废除，首批回归圣物于1980年入藏阿勒特湾乌米斯塔文化中心，后续返还与赠礼宴传统延续至今。

items.rationale: Remove "This record distinguishes..." and tell the gripping Dan Cranmer 1921 arrest and 1980 Alert Bay repatriation story directly!

before.en:
Comanche communities made horses central to mobility, bison hunting and regional exchange in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. Herds required grazing and care, while horses became commodities in networks involving skins, manufactured goods and captives. Trade, warfare and negotiation connected communities with New Mexico, Texas and other Indigenous societies. Areas appearing empty on a conventional state map could contain competing economic and political relationships.

An interdisciplinary study involving Indigenous researchers challenges older claims that horse cultures spread only after the Pueblo Revolt of 1680. European written observation is not the beginning of Indigenous practice. This record focuses on a documented Comanche regional phase without projecting one precise horse-arrival year onto all Plains peoples or treating Comanche history as ending with reservation confinement.
before.zh:
十八、十九世纪，科曼奇社群把马匹用于交通、野牛狩猎与区域交换。养马需要牧草和照料，马也成为兽皮、制成品及俘虏交易网络中的商品。贸易、战争与协商，把社群同新墨西哥、得克萨斯及其他原住民社会联系起来。传统国家地图上看似空白的区域，可能存在彼此竞争的经济与政治关系。

一项有原住民研究者参与的跨学科研究，挑战了马文化仅在1680年普韦布洛起义后传播的旧说。欧洲人的书面观察不等于原住民实践的起点。本条聚焦有据可查的科曼奇区域阶段，不为全部平原民族指定单一马匹传入年份，也不以保留地禁锢作为科曼奇历史的终点。

after.en: Across the southern Great Plains (*Comanchería*) in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, Numunuu (Comanche) bands bred vast horse and mule herds that transformed bison hunting, mobile camp logistics and continental diplomacy from the Arkansas River down into northern Mexico. Recent archaeozoological studies conducted with Indigenous scholars show Plains horse husbandry already spreading north of Spanish New Mexico BEFORE the 1680 Pueblo Revolt—growing into a powerhouse trading horses, buffalo robes and captives with Pueblo towns, French voyageurs, Spanish governors and Anglo-Texan settlers long before late-nineteenth-century reservation confinement in Oklahoma.
after.zh: 十八至十九世纪的北美南部大平原（“科曼奇里亚”），努穆努人（科曼奇）繁育出庞大马骡群，重塑了自阿肯色河延伸至墨西哥北部的野牛狩猎、营帐迁徙与区域外交。原住民学者参与的最新动物考古研究表明，早在1680年普韦布洛起义之前，平原族群的驯马护驹实践已越过新墨西哥向北传播，继而发展为同普韦布洛城镇、法国毛皮商、西班牙总督与得克萨斯移民竞逐交易战马、野牛皮的草原强权，其族群历史亦在十九世纪末迁入保留地后持续绵延。

items.rationale: Cut "This record focuses on..." and integrate the pre-1680 archaeozoological horse evidence directly into the narrative.

before.en:
Lambayeque, also called Sicán, artists on Peru’s north coast made metal vessels, masks and ornaments that connected skilled production with elite display. Thin sheets could be hammered into shapes and patterned from both sides. The composition and surface of an object mattered alongside its form: a gleaming appearance was itself part of how materials communicated status and ritual significance.

A gold funerary mask dated to the ninth–eleventh centuries provides one anchor for this record, while related vessels reveal different techniques and possible uses. Objects removed from archaeological settings cannot always be assigned a complete original biography. Their study nonetheless broadens the regional sequence between Moche and Chimú beyond the names of rulers. Mining, alloying, forming and ceremonial consumption depended on many kinds of labour that an imperial succession chart leaves invisible.
before.zh:
秘鲁北岸的兰巴耶克——亦称西坎——艺术家制作金属器皿、面具和饰品，把熟练生产与精英展示连接起来。薄金属片可被锤打成形，并从正反两面制作纹样。材质组成、表面与形状同样重要：闪耀外观也是材料传达地位及仪式意义的方式。

一件定为九至十一世纪的黄金葬仪面具，为本条提供年代锚点；相关器皿展示不同技术与可能用途。离开出土环境的物品，未必能够复原完整来历，但它们仍使莫切至奇穆之间的区域序列超出统治者名字。采矿、配合金、成形和仪式消费，依赖帝国更替表中看不见的多种劳动。

after.en: Between the fall of Moche centres and the rise of Chimú conquerors (~750–1375 CE), Lambayeque (Sicán) workshops in Peru’s forested Batán Grande valley smelted arsenical copper in wind-drafted furnaces and hammered depleted-gold *tumbaga* sheets into towering inverted-pyramid beakers and winged-eye funerary masks painted with cinnabar. In deep shaft tombs beneath Huaca Loro, elite dead went into the earth wrapped in hundreds of kilograms of gold, silver, Spondylus shell from Ecuador and emeralds from Colombia—mobilizing miners, fuel-cutters, alloy smiths and maritime rafters across the northern Andes.
after.zh: 在莫切衰落与奇穆征服之间（约750—1375年），秘鲁北岸巴坦格兰德林谷的兰巴耶克（西坎）工坊鼓风冶炼砷铜，并将金银铜合金（tumbaga）薄片锤揲成高耸的倒梯形礼杯与涂抹朱砂的飞眼黄金葬仪面具。在洛罗金字塔下的深竖穴墓中，贵族遗骸由重达数百千克的金银器物、厄瓜多尔棘牡蛎壳与哥伦比亚祖母绿层层包裹，凝聚着北安第斯采矿工、伐薪者、冶金匠与航海木筏队的协作劳动。

items.rationale: Replace "provides one anchor for this record" with Batán Grande smelting, tumbaga, Huaca Loro, Spondylus and emeralds.

before.en:
The acceptance of Christianity under Volodymyr in 988 connected Rus’ rulers and religious institutions with Byzantine models of worship, architecture and court display. Kyiv’s Saint Sophia and locally made precious-metal ornaments show that such connections involved adaptation as well as borrowing. Craftspeople produced objects for patrons whose identities and authority were expressed through dress and religious imagery.

This phase should not be read as one centralized state possessing fixed borders for two and a half centuries. It provides a political and cultural frame for a changing princely world, alongside other eastern European centers. The Mongol sack of Kyiv in 1240 marks the end of this entry’s focus, not the disappearance of its people or traditions. Its medieval legacy belongs to several later histories and cannot by itself settle modern national or territorial claims.
before.zh:
988年弗拉基米尔（沃洛德米尔）接受基督教，使罗斯统治者及宗教机构与拜占庭的礼拜、建筑和宫廷展示方式建立联系。基辅圣索菲亚大教堂和当地制作的贵金属饰品表明，这种联系既包括借鉴，也包括改造。工匠为赞助者制作器物，服饰和宗教图像则表现身份与权威。

这一阶段不应被理解为一个拥有两个半世纪固定边界的中央集权国家。它为不断变化的诸王公世界提供政治和文化框架，并与其他东欧中心并列呈现。1240年蒙古军攻陷基辅，是本条关注阶段的终点，不是当地人群和传统的消失。中世纪遗产进入了多种后世历史，不能单独用来裁定现代民族或领土诉求。

after.en: Grand Prince Volodymyr’s baptism and adoption of Eastern Christianity in 988 linked the Rurikid princely dynasty along the Dnieper–Volkhov river routes with Byzantine liturgy, Slavonic literacy and mosaic-lined brick cathedrals such as Kyiv’s Saint Sophia, where local goldsmiths also crafted cloisonné *kolty* pendants for boyar households. Rather than one unitary centralized kingdom, Kyivan Rus’ operated as a contentious federation of rotating princely seats—Kyiv, Novgorod, Chernihiv, Halych, Vladimir-Suzdal—until Batu’s Mongol siege of Kyiv in 1240 shattered the old southern primacy and dispersed its medieval inheritance across distinct East Slavic lands.
after.zh: 988年大公弗拉基米尔（沃洛德米尔）受洗奉行东方基督教，使第聂伯河—沃尔霍夫河商路上的留里克王朝诸公与拜占庭礼仪、斯拉夫文字及镶嵌画砖石教堂相连；基辅圣索菲亚大教堂耸立的同时，本地金匠亦为贵族打造精美的掐丝珐琅耳坠（kolty）。基辅罗斯并非疆界固定的单一集权王国，而是基辅、诺夫哥罗德、切尔尼戈夫、加利奇与弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔诸公国轮替竞逐的联盟；1240年拔都西征攻陷基辅终结了南方宗主旧局，其中世纪遗产此后汇入多支东斯拉夫社会的演进之中。

items.rationale: Remove "marks the end of this entry’s focus" and name the rotating princely cities, kolty enamels, and 1240 siege.

before.en:
Habsburg authority in central Europe grew through inheritance, marriage, election and war. Ferdinand’s acquisition of the Bohemian and Hungarian crowns in 1526 helped form a composite monarchy anchored in the Austrian hereditary lands. Possessing a crown did not ensure uncontested rule over every part of its claimed kingdom, particularly in lands contested with the Ottomans.

Different estates, languages and legal traditions persisted within the ruler’s domains. The dynasty’s imperial role in the Holy Roman Empire overlapped with, but was distinct from, these hereditary possessions. Political integration was a process of bargaining and administrative change rather than the instant creation of one uniform country. The Austrian imperial title adopted in 1804 provides this entry’s terminal transition. Reading the monarchy alongside Ottoman and regional histories clarifies how central Europe’s borders and institutions changed without reducing those histories to one dynasty’s family tree.
before.zh:
哈布斯堡在中欧的权力通过继承、婚姻、选举和战争发展。1526年斐迪南取得波希米亚及匈牙利王冠，推动形成以奥地利世袭领地为基础的复合君主国。拥有王冠，并不表示对所声称王国的全部地区都能实施无争议统治，在与奥斯曼竞争的地区尤其如此。

统治者领地内仍保留不同的等级会议、语言和法律传统。王朝在神圣罗马帝国中的帝位，与这些世袭领地重叠，却并不相同。政治整合是一系列协商和行政变革，并非瞬间建立一个均质国家。1804年采用奥地利帝号，构成本条的阶段转折。把君主国与奥斯曼及各地区历史并读，有助于解释中欧边界和制度如何变化，而不把这些历史缩成一个家族的谱系。

after.en: After Ottoman victory at Mohács killed King Louis II in 1526, Archduke Ferdinand of Austria claimed the elective crowns of Bohemia and royal Hungary alongside his Alpine Habsburg duchies—assembling a central European composite monarchy in which Prague diets, Hungarian county nobles, Croatian estates and Tyrolean assemblies each guarded separate laws, taxes and languages. Distinct from yet bolstered by the dynasty’s near-continuous election as Holy Roman Emperors, Vienna negotiated constantly with provincial estates while fortifying a long military frontier against Ottoman Buda until Francis II proclaimed a hereditary Empire of Austria in 1804.
after.zh: 1526年奥斯曼大军在莫哈奇击杀匈牙利兼波希米亚国王路易二世后，奥地利大公斐迪南承袭波希米亚与皇家匈牙利两顶选举王冠，同阿尔卑斯世袭领地拼合成中欧复合君主国——布拉格等级议会、匈牙利郡县贵族、克罗地亚议会与蒂罗尔领地各自保有独立的法律、税制与语言。这一版图与哈布斯堡家族长期当选的神圣罗马帝国皇位既相重叠又彼此区分，维也纳宫廷一面同各地贵族议价整合行政，一面在漫长军政前线与奥斯曼属布达拉锯，直至1804年弗朗茨二世加称世袭奥地利皇帝。

items.rationale: Remove "provides this entry’s terminal transition" and explain Mohács 1526, provincial diets, Ottoman Buda frontier and 1804.

before.en:
After siege, defeat and an armistice in the Franco-Prussian War, conflict over authority within France produced the Paris Commune. Its brief experiment in municipal government ran from March to May 1871. Public debate and political participation involved workers, journalists, activists and women whose experiences cannot be reduced to the biographies of the movement’s best-known leaders.

Government forces retook Paris during the Bloody Week, with killings, imprisonment and destruction. Contemporary objects, portraits and photographs preserve evidence but also reflect accusation, propaganda and later remembrance. Even estimates of the death toll vary; this entry does not turn one contested number into a precise count. The Commune connects urban hardship, military power and arguments over social government. It also helps explain why later political movements returned to 1871 as an example, a warning or a symbol rather than agreeing on one shared interpretation.
before.zh:
普法战争中的围城、战败和停战之后，法国国内围绕权威的冲突催生巴黎公社。其短暂的市政统治实验从1871年3月延续至5月。工人、记者、活动家和妇女参与公共讨论与政治行动，他们的经验不能缩减为几位知名领袖的传记。

政府军在“流血周”夺回巴黎，伴随杀戮、监禁和破坏。当时的器物、肖像与照片保存证据，也反映指控、宣传和后来的纪念。死亡人数估计仍有差异；本条不把某一争议数字当作精确统计。公社把城市困苦、军事实力与社会治理争论联系起来，也说明后来的政治运动为何不断把1871年视为典范、警示或象征，而非形成单一共识。

after.en: Starved through a four-month Prussian siege during the winter of 1870–1871 and outraged when Adolphe Thiers’s national government at Versailles sent troops on 18 March to seize Montmartre’s National Guard cannon, working-class Parisians elected a radical municipal council—the Paris Commune—that governed the city for seventy-two days. Laundresses, bookbinders, journalists, teachers and feminist organizers such as Louise Michel abolished night bakery labour, separated church and school budgets, remitted wartime rents and turned worker cooperatives loose in abandoned workshops before Versailles troops stormed the barricades during May’s *Semaine sanglante* (“Bloody Week”), executing thousands and sending thousands more to New Caledonia.
after.zh: 经历1870—1871年寒冬普鲁士大军四个月围城断粮之苦后，退驻凡尔赛的梯也尔政府于3月18日派兵收缴蒙马特高地国民自卫军大炮，激起巴黎劳工阶层起义并选出自治市政委员会——巴黎公社，执掌全城七十二天。洗衣女工、装订匠、记者、教师与路易丝·米歇尔等女性组织者废除面包房夜班制、推行政教与学校经费分离、减免战时房租，并将闲置工场交由工人合作社经营；5月下旬凡尔赛政府军在“流血周”攻破街垒，数千至上万公社社员遭处决，另有数千人被流放新喀里多尼亚。

items.rationale: Replace "this entry does not turn..." with Montmartre cannon, bakery/school/rent decrees, Louise Michel, Bloody Week and New Caledonia exile.

before.en:
The Prague Spring opened a period of reform and debate within socialist Czechoslovakia in 1968. Changes in censorship allowed journalists and citizens to discuss subjects that earlier controls had restricted. The movement’s participants did not all seek the same political destination, and reform within socialism should not be equated automatically with a fully formed later constitutional order.

Soviet-led Warsaw Pact troops invaded in August. Radio staff continued news broadcasts from improvised locations after troops occupied their main building, leaving testimony about both coercion and civilian action. Such recollections are evidence of particular experiences rather than a view of every street or institution. The invasion and subsequent restrictions connect the episode with later dissent, including Charter 77 and Václav Havel’s activities. This entry follows communication and everyday political agency alongside the decisions of governments and armies.
before.zh:
1968年的布拉格之春，在社会主义捷克斯洛伐克内部开启改革与讨论。审查制度的变化，使记者和公民得以谈论过去受到限制的话题。参与者并非都追求同一种政治结果，社会主义内部改革也不能自动等同于后来已经成形的宪制秩序。

8月，苏联领导的华约军队入侵。主要广播大楼被占领后，电台人员仍从临时地点播发新闻，留下关于强制与平民行动的证言。这些回忆证明特定经验，并不代表每条街道或所有机构。入侵及其后限制，与后来的异议活动，包括七七宪章及瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔的行动相联系。本条在政府和军队决策之外，也追踪传播与日常政治能动性。

after.en: During the first eight months of 1968 under Alexander Dubček’s reformist leadership, lifted press censorship across socialist Czechoslovakia unleashed spirited public debate in newspapers, factories, theatres and Czechoslovak Radio over civil liberties, economic decentralization and Slovak federal equality. When Soviet-led Warsaw Pact tanks rolled into Prague on the night of 20–21 August and troops stormed the Vinohradská radio headquarters amid unarmed street resistance, technicians and announcers routed clandestine relays through basement studios, provincial transmitters and factory rooms for days—leaving audio testimony that echoed a decade later in Charter 77.
after.zh: 1968年前八个月，在杜布切克改革派领导下，捷克斯洛伐克放宽新闻审查，报刊、工厂、剧场与捷克斯洛伐克广播电台围绕公民权利、经济分权与斯洛伐克联邦对等展开热烈公共讨论。8月20至21日夜，苏联主导的华约装甲部队开进布拉格并强攻广播大楼；面对徒手市民的街头阻拦，电台技师与播音员将线路秘密转入地下室、外省发射台与工厂临时播音间，连续数日向全国播报实况，其公民抵抗记忆在十年后的《七七宪章》运动中再度回响。

items.rationale: Cut "This entry follows..." and highlight Dubček, Vinohradská radio relays, and Charter 77 continuity.

before.en:
In July 1995 Bosnian Serb forces took Srebrenica during the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Bosnian Muslim men and boys were separated, detained and murdered, while women, children and other residents were forcibly removed. The crimes destroyed families and communities; the history cannot be represented adequately as a neutral change of territorial color.

International criminal investigations assembled testimony, forensic evidence and records about the killings and displacement. Judicial findings established genocide, and later identification and remembrance concern people as well as legal categories. This entry draws on court and United Nations accounts while avoiding claims that every victim’s fate or every individual’s responsibility can be summarized by one paragraph. It connects the broader Yugoslav succession entry with a specific experience of civilian targeting. The locality pin identifies a historical setting, not all execution, detention or burial sites.
before.zh:
1995年7月，在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那战争期间，波斯尼亚塞族部队占领斯雷布雷尼察。波斯尼亚穆斯林男性和男孩被分离、拘禁并杀害，妇女、儿童及其他居民则遭强制移走。罪行摧毁家庭与群体，不能仅以中性的领土换色来表达。

国际刑事调查汇集有关杀戮与迁移的证言、法医证据和文书。司法裁判认定种族灭绝；后来的身份确认与纪念既涉及法律类别，也涉及具体的人。本条采用法庭和联合国资料，但不宣称一个段落能够总结每位受害者的命运或每个人的责任。它把更广泛的南斯拉夫继承国家条目，与平民遭到针对的具体经验相连。点位表示历史环境，并非所有处决、拘禁或埋葬地点。

after.en: In July 1995 Bosnian Serb Army forces under Ratko Mladić overran the UN-designated “safe area” of Srebrenica in eastern Bosnia while lightly armed Dutch peacekeepers stood outnumbered and without effective air support. Separating women, young children and elderly residents onto buses toward Bosnian government territory, Bosnian Serb units detained and systematically executed more than 8,000 Bosniak (Bosnian Muslim) men and boys across warehouses, fields and ravines, then bulldozed primary graves into scattered secondary pits—crimes ruled genocide by international courts at The Hague as forensic DNA teams and bereaved mothers fought for decades to identify and rebury each person at Potočari.
after.zh: 1995年7月，姆拉迪奇指挥的波黑塞族部队攻占联合国划定的波斯尼亚东部“安全区”斯雷布雷尼察，驻守当地的荷兰轻装维和营孤立无援。塞族部队将妇女、幼童与老人强行押上巴士驱离，同时拘禁并有系统地屠杀逾八千名波什尼亚克（波斯尼亚穆斯林）成年男子与少年，事后又动用推土机将遗骸挖出转埋至多处二次乱葬坑；海牙国际法庭裁定此役构成种族灭绝罪，法医DNA团队与遇难者母亲群体此后数十年持续辨认遗骸并安葬于波托查里纪念墓园。

items.rationale: Replace "This entry draws on..." and "The locality pin..." with Potočari, secondary graves, Hague genocide rulings and DNA identification.

before.en:
Kaiping’s tower houses connect village security and domestic ambition with migration across oceans.
