Overseas Chinese communities in different destinations helped finance buildings that combined local construction practices with architectural forms encountered abroad. Remittances could become rooms, decorated facades and visible statements about a household’s connections. Migration therefore changed the landscape of home as well as the places where migrants worked.

Diaolou served several purposes: some provided shared refuge, others were residential towers or watchtowers. Those functions should not be collapsed into a single story of wealthy private houses. UNESCO’s selected villages and buildings document an especially prominent late-nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century phase, within longer building traditions. The chosen endpoint is a historical focus rather than a claim that migration or construction ceased in 1937. A representative village location helps readers connect built form, overseas labour and family strategies without inventing a route for every migrant.
before.zh:
开平碉楼把村落安全、居住愿望与越洋迁徙联系起来。分布在不同目的地的华侨群体，资助建造融合本地营造方法与海外所见建筑形式的房屋。侨汇因此转化为房间、装饰立面，以及显示家庭联系的可见标志。迁徙不仅改变侨民工作的地方，也改变家乡景观。

碉楼具有多种用途：有些供共同避难，有些是居住楼或更楼，不能全部压缩成富裕私人住宅的故事。世界遗产选取的村落和建筑，记录了十九世纪末至二十世纪初尤为突出的发展阶段，其背后还有更长的建造传统。1937年是本条关注范围的终点，不表示迁徙或营建就此停止。代表性村落点帮助联系建筑、海外劳动和家庭策略，不虚构每位移民的具体路线。

after.en: Along the low-lying Tanjiang river plain of Kaiping in Guangdong’s Pearl River Delta, families backed by wages and merchant remittances from North American railroads, Southeast Asian tin mines and Pacific ports raised more than 1,800 multi-storey fortified *diaolou* towers peaking between the 1900s and 1930s. Blending rammed earth or imported Portland cement with iron window grilles, gun embrasures, Cantonese ancestral shrines and arcaded domes inspired by arcades seen in San Francisco, Singapore or Manila, these village towers served variously as communal flood-and-bandit refuges (*zhonglou*), night watchtowers and multi-family residences.
after.zh: 在广东珠江三角洲低洼多水的开平潭江平原，依靠北美铁路华工、南洋锡矿商埠与太平洋各港侨汇接济的宗族乡亲，在二十世纪初至三十年代掀起营建高潮，筑起逾一千八百座多层设防碉楼。匠人将夯土或进口红毛泥（波特兰水泥）、铁窗射击孔同岭南祖堂神龛，以及旅外华侨在旧金山、新加坡、马尼拉目睹的拱廊穹顶融于一体，分别充当全村共筹防洪御匪的众楼、夜间报警的更楼与侨眷起居的居楼。

items.rationale: Remove "The chosen endpoint is..." and "representative village location" meta-talk; detail Portland cement, zhonglou/genglou, and overseas remittances.

before.en:
Merv’s history is written across several adjacent walled settlements rather than a single city centre occupied in the same way forever. Within the Murghab oasis, older urban areas stood beside the medieval Sultan Kala. During the eleventh and twelfth centuries, Merv became a major centre of the Great Seljuks, linking imperial authority to an already long history of settlement.

Sultan Kala’s fortifications and the mausoleum of Sultan Sanjar make different uses of urban space visible. Walls organized defence and access, while the mausoleum belonged to a larger religious complex. Brickwork, carved stucco and surviving painted decoration preserve evidence of skilled construction. These structures can support questions about resources and labour, but they do not by themselves identify every worker or reveal the distribution of wealth across the city.

The oasis contains buildings and settlement phases from much earlier and later periods. Their proximity must not collapse those differences into one simultaneous city map. This entry selects the Seljuk urban phase and links it to the dynasty overview, Samarkand and wider Central Asian histories. The ending date is an editorial boundary, not a claim that Merv ceased to exist in 1200.
before.zh:
梅尔夫的历史分布于数座相邻围城，而非一个永远以相同方式使用的城市中心。在穆尔加布绿洲，较早城区与中古苏丹卡拉并列。十一至十二世纪，梅尔夫成为大塞尔柱的重要中心，将帝国权威与早已悠久的聚居史连接起来。

苏丹卡拉的防御设施及苏丹桑贾尔陵墓，呈现城市空间的不同用途。城墙组织防御和出入，陵墓则属于更大的宗教建筑群。砖作、灰泥雕刻及存留彩绘，保留熟练营造劳动的证据。这些结构可以支持关于资源与劳动的问题，却不能独自辨识所有工人，或揭示全城财富分配。

绿洲还有年代远早和远晚于此的建筑及聚居阶段。地理邻近不应把差别压缩成一张同时存在的城市地图。本条选择塞尔柱城市阶段，并与王朝概述、撒马尔罕及更广中亚史相接。结束年份是编辑边界，并非梅尔夫在1200年不再存在。

after.en: Rather than rebuilding on top of a single mound, successive cities in Turkmenistan’s Murghab delta stepped sideways across the oasis—from Bronze Age river settlements and walled Hellenistic-Sassanian Erk Kala and Gyaur Kala to medieval Sultan Kala, which expanded into a 600-hectare imperial metropolis under Great Seljuk rulers Malik-Shah and Ahmad Sanjar in the eleventh and twelfth centuries. Within hollow-towered mudbrick ramparts and suburbs (*rabads*) of potters and steelmakers rose Sultan Sanjar’s vast brick-domed mausoleum, library madrasas where astronomers including Omar Khayyam worked, and canal-fed gardens that thrived well past 1200 until Tolui’s Mongol assault of 1221.
after.zh: 在土库曼斯坦穆尔加布河三角洲绿洲中，历代古城并非叠压于同一废墟之上，而是横向比邻迁移——自青铜时代聚落、希腊化至萨珊时期的埃尔克卡拉与贾乌尔卡拉，延伸至十一至十二世纪在大塞尔柱苏丹马立克沙与桑贾尔治下扩建逾六百公顷的帝国大都会苏丹卡拉。中空马面泥砖城垣与陶匠、坩埚钢工坊云集的外郭之间，耸立着双层砖穹顶的苏丹桑贾尔陵墓及欧玛尔·海亚姆曾驻足治历的书院园林，直至1221年拖雷率蒙古军攻城方遭重创。

items.rationale: Cut "The ending date is an editorial boundary..." and bring out Erk/Gyaur/Sultan Kala, Omar Khayyam, crucible steel and 1221.

before.en:
The carpet associated with the shrine at Ardabil carries an inscription dated 946 in the Islamic calendar, equivalent to 1539–1540. Its large central medallion, paired lamps, surrounding floral patterns and dense wool pile make it evidence of coordinated design and skilled weaving in the Safavid world. The completed object required many acts of work, even though the inscription preserves a single name, Maqsud Kashani.

The Victoria and Albert Museum interprets Maqsud as probably an official responsible for the commission rather than the individual who tied every knot. The inscription’s deferential language should not automatically be treated as proof that he was literally enslaved. Conversely, a named supervisor does not recover the identities or circumstances of the other makers.

The carpet is traditionally linked to the shrine of Shaykh Safi al-Din, an important place for the Safavid dynasty, while its exact origins remain uncertain. The map therefore marks that association at Ardabil, not a verified weaving workshop. Read beside Herat’s manuscripts and Isfahan’s buildings, the object opens questions about patronage and labour across different media without assuming that all court-sponsored arts were made in the same way.
before.zh:
与阿尔达比勒圣陵相关的地毯，带有伊斯兰历946年的铭文，相当于1539—1540年。大型中央团花、成对悬灯、周围花叶图案及密集羊毛绒面，使其成为萨法维世界协调设计与熟练编织的证据。成品需要众多劳动环节，铭文却只保留马克苏德·卡沙尼一个名字。

维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆认为，马克苏德可能是负责委托制作的官员，并非亲自打结的唯一织工。铭文的谦卑措辞，不应自动视作他实际上遭奴役的证明。反过来，主管有名，也无法恢复其他制作者的身份和处境。

地毯传统上与谢赫萨菲丁圣陵相连，该地对萨法维王朝具有重要意义，但其确切起源仍不确定。因此地图标记阿尔达比勒这一关联，而非已核实的织毯作坊。与赫拉特手稿及伊斯法罕建筑并读，此物可以开启不同媒介中的赞助与劳动问题，而不假定所有宫廷资助艺术都以相同方式制作。

after.en: Woven from glossy wool pile on silk warps and wefts with roughly twenty-five million knots across ten and a half metres, the paired carpets associated with the dynastic shrine of Shaykh Safi al-Din at Ardabil bear a woven cartouche dated AH 946 (1539–1540 CE), a couplet by Hafiz, and a single name: Maqsud of Kashan, “slave of the threshold.” As Victoria and Albert Museum curators note, that devotional phrase likely marks the court official who oversaw royal master-drawers, dyers and teams of weavers—probably in Tabriz or Kashan—rather than literal enslavement or a lone artisan tying every knot.
after.zh: 以丝线为经纬、亮泽羊毛打结约两千五百万个、长逾十米的成对巨幅地毯，传统上与萨法维王室祖陵阿尔达比勒谢赫萨菲丁圣祠相连，毯端题记署伊斯兰历946年（公元1539—1540年），织有哈菲兹诗句及唯一人名：自称“圣阈之仆”的卡尚人马克苏德。正如维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆学者所考，这一虔敬自谦称谓应指受命统筹宫廷画样师、染匠与大批织工（工坊或设于大不里士或卡尚）的督造官员，而非字面受奴役者或独自打完千万绳结的单一匠人。

items.rationale: Remove "The map therefore marks..." and weave the 25 million knots, silk warps, Hafiz couplet, and V&A Maqsud analysis together.

before.en:
A volcanic eruption buried the farming settlement now called Joya de Cerén around 600 CE. The preserved buildings and household materials provide an unusual view of everyday life in a Maya community. Instead of beginning with royal monuments, historians can ask how people stored food, cooked, worked and shared spaces.

Excavated remains include houses, storage buildings, kitchens, a sweat bath and structures used for communal purposes. Their arrangement allows comparison between the activities of households and those of a larger settlement. Earthen construction and traces of perishable materials are especially valuable because such evidence often survives less clearly than stone temples or elite tombs.

Burial by ash created a particular archaeological record; it did not freeze every aspect of social life in a form that can be read without interpretation. The relationship between buildings, objects and daily routines still requires careful analysis. Modern discovery and excavation are also separate from the ancient event. This entry centers the village’s occupied landscape before its burial, showing how the history of Mesoamerica can be approached through ordinary productive and domestic spaces as well as the affairs of rulers.
before.zh:
约公元600年，一场火山喷发掩埋了今天称为霍亚德塞伦的农业聚落。保存下来的建筑与家用材料，为理解玛雅社区日常生活提供了少见窗口。历史研究可以从食物储存、烹饪、劳动及共享空间出发，而不仅以王室纪念建筑为起点。

出土遗存包括住宅、仓储建筑、厨房、汗浴房及具有共同用途的建筑。空间安排让人比较家庭活动与更大聚落的关系。土构建筑及易腐材料痕迹尤其珍贵，因为它们往往不像石质神庙或精英墓葬那样容易保存。

火山灰形成了特定考古记录，却没有把社会生活的每个方面都冻结成无需解释的答案。建筑、物品与日常程序之间的关系仍须细致分析。现代发现与发掘也应同古代事件区分。本条关注掩埋前有人生活的村落景观，展示中部美洲历史既可以通过统治者的活动，也可以通过普通生产与家庭空间来理解。

after.en: Around 600 CE a sudden steam-and-ash eruption from the Loma Caldera vent blanketed a Maya farming village in El Salvador’s Zapotitán Valley under metres of tephra—giving villagers just enough warning to flee without a single body found, while sealing thatched wattle-and-daub homes, elevated corn cribs, manioc garden ridges, painted gourds and obsidian blades stacked under eaves. Alongside family sleeping benches and round kitchens stood a domed earthen *temazcal* sweat bath, a village feast-house storing giant cooking vessels, and a shaman-diviner’s structure, revealing how Maya villagers governed daily harvests and ceremony far from stone royal pyramids.
after.zh: 约公元600年，萨尔瓦多萨波蒂坦河谷洛马火山口突发的火山灰喷发将一座玛雅农耕村落掩埋在数米厚的凝灰层下——村民得以仓促撤离而无一人遇难，屋檐下插着的黑曜石刀片、彩绘葫芦、木薯田垄、高架玉米仓与木骨泥墙茅顶房屋却原封留存。在家户睡榻与圆形厨房旁，还分布着土筑穹顶汗浴房（temazcal）、存放大陶釜的村社公宴厅与占卜师居所，展现出远离王室石砌金字塔的玛雅乡村自治与日常生计。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry centers..." and bring alive the Loma Caldera escape, obsidian under eaves, manioc ridges and temazcal sweat bath.

before.en:
Mexico’s student movement of 1968 grew from confrontation with police into a wider demand for political freedoms. Students from institutions including the National Autonomous University and the National Polytechnic Institute organized assemblies and a National Strike Council. Their demands included the release of political prisoners, an end to repression and public dialogue.

The movement created new forms of coordination rather than relying on one charismatic figure. Demonstrations, meetings and communication between schools made participation visible in public space. Military occupation of university facilities in September sharpened the confrontation between students and the state.

On 2 October, forces attacked a gathering at the Plaza de las Tres Culturas in Tlatelolco. The massacre, shortly before the Olympic Games opened in Mexico City, became a lasting point of reference in struggles over state violence and historical memory. The number killed remains disputed; this record does not offer a false exact total. The plaza pin marks the violence, while the wider movement included many institutions, neighbourhoods and people whose experiences cannot be reduced to one day. Ending the date interval in 1968 does not end the history of demands for truth and accountability.
before.zh:
墨西哥1968年的学生运动，从与警察的冲突发展为争取政治自由的更广泛行动。国立自治大学、国立理工学院等机构的学生组织大会与全国罢工委员会。诉求包括释放政治犯、停止镇压及开展公开对话。

运动形成新的协调方式，而非依靠单一魅力领袖。示威、集会与校际交流，使参与在公共空间中变得可见。9月军队占领大学设施，使学生与国家之间的冲突进一步加剧。

10月2日，武装力量袭击特拉特洛尔科三文化广场的集会。屠杀发生于墨西哥城奥运会开幕前不久，成为有关国家暴力与历史记忆斗争的重要参照。死亡人数仍有争议，本条不提供虚假的精确总数。广场点位标示暴力发生地，而更广泛的运动涉及许多院校、街区与个人，不能缩减为一天。1968年的区间结束，也不意味着争取真相与追责的历史结束。

after.en: In the summer of 1968 confrontation between riot police and high-school students in Mexico City swelled into a mass democratic movement led by a horizontal National Strike Council (*CNH*) uniting delegates from UNAM, the National Polytechnic Institute (*IPN*) and dozens of schools demanding freedom for political prisoners, repeal of anti-subversion articles and public negotiations. After the army occupied university campuses in September, thousands of students, families and neighbours gathered on 2 October at the Plaza de las Tres Culturas in Tlatelolco—ten days before the Mexico City Olympics opened—where hidden Olympia Battalion snipers and regular troops opened fire into the trapped crowd, leaving a contested toll of hundreds dead and igniting decades of Mexican struggle against single-party impunity.
after.zh: 1968年夏，墨西哥城防暴警察与中学生的冲突迅速发展为声势浩大的民主运动；来自国立自治大学（UNAM）、国立理工学院（IPN）等数十所院校的代表组成扁平议事的“全国罢课委员会”，要求释放政治犯、废除镇压法条并举行公开对话。9月陆军进占大学校园后，数千名学生、市民与街坊于奥运会开幕前十天的10月2日傍晚聚集在特拉特洛尔科三文化广场，遭到埋伏在公寓高层的“奥林匹亚营”便衣枪手与正规军交叉扫射；这场死伤人数至今存议的血案，成为此后数十年墨西哥社会追索国家暴力真相与打破一党威权的转折记忆。

items.rationale: Replace "The plaza pin marks..." with UNAM/IPN National Strike Council, Olympia Battalion, and Olympic eve context.

before.en:
Phosphate deposits identified on Banaba around 1900 connected a small Pacific island to agricultural production far away. Mining companies, followed by the British Phosphate Commission involving Britain, Australia and New Zealand, removed material used to fertilize farms. The value gained elsewhere depended on profound changes to the islanders’ land.

Extraction, wartime occupation and displacement combined during the twentieth century. Japanese forces occupied the island during the Second World War, and in 1945 Banaban people were relocated to Rabi in Fiji. The move separated many from a damaged homeland while allowing phosphate exploitation to continue. It should not be represented as an uncomplicated voluntary search for a new home.

Banaban writer Hele Christopher-Ikimotu connects this history to family memory and the difficulty of explaining a distinct identity within wider Pacific categories. Such testimony changes the scale of an account otherwise dominated by commodity flows and colonial institutions. The 1945 endpoint marks relocation in this selected history, not the disappearance of Banaban people or the termination of claims to land and identity. The map keeps Banaba visible rather than allowing the destination alone to replace the homeland.
before.zh:
约1900年发现的磷矿，使太平洋小岛巴纳巴与远方农业生产相连。采矿公司及后来由英国、澳大利亚和新西兰参与的英国磷酸盐委员会，开采材料供农场施肥。别处获得的价值，以岛民土地的深刻改变为基础。

二十世纪的开采、战争占领与流离相互交织。第二次世界大战期间日军占领该岛，1945年巴纳巴人被迁到斐济拉比岛。迁移使许多人离开受损家园，同时让磷矿开采继续，不能写成简单自愿寻找新家的故事。

巴纳巴作者赫勒·克里斯托弗—伊基莫图，把这段历史与家庭记忆，以及在更宽泛太平洋分类中解释自身独特身份的困难相连。这样的证词，使通常由商品流通和殖民机构主导的叙述转向人的经验。1945年结束年份标示本条关注的迁离，不是巴纳巴人的消失，也不意味着土地与身份诉求终结。地图保留巴纳巴家园的位置，而非让迁入地取代家园。

after.en: After British prospector Albert Ellis tested a coral-rock doorstop in Sydney in 1900 and found pure guano phosphate from Banaba (Ocean Island), mining syndicates and the tri-government British Phosphate Commission (Britain, Australia and New Zealand) stripped away nearly ninety percent of the six-square-kilometre equatorial island’s surface soil to fertilize Australian and New Zealand pastures, leaving jagged limestone pinnacles behind. Following brutal Japanese wartime occupation and deportation during 1942–1945, colonial authorities shipped surviving Banabans 3,000 kilometres away to Rabi Island in Fiji so open-cast mining could run until 1979—a dispossession kept alive in Banaban elders’ songs, lawsuits and writers such as Hele Christopher-Ikimotu.
after.zh: 1900年英国勘探商阿尔伯特·埃利斯在悉尼化验一块用作门挡的珊瑚岩，发现赤道小岛巴纳巴（大洋岛）富藏高纯度鸟粪磷矿；此后采矿公司及英、澳、新三国共管的“英国磷酸盐委员会”掘走全岛六平方公里近九成的表土，制成化肥滋养澳新牧场，仅留下嶙峋裸露的石灰岩尖柱。经历1942—1945年日军残酷占领与强征离散后，殖民当局将幸存巴纳巴人迁往三千公里外的斐济拉比岛，以便露天采矿继续运转至1979年；赫勒·克里斯托弗-伊基莫图等巴纳巴后裔至今仍以著述与跨国诉讼守护故岛身份与土地权利。

items.rationale: Cut "The 1945 endpoint marks..." and "The map keeps..." meta-lines; tell the doorstop discovery, limestone pinnacles, Rabi relocation and 1979 mining story directly.

before.en:
The translation bureau established under Akbar in 1574 belonged to a wider system of imperial book production. Translation required interpreters of different linguistic and religious traditions; producing a luxury manuscript also required scribes, painters, illuminators and binders. The finished object could unite words, images and materials that had passed through many hands.

Persian served an expanding administrative and literary audience. The translation of Babur’s memoirs from Turki, completed under Abd al-Rahim’s supervision in 1589, made a dynastic ancestor’s account accessible to readers who no longer understood its original language. Sanskrit works also entered Persian manuscript culture. The process was selective: a court decided what to commission, how to frame it and which books merited costly illustration.

This makes translation both an intellectual encounter and an exercise of patronage. Surviving pages show collaboration across regional artistic traditions, but many have been separated from their original volumes. A detached painting cannot by itself recover every translator’s contribution or the full conditions of its production. The entry follows the institutional phase of Akbar’s reign; bookmaking and translation continued under later rulers.
before.zh:
阿克巴于1574年设立的翻译机构，属于更广泛的皇家书籍生产体系。翻译需要熟悉不同语言与宗教传统的人；豪华抄本还需要抄写员、画师、装饰匠和装订匠。成品把经过多人之手的文字、图像与材料结合起来。

波斯语服务于不断扩展的行政与文学读者。阿卜杜勒·拉希姆主持的巴布尔回忆录译本于1589年完成，使已经不懂原文突厥语的读者能够阅读王朝先祖的记述。梵文作品也进入波斯语抄本文化。这一过程具有选择性：宫廷决定委托哪些作品、如何解释，以及哪些书值得配置昂贵插图。

因此，翻译既是知识相遇，也是赞助权力的运用。存世书页展示不同地区艺术传统的合作，但许多已与原卷分离。一幅散页画作不足以恢复每位译者的贡献或完整生产条件。本条聚焦阿克巴在位时的机构发展；后继统治者时期仍有翻译和制书活动。

after.en: When Emperor Akbar founded his *Maktab Khana* (translation bureau) at Fatehpur Sikri in 1574, multilingual teams pairing Sanskrit pandits with Persian court stylists rendered the *Mahabharata* (*Razmnama*), *Ramayana* and mathematical treatises into Persian, while Abd al-Rahim Khan-i-Khanan presented a lavishly illustrated Persian translation of Babur’s Chagatai Turkic memoirs (*Baburnama*) in 1589. Each royal codex passed from papermakers, gold-leaf beaters and *nastaliq* scribes to Hindu and Muslim master painters who signed individual folios—a collaborative book-arts tradition sustained across Shah Jahan’s and Dara Shikoh’s courts even after dealers later dismembered many albums into scattered museum leaves.
after.zh: 1574年莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴在法泰赫布尔西格里设立皇家译书院（Maktab Khana），组织通晓梵文的班智达与波斯文词臣合译《摩诃婆罗多》（波斯名《战书》）、《罗摩衍那》及算学典籍；1589年重臣阿卜杜勒·拉希姆又主持将王朝始祖巴布尔的察合台突厥文回忆录译成彩绘波斯文《巴布尔纪》。每部御制抄本皆经造纸匠、打金箔工、悬体书法家与签署姓名的印度教及穆斯林画师接力完成，并在沙贾汗与达拉·舒科时代延续光大，尽管不少画册后世遭拆散流落各地博物馆。

items.rationale: Remove "The entry follows..." and name Maktab Khana, Razmnama, Baburnama, nastaliq scribes and Dara Shikoh.

before.en:
Mahendralal Sircar founded the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science in Calcutta in 1876. Public contributions helped sustain an institution intended to make experimental scientific work possible locally. Its early Bowbazar setting belongs to a history of laboratories, lectures and support networks within colonial India, rather than a story in which scientific knowledge only arrived from elsewhere.

C. V. Raman began research there outside his government working hours in 1907. The association provided continuity for experiments that later included the study of light scattering. In 1928 Raman and K. S. Krishnan identified a small component of scattered light whose colour differed from the incident beam. Filters, increasingly effective light sources and spectroscopic measurement turned an observation into a reproducible scientific result.

The institution matters alongside the celebrated discovery. Instruments, time, collaborators and an audience for publication were necessary parts of the work. The later uses of Raman spectroscopy should not obscure those modest experimental arrangements. This entry ends at the 1928 research milestone; the association continued thereafter and later moved to Jadavpur. Its map point therefore identifies the earlier urban setting, not the modern campus.
before.zh:
马亨德拉拉尔·西尔卡尔于1876年在加尔各答创立印度科学培育协会。公众捐助帮助维持这一机构，使本地实验研究成为可能。其早期鲍巴扎尔地点，属于殖民时期印度的实验室、讲座与支持网络史，而不是科学知识只从外部传入的单向故事。

1907年起，拉曼在政府工作之外利用协会开展研究。机构为持续实验提供条件，其中后来包括光散射研究。1928年，拉曼与克里希南识别出散射光中颜色不同于入射光的一小部分。滤光片、更有效的光源及光谱测量，使观察成为能够重复检验的科学结果。

机构与著名发现同样重要。仪器、时间、合作者以及发表成果的读者，都是研究所需的条件。后来拉曼光谱的用途，不应掩盖早期较为有限的实验配置。本条以1928年的研究节点结束；协会此后继续存在，并迁往贾达夫普尔。因此地图点位标示早期城市环境，并非现代校园。

after.en: Determined that Indian researchers should run experiments in self-governed laboratories rather than remain subordinate clerks in colonial surveys, Calcutta physician Mahendralal Sircar raised Indian public subscriptions to open the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science (*IACS*) on Bowbazar Street in July 1876. Starting in 1907, young finance official C. V. Raman arrived before dawn and stayed late at night in Bowbazar’s modest lecture-laboratory; on 28 February 1928 Raman and collaborator K. S. Krishnan used focused sunlight, complementary optical filters and a pocket spectroscope to isolate inelastic wavelength shifts in liquids—the “Raman effect” that won Asia’s first science Nobel Prize in 1930 before IACS later outgrew Bowbazar for Jadavpur.
after.zh: 立志让印度学者在自主管理的实验室开展研究、摆脱殖民调查局附庸地位的加尔各答医师马亨德拉拉尔·西尔卡尔，募集本土公众捐款，于1876年7月在鲍巴扎尔街创办“印度科学培育协会”（IACS）。1907年起，年轻的财政部职员拉曼每天清晨上衙前与深夜下班后赶赴协会实验室钻研声学与光学；1928年2月28日，拉曼与合作者克里希南利用聚焦日光、互补滤光片与分光镜捕捉到液体散射光中的波长频移（拉曼效应），摘得亚洲首个自然科学诺贝尔奖，协会后亦迁址贾达夫普尔持续发展。

items.rationale: Cut "This entry ends at..." and "Its map point therefore..." meta-talk; vividly tell Sircar’s 1876 vision and Raman/Krishnan’s 28 Feb 1928 sunlight spectroscope experiment!

before.en:
The independence mobilization of 1919 produced several Korean provisional-government initiatives, including bodies associated with Shanghai, Seoul and the Russian Far East. Their coordination and consolidation required negotiation; a single unified institution did not simply appear fully formed on the day of the March First demonstrations.

Shanghai became an important centre for an assembly, an interim charter, offices and fundraising networks. Documents and photographs preserved by the National Institute of Korean History show the material work behind a claim to national representation: rented premises, overseas contributions, printed constitutional rules and named officeholders. The organization could articulate a republic without exercising ordinary governmental control over Korea under Japanese rule.

War later displaced the government through China, and its Chongqing phase included the Korean Liberation Army in 1940. Members returned after Japan’s defeat in 1945, but their exile institutions did not automatically become an internationally accepted government of the whole peninsula. Subsequent occupation and division created different political circumstances. The point marks the initial Shanghai setting, not sovereign Korean territory in China. This entry follows the exile phase and leaves constitutional succession claims distinct from demonstrated control on the ground.
before.zh:
1919年的独立动员产生了多个韩国临时政府倡议，包括与上海、首尔及俄国远东相关的组织。协调与整合需要谈判，不能认为三一示威当日就突然出现完整而统一的机构。

上海成为议会、临时宪章、行政职务与筹款网络的重要中心。韩国国史编纂委员会保存的文件和照片，展示国家代表权主张背后的具体工作：租用办公地点、接受海外捐助、印刷宪制规则以及安排任职人员。组织能够提出共和国方案，却无法正常治理日本统治下的朝鲜半岛。

战争后来迫使政府在中国境内迁移，重庆阶段包括1940年组织韩国光复军。日本战败后，成员于1945年返回，但流亡机构并未自动成为国际认可的全半岛政府。此后的占领与分裂带来不同政治条件。点位标示最初的上海环境，不表示中国境内存在韩国主权领土。本条聚焦流亡阶段，并把宪制继承主张与可证实的实际控制区分开来。

after.en: Out of the mass March First Movement of 1919 against Japanese colonial rule emerged rival provisional Korean assemblies in Vladivostok, Seoul and Shanghai’s French Concession, which negotiated a unified Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea in Shanghai by September 1919 with a democratic provisional charter, legislative assembly, newspaper (*Tongnip Sinmun*) and diaspora bond drives. Forced across inland China after Japanese escalation in the 1930s, the cabinet reached wartime Chongqing and organized the Korean Liberation Army in 1940—though Allied occupation zones after August 1945 denied its returning leaders recognition as a sovereign peninsula-wide government.
after.zh: 1919年抗击日本殖民统治的“三一运动”浪潮中，海参崴、汉城与上海法租界先后涌现临时政权倡议，并于同年9月在上海整合为大韩民国临时政府，颁布民主临时宪章、设立临时议政院、印行《独立新闻》并向海外韩侨募集独立公债。1930年代日军侵华升级后，临时政府辗转内迁至战时陪都重庆，于1940年组建韩国光复军；1945年8月日本战败后成员虽归国，美苏分区占领格局却未承认其为全半岛合法政府。

items.rationale: Remove "The point marks..." and "This entry follows..." meta-prose; tell the 1919 Shanghai consolidation, Chongqing move, and 1945 return directly.

before.en:
Barasoain Church in Malolos became a setting for revolutionary institution-building when a congress convened there in September 1898. Under Pedro Paterno’s presidency, delegates debated the political order emerging from the struggle against Spanish rule. A religious building thus acquired a civic function in a rapidly changing situation.

The Malolos Constitution, chiefly drafted by Felipe Calderón, was among the assembly’s principal measures. The church is also associated with the inauguration of the First Philippine Republic. These acts show that independence involved efforts to define public authority and create institutions, not only declarations or battles. Producing a constitution, however, did not by itself secure acceptance abroad or effective authority throughout the archipelago.

The congress’s documented use of the church continued into February 1899, as conflict with the United States transformed the conditions in which the republic operated. This entry focuses on the assembly and its setting rather than duplicating the wider Philippine–American War. The surviving historical marker records a later commemoration of those events; its claims should be distinguished from the text of the constitution and from contemporary records of individual debates, which remain separate research tasks.
before.zh:
1898年9月，国会在马洛洛斯的巴拉索阿因教堂召开，使这里成为革命机构建设的场所。佩德罗·帕特诺主持会议，代表们讨论反抗西班牙统治后形成的政治秩序。在快速变化的局势中，一座宗教建筑获得公民政治功能。

主要由费利佩·卡尔德隆起草的《马洛洛斯宪法》，是议会的重要成果之一。教堂也与菲律宾第一共和国的成立典礼相关。这些行动说明，独立还包含界定公共权威与创设机构的努力，不只是宣言或战斗。然而，制宪本身并不能保证国外承认，也不能确保对整个群岛的实际权威。

有记录的国会使用教堂时期延续到1899年2月，当时同美国的冲突改变了共和国运作条件。本条聚焦议会及其空间，不重复更广泛的美菲战争条目。存世历史标志记录的是对事件的后世纪念；应将其陈述同宪法原文及具体辩论的同时代记录区分，后两者仍是独立研究任务。

after.en: In September 1898 ninety-plus Filipino delegates convened inside Barasoain Church at Malolos, Bulacan, under assembly president Pedro Paterno to turn anti-Spanish victory into constitutional government. Rejecting Apolinario Mabini’s call for wartime executive emergency powers, legislators adopted Felipe Calderón’s parliamentary Malolos Constitution—separating church and state by a single vote—and inaugurated the First Philippine Republic under Emilio Aguinaldo in January 1899, just two weeks before fighting erupted with United States forces outside Manila.
after.zh: 1898年9月，九十余名菲律宾代表齐聚布拉干省马洛洛斯的巴拉索阿因教堂，在议长佩德罗·帕特诺主持下为反西独立战争后的新国家制定宪章。代表们未采纳马比尼主张的战时强力行政方案，而是通过卡尔德隆起草的议会制《马洛洛斯宪法》（其中政教分离条款以一票之差惊险过关），并于1899年1月宣告阿奎纳多领导的菲律宾第一共和国成立；仅两周后，马尼拉城外便爆发美菲战争。

items.rationale: Cut "This entry focuses on..." and "surviving historical marker" meta-talk; add Mabini vs Calderón and the one-vote church-state vote!

before.en:
The Hundred Years War is a later label for a series of conflicts between rulers of England and France and their allies. Rival claims to the French crown overlapped with disputes over lands and obligations. The conventional span, 1337–1453, includes truces and changes in alliance, not a single continuous campaign. Scotland and Burgundy, among other powers, complicate a story told only as two modern nations fighting.

Royal legitimacy depended on more than battlefield outcomes. Joan of Arc’s 1429 campaign helped bring Charles VII to coronation at Reims, while her subsequent trial at English-held Rouen made religious judgment part of political conflict. Weapons and armour in museum collections show aspects of fighting, but cannot by themselves describe every civilian experience. This entry connects dynastic politics to the separate biographies and to the Black Death’s overlapping chronology without assuming that plague explains every military change.
before.zh:
“百年战争”是后人为英格兰、法国统治者及其盟友之间的一系列冲突所加的名称。对法国王位的竞争，与土地和效忠义务的争议相互重叠。通常使用的1337—1453年范围包含休战与联盟变化，并非一次连续战役。苏格兰、勃艮第等势力的参与，也使其不能简单归结为两个现代民族国家的对抗。

王权的正统性并不只取决于战场结果。贞德1429年的战役帮助查理七世在兰斯加冕，而她随后在英方控制的鲁昂受审，又使宗教裁判成为政治冲突的一部分。博物馆中的武器和盔甲展示战斗的某些方面，却无法独自说明所有平民的经历。本条连接王朝政治、人物生平，以及时间上重叠的黑死病，但不把瘟疫视作每次军事变化的统一解释。

after.en: Spanning 1337 to 1453 across truces, chevauchées and shifting alliances with Burgundy, Brittany, Scotland and Castile, the dynastic struggle later called the Hundred Years War pitted Plantagenet and Lancastrian kings of England against Valois rulers of France over Gascon fiefs and the French succession. Longbow victories at Crécy, Poitiers and Agincourt repeatedly shattered French chivalry amid the demographic shock of the Black Death, yet Joan of Arc’s 1429 relief of Orléans, Charles VII’s coronation at Reims—followed by Joan’s heresy trial and burning in English-held Rouen—and French siege artillery ultimately drove English garrisons from all continental holdings save Calais.
after.zh: 横跨1337至1453年、其间穿插多次休战与勃艮第、苏格兰、卡斯蒂利亚盟约倒戈的“百年战争”，源于英格兰金雀花及兰开斯特王室与法兰西瓦卢瓦王室围绕加斯科涅封地及法王继承权的争夺。在黑死病人口剧减的阴影下，英军虽凭长弓战术在克雷西、普瓦捷与阿让库尔屡挫法军重骑，但1429年贞德解奥尔良之围促成查理七世在兰斯加冕（贞德旋即在英占鲁昂受宗教审判殉难），加之法军攻城火炮革新，终将英军逐出除加来以外的欧洲大陆领地。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry connects..." and replace generic fighting remarks with Gascony, Crécy/Agincourt, Orléans/Rouen, and artillery.

before.en:
Alexander II’s 1861 reform changed the legal position of privately owned serfs in the Russian Empire. Freedom and access to land were related but different questions. Arrangements for allotments, compensation and continuing obligations meant that emancipation could not be understood simply as an immediate transfer of unrestricted property.

A U.S. diplomatic report written in 1865 describes payments, government loans and local variation, while strongly praising the emperor. It is useful evidence of how a foreign observer explained the reform, but its optimism should not be mistaken for the voices of all former serfs. This entry separates the legal turning point from the longer history of rural resources and dependency. Shevchenko’s earlier purchase of individual freedom provides a related personal story; it was not the same mechanism as the 1861 settlement.
before.zh:
亚历山大二世1861年的改革改变了俄罗斯帝国私人领主所属农奴的法律地位。获得自由与取得土地是相互关联却不同的问题。份地、补偿和继续承担义务的安排，意味着农奴解放不能简单理解为立即获得不受限制的财产权。

1865年美国外交官的一份报告描述了付款、政府贷款与地方差异，同时高度赞扬皇帝。它有助于了解一名外国观察者如何解释改革，但其乐观态度不能代表所有获释农奴的声音。本条区分法律上的转折点与更长期的农村资源和依附关系。舍甫琴科此前通过赎身获得个人自由，提供了相关的个人故事，却并非1861年改革所采用的同一种机制。

after.en: Shaken by defeat in the Crimean War and mounting peasant unrest, Tsar Alexander II issued the Emancipation Manifesto of 1861 freeing more than twenty million privately held serfs from personal bondage to Russian nobles without making them unencumbered landowners. Former serfs had to shoulder forty-nine-year state redemption mortgages for often shrunken land allotments managed collectively through the village commune (*mir*), keeping rural households tied to tax arrears and labour obligations—a stark contrast both to glowing foreign diplomatic dispatches of the 1860s and to rare earlier individual buy-outs such as poet Taras Shevchenko’s 1838 manumission.
after.zh: 受克里米亚战争惨败与农奴骚动震动，沙皇亚历山大二世于1861年颁布解放法令，解除俄罗斯帝国两千余万私属农奴对贵族领主的人身依附，却并未无偿赋予其独立土地产权。获释农民须背负长达四十九年的国家赎买贷款以换取往往遭削减的份地，且受村社（米尔）连带管束与欠税劳役牵制——这一农村现实既不同于1860年代部分外国使节笔下的乐观颂词，也异于诗人舍甫琴科1838年由友人集资赎买个人自由的个案。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry separates..." and explain the 49-year redemption payments and village mir directly.

before.en:
The Representation of the People Act 1918 admitted some women to the United Kingdom’s parliamentary electorate, but it did not create equal voting rights. Women had to be at least thirty and meet specified qualifications. Younger women were excluded, while the male franchise extended much more widely. Wartime electoral problems and long-running suffrage organizing formed part of the setting for reform.

In 1928 the Equal Franchise Act put women on the same voting basis as men at twenty-one. The ten-year gap matters because a milestone labelled only “women win the vote” conceals who still lacked it. The legislation addressed parliamentary voting; it should not be taken to mean that every inequality in public life ended, or that subjects throughout the British Empire received identical rights. A link to New Zealand’s earlier suffrage history invites comparison without assuming that reform followed one universal sequence.
before.zh:
1918年的《人民代表法》允许部分女性加入英国议会选民行列，却没有建立平等的投票权。女性必须至少三十岁并符合特定资格；较年轻的女性仍被排除，而男性选举权的范围扩大得更多。战时选举问题和长期争取女性参政的组织活动，共同构成改革的背景。

1928年的《平等选举权法》使女性与男性一样，以二十一岁为投票年龄基础。这十年的间隔十分重要，因为仅标注“女性获得投票权”，会掩盖仍然被排除的人群。法律处理的是议会投票问题，不表示公共生活中的所有不平等都已终结，也不表示大英帝国各地臣民获得了同样权利。关联的新西兰较早的参政史邀请读者进行比较，但不假定各地改革沿着同一条普遍路线发展。

after.en: After decades of constitutional petitions, militant suffragette hunger strikes and mass wartime industrial service, Britain’s Representation of the People Act 1918 abolished property tests for men aged twenty-one while restricting women’s parliamentary ballots to those aged thirty and over who met local property or university-graduate rules—leaving millions of young working-class munitionettes and shopworkers disenfranchised. Ten more years of lobbying closed that gap in the Equal Franchise Act 1928, granting women parliamentary votes on the same age-twenty-one terms as men across the United Kingdom, thirty-five years after New Zealand’s 1893 reform and while most subjects across Britain’s colonies still lacked self-government.
after.zh: 历经数十年宪政请愿、妇女参政派绝食抗争及一战期间大规模工厂服役，英国1918年《人民代表法》取消了年满二十一岁男性的财产资格限制，却规定女性须年满三十岁且符合房产或大学学位条件方可参加议会投票，将数百万年轻劳工女性挡在选民册外。又经十年奔走，1928年《平等选举权法》方使英国女性与男性同享二十一岁普选权——此时距新西兰1893年开创女性选举权已逾三十五年，而大英帝国广袤殖民地的多数民众仍未获自治与普选。

items.rationale: Cut "A link to New Zealand’s earlier suffrage history invites comparison..." and state the 1918/1928/1893/empire contrast directly.

before.en:
The publication of Efuru in 1966 and Women Are Different in 1986 frame a selected period in Nigerian literary production. Between them, Flora Nwapa combined writing with public work and founded publishing ventures that issued adult fiction and books for children. The institutional question was how stories would be produced and circulated, as well as who could appear within them.

Tana Press and Flora Nwapa Books provided channels for her work beyond the acceptance of a manuscript by an overseas publisher. Children’s stories drew on folktales, while adult fiction examined urban life, war, marriage and women’s economic choices. These books addressed different readers; a publishing catalogue was not one uniform message or a census of women’s lives.

The surviving reference accounts disagree over whether Tana began in 1974 or 1976. This entry retains that disagreement instead of manufacturing an exact foundation date. The 1966–1986 focus is a literary sequence, not the company’s lifespan. It connects Nwapa’s biography to the practical work of making books available, without claiming that owning a press removed every commercial or gender barrier.
before.zh:
1966年《埃富鲁》与1986年《女人各不相同》的出版，构成尼日利亚文学生产的一段观察窗口。在这期间，弗洛拉·恩瓦帕兼顾写作与公共工作，并创办出版企业，发行成人小说和儿童读物。问题不仅是谁能进入故事，也包括故事如何制作并流通。

塔纳出版社与弗洛拉·恩瓦帕图书公司，使她的作品不只依靠海外出版者接收稿件。儿童故事吸取民间传说，成人小说则考察城市生活、战争、婚姻和女性的经济选择。不同书籍面向不同读者；出版目录不是单一宣言，也不是女性生活的普查。

已读参考资料对塔纳始创于1974还是1976年存在分歧，本条保留分歧，不制造确切创办年。1966—1986年是文学序列，并非公司存续时间。它把个人生平与制作、传播图书的实际工作连接起来，但不声称自办出版社就消除了所有商业或性别障碍。

after.en: When Heinemann in London published *Efuru* in 1966, Nigerian novelist Flora Nwapa became the first African woman internationally published in English fiction—yet after serving in East Central State reconstruction cabinets following the Biafran war, she grew determined not to rely solely on European gatekeepers for African readers. Founding Tana Press and Flora Nwapa Books in Enugu in the mid-1970s (sources place Tana’s start in either 1974 or 1976), she commissioned local illustrators, ran distribution networks for folk-rooted children’s picture books, and issued adult novels through *Women Are Different* (1986) examining marriage, wartime survival and women’s urban enterprise.
after.zh: 1966年伦敦海涅曼出版社印行《埃富鲁》，使尼日利亚作家弗洛拉·恩瓦帕成为首位在国际出版英文长篇小说的非洲女性；比夫拉内战结束后参与地方重建政务的经历，更促使她立志摆脱非洲文学对海外出版商的单一依赖。1970年代中期（史料对其始创年份分记为1974或1976年），她在埃努古自创塔纳出版社与弗洛拉·恩瓦帕图书公司，延请本土插画师印行取材民间故事的童书，并陆续推出至《女人各不相同》（1986）等探讨婚姻、战乱求生与城市女性经济独立的小说。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry retains..." and "The 1966–1986 focus is..." meta-talk while preserving the 1974/1976 source discrepancy cleanly.

before.en:
Radio and theatrical performance helped bring Jamaican speech into a wider public cultural life. Louise Bennett’s BBC work during her 1945–1946 studies and again in 1950 connected Caribbean performance with audiences in Britain. These broadcasts accompanied, rather than created, the oral traditions and linguistic knowledge on which her work depended.

Back in Jamaica after 1955, she combined drama work with teaching, writing and village visits through the Welfare Commission. The stage and microphone made it possible to work with humour, characters and familiar ways of speaking beyond a printed page. Her later Miss Lou’s Views programme, documented for 1965–1982, joined performance to social observation in Jamaican Patois.

This history concerns access to cultural authority: a language used in households and communities could also carry literature and public commentary. It should not be read as a single person’s invention of Jamaican language, or proof that broadcasting removed linguistic hierarchy. The surviving letters, programme references and personal papers let readers compare institutional descriptions with the practical work of performers and educators. Recording and preservation shaped which voices remain available to later listeners.
before.zh:
广播与戏剧表演使牙买加语言进入更广泛的公共文化生活。路易丝·贝内特1945—1946年求学期间及1950年在BBC的工作，把加勒比表演带给英国观众。这些节目依托已有口头传统与语言知识，并非创造它们。

1955年返乡后，她把戏剧工作同教学、写作及福利委员会的村庄访问结合起来。舞台与麦克风使幽默、人物及熟悉的说话方式能够超越纸面传播。资料所记1965—1982年的《露阿姨的见解》，以牙买加帕托瓦语把表演与社会观察联系起来。

这段历史涉及文化权威的获得：家庭与社区所用的语言，也能承载文学和公共评论。它不应被理解为一人发明牙买加语言，或广播已消除语言等级。保存的通信、节目介绍与私人文书，让读者比较机构描述及表演者、教育者的具体劳动。录音与保存方式，也影响哪些声音能供后来听众聆听。

after.en: Trained at London’s Royal Academy of Dramatic Art in 1945–1946, poet and performer Louise Bennett-Coverley (“Miss Lou”) hosted *Caribbean Carnival* on BBC radio before returning home to Jamaica in 1955 to teach drama, tour rural villages for the Jamaica Social Welfare Commission, and celebrate the wit and proverb craft of everyday Jamaican Patois (*Patwa*). From 1965 to 1982 her crisp radio monologues on *Miss Lou’s Views* brought household speech—long dismissed by colonial schools as “broken English”—onto national airwaves as sharp literary and social commentary.
after.zh: 1945—1946年赴伦敦皇家戏剧艺术学院深造的牙买加诗人与戏剧家路易丝·贝内特-科弗利（“露阿姨”），曾在英国广播公司主持《加勒比嘉年华》，1955年归国后投身戏剧教学并随社会福利委员会深入乡村采风，发掘日常牙买加克里奥尔语（帕托瓦语）中的机锋与谚语智慧。1965至1982年间，她主讲的电台专栏《露阿姨的见解》将长期被殖民学堂贬斥为“蹩脚英语”的市井母语带上全国广播，化作犀利诙谐的文学与社会评论。

items.rationale: Remove "It should not be read as..." and "Recording and preservation shaped..." boilerplate; foreground Miss Lou’s BBC and Jamaica radio voice.

before.en:
In 2018 Pacific Islands Forum leaders adopted the Boe Declaration on Regional Security in Nauru. It placed climate change at the centre of a broad security agenda, alongside human welfare, environmental and resource protection, transnational crime and cybersecurity. This framing made livelihoods and the conditions of community life part of regional diplomacy, without removing members’ concerns about sovereignty and external coercion.

The declaration built on earlier Forum agreements and called for national security strategies, training, information sharing and better coordination. Its commitments belonged to the leaders collectively. They should not be attributed to Meg Taylor as a personal invention, although her Secretariat leadership helped explain and organize the regional programme.

Leaders endorsed an action plan in 2019 in Tuvalu. Taylor launched it in Suva that October, describing specific activities and a process for annual review. Adoption and launching are documented institutional steps; they do not demonstrate that every activity was funded, completed or effective. Comparing the declaration with the action-plan speech helps readers distinguish a political definition of security from the practical work required to carry it into national and regional institutions.
before.zh:
2018年，太平洋岛国论坛领导人在瑙鲁通过《博埃区域安全宣言》。宣言把气候变化置于广义安全议程中心，同时涵盖人的福祉、环境与资源保护、跨国犯罪及网络安全。这种表述让生计和社区生活条件进入区域外交，同时保留成员对主权及外部胁迫的关切。

宣言承接较早的论坛协议，提出国家安全战略、培训、信息共享及协调工作。承诺属于领导人的集体决定，不应说成梅格·泰勒的个人发明；不过她领导秘书处，参与解释与组织这项区域议程。

领导人2019年在图瓦卢认可行动计划；泰勒同年10月在苏瓦主持发布，介绍具体活动及年度审议安排。认可与发布是有据可查的制度步骤，不证明每项活动已获资助、完成或有效。把宣言与发布演说对读，可以区分政治上如何定义安全，以及将其落实到国家与区域机构所需的实际工作。

after.en: Meeting on Nauru in September 2018 while Dame Meg Taylor headed the Pacific Islands Forum Secretariat, eighteen Forum leaders adopted the Boe Declaration on Regional Security—declaring that climate change constitutes the single greatest threat to the livelihoods, security and wellbeing of the peoples of the Pacific alongside human security, ocean resource stewardship, transnational crime and cyber resilience. Followed in 2019 by an implementation action plan endorsed in Tuvalu and launched by Taylor in Suva, the collective accord reframed diplomacy from narrow military geopolitics toward island survival while leaving long-term climate financing and emissions cuts contested on the global stage.
after.zh: 2018年9月，在梅格·泰勒主持太平洋岛国论坛秘书处期间，各成员领导人在瑙鲁共同通过《博埃区域安全宣言》，明确宣告气候变化是威胁太平洋各国人民生计、安全与福祉的首要生存危机，并将人的安全、海洋资源护育、跨国犯罪防治与网络安全一并纳入广义安全议程。2019年图瓦卢峰会核准行动计划并由泰勒在苏瓦正式发布，使岛屿社区的存续条件成为区域外交核心，尽管后续资金落实与全球减排博弈依然任重道远。

items.rationale: Cut "Comparing the declaration with the action-plan speech helps readers..." and state the Nauru 2018 / Tuvalu-Suva 2019 diplomacy directly.

before.en:
Seitō’s first issue appeared on 1 September 1911. The women who edited and published it included Hiratsuka Raichō, Yasumochi Yoshiko, Mozume Kazuko, Kiuchi Teiko and Nakano Hatsuko. Treating the magazine as a collective makes visible the work behind a manifesto: selecting writing, assembling issues and creating a readership for women’s words.

Literary work became a means of discussing social authority. The magazine broadened its attention to relationships, sexuality and women’s autonomy, while translations brought writers from outside Japan into local debate. These connections did not erase differences among contributors or turn the magazine into the voice of every Japanese woman. Access depended on literacy, circulation and the ability to withstand public criticism.

Schools prohibited reading it, and authorities seized some issues as threats to public morals. Those responses show how the regulation of print could constrain a new discussion space. The selected early-years window is editorial, rather than a claim that the journal closed in 1915. This record follows the production and reception of a publication alongside Hiratsuka’s life, inviting comparison with education and other women’s writing already represented in the atlas.
before.zh:
《青鞜》创刊号于1911年9月1日出版。参与编辑和发行的女性包括平塚雷鸟、保持研子、物集和子、木内锭子与中野初子。把杂志视为集体事业，就能看到宣言背后的工作：选择作品、编排期刊，并为女性文字建立读者群。

文学由此成为讨论社会权威的途径。杂志逐渐关注亲密关系、性及女性自主，通过翻译把日本以外的作者引入本地讨论。这些联系并未消除作者之间的分歧，也不使杂志自动成为所有日本女性的声音。阅读机会取决于识字、流通及承受社会批评的能力。

一些学校禁止学生阅读，当局也以有碍公共道德为由没收部分期刊。这些反应显示，出版管制会约束新出现的讨论空间。所选早期年份是编辑观察窗口，并非声称杂志于1915年停刊。本条将出版物的制作与接受过程同平塚的生平并读，并与图谱已有的教育及女性写作条目进行比较。

after.en: Opening its first issue on 1 September 1911 with Hiratsuka Raichō’s declaration, “In the beginning, woman was truly the sun,” the Tokyo literary journal *Seitō* (*Bluestocking*) was edited, financed and distributed by a women’s collective co-founded with Yasumochi Yoshiko, Mozume Kazuko, Kiuchi Teiko and Nakano Hatsuko. Moving rapidly from poetry and translations of Henrik Ibsen and Ellen Key to candid essays by contributors including Itō Noe and Yosano Akiko on arranged marriage, chastity, abortion and sex work, *Seitō* drew girls’-school bans and Home Ministry police seizures before folding in early 1916.
after.zh: 1911年9月1日在东京创刊的女性文艺杂志《青鞜》，卷首刊出平塚雷鸟名句“元始，女性实为太阳”，由平塚与保持研子、物集和子、木内锭子、中野初子共同发起编辑与发行。刊物很快从诗歌及易卜生、爱伦·凯译介，拓展至与谢野晶子、伊藤野枝等人围绕包办婚姻、贞操观、堕胎与娼妓制度的激烈论辩，屡遭女校禁读与内务省以“妨害风俗”查扣没收，直至1916年初停刊。

items.rationale: Remove "The selected early-years window is editorial..." and quote Raichō’s famous opening while naming Itō Noe, Yosano Akiko and 1916 closure!

before.en:
Champlain’s maps were products of encounters and compilation. The 1613 Ottawa River journey reveals how geographic information moved through interpreters and political relationships. Nicolas de Vignau’s report about reaching a northern sea was challenged by the Algonquin leader Tessouat. The Dictionary of Canadian Biography leaves the report’s exact truth unresolved. Tessouat’s refusal to guide the French onward also protected control of a strategic portage and the trade passing through it.

Printed maps combined personal observations with other navigators’ work and information supplied by Indigenous people. The 1616 map incorporated recent inland journeys, while the 1632 Paris publication presented a larger geographical and colonial account. Naming features was part of claiming places; a map could serve royal negotiation and promotion as well as orientation.

The subject is therefore the movement and appropriation of knowledge, not another account of Québec’s founding or a general fur-trade overview. Indigenous leaders could disclose information, withhold access and redirect a visitor’s plans. At the same time, French publication gathered diverse contributions under one author’s name. These records support questions about whose knowledge became visible in print. They do not provide a surveyed reconstruction of every journey or authorize new territorial outlines for the atlas.
before.zh:
尚普兰的地图来自接触与汇编。1613年的渥太华河之行显示，地理信息通过译员和政治关系流动。尼古拉·德·维尼奥声称到达北方海洋，阿尔冈昆领袖泰苏阿对此提出质疑。《加拿大人物传记辞典》并未认定报告的确切真伪。泰苏阿拒绝继续带领法国人前进，也维护了对关键陆上转运道及其贸易的控制。

印刷地图把个人观察、其他航海者的成果与原住民提供的信息结合。1616年地图纳入最近的内陆旅行，1632年的巴黎出版物则呈现更广的地理与殖民叙述。为地物命名也是主张地方的方式；地图既可供定向，也可服务王室谈判和宣传。

本条关注知识的流动与占用，而非再次叙述魁北克建城或概括整个毛皮贸易。原住民领袖能够提供信息、拒绝通行并改变来访者计划。同时，法国出版把不同人的贡献汇入一位作者名下。这些记录支持追问：谁的知识在印刷品中变得可见？它们并不构成每次旅行的实测重建，也不授权图谱绘制新的领土轮廓。

after.en: When Samuel de Champlain paddled up the Ottawa River in 1613 hoping to verify interpreter Nicolas de Vignau’s tale of a quick route to the northern sea, Kichesipirini Algonquin chief Tessouat confronted Vignau at Morrison Island, exposed contradictions in his story, and refused French canoes guides past the strategic Allumette portage—protecting Algonquin toll control over interior trade. Champlain’s celebrated 1616 and 1632 Paris maps thus compiled Algonquin, Wendat and Montagnais geographic drawings and seasonal river intelligence alongside French compass bearings, translating Indigenous diplomatic disclosures and refusals into printed royal claims.
after.zh: 1613年萨缪尔·德·尚普兰溯渥太华河而上，欲核实译员维尼奥所谓通往北海捷径的报告，却在莫里森岛遭阿尔冈昆首领泰苏阿当面质证戳穿（《加拿大人物传记辞典》对维尼奥行踪真伪仍存疑），泰苏阿并拒绝派向导带法方越过关键水陆转运口岸，成功捍卫了部族对内陆商道的关税控制。尚普兰随后于1616年及1632年在巴黎刻印的地图，实将阿尔冈昆、温达特等原住民绘制的水系图与口授地理情报同法方罗盘测绘汇编于一纸，在印刷品上把原住民的选择性告知转化为法兰西王室的领土宣示。

items.rationale: Remove "The subject is therefore..." and "authorize new territorial outlines for the atlas" while keeping the DCB Vignau nuance intact!

before.en:
Saskatchewan’s medical insurance developed through several institutions and stages. The 1947 hospital plan covered hospital services; extending public insurance to physicians’ services raised another set of political and administrative questions. Experience in the Swift Current health region brought residents and providers together around a broader services plan, but a province-wide proposal faced organized medical opposition.

The CCF campaigned on public medical insurance in 1960. A bill was introduced in October 1961 and became law in November, after Tommy Douglas had left the premiership. Woodrow Lloyd’s government therefore carried the programme through its most visible confrontation. The programme took effect on 1 July 1962, when doctors began a withdrawal of services. Government and medical representatives negotiated, while community clinics offered another way to organize access.

Agreement was reached on 23 July 1962. That settlement belongs to a history of financing, professional autonomy, electoral decisions and collective organization. It cannot be reduced to one leader announcing a benefit, nor should hospital insurance and physician-service coverage be treated as the same milestone. The selected window connects an earlier hospital foundation to the contested provincial implementation. Later federal legislation and the development of coverage across Canada require their own chronology; this record does not establish that all barriers to care disappeared in 1962.
before.zh:
萨斯喀彻温的医疗保险通过多个机构和阶段发展。1947年的计划覆盖医院服务；将公共保险扩展到医生服务，则提出另一组政治与行政问题。斯威夫特卡伦特卫生地区的经验，让居民和服务提供者围绕更广的服务计划合作，但全省推广面对有组织的医疗界反对。

合作平民联盟在1960年选举中主张公共医疗保险。法案1961年10月提出，11月成为法律，当时汤米·道格拉斯已离开省长职位。因此，伍德罗·劳埃德政府带领制度经历最显著的冲突。方案于1962年7月1日生效，医生同日开始撤出服务。政府与医疗代表展开谈判，社区诊所则提供另一种组织就医服务的方式。

1962年7月23日达成协议。该安排属于筹资、专业自主、选举决定及集体组织的历史，不能缩减为一位领袖宣布福利；医院保险与医生服务保险也不应视作同一节点。所选时段从早期医院保险基础延伸至有争议的省级实施。后来的联邦立法与全加拿大覆盖发展另有时间线；本条不证明所有就医障碍都在1962年消失。

after.en: Building on Saskatchewan’s 1947 public hospital insurance and pioneer prepaid municipal plans in the Swift Current region, the Co-operative Commonwealth Federation campaigned in 1960 to extend universal tax-funded coverage to doctors’ bills, enacting the Saskatchewan Medical Care Insurance Act in November 1961 just as Tommy Douglas handed the premiership to Woodrow Lloyd. When the law took effect on 1 July 1962, the provincial College of Physicians and Surgeons staged a bitter twenty-three-day doctors’ strike while citizens’ groups opened cooperative community clinics and British mediators helped broker the Saskatoon Agreement of 23 July 1962—securing North America’s first universal public medical-care plan.
after.zh: 在萨斯喀彻温省1947年公立住院保险及斯威夫特卡伦特卫生区预付医疗试点的基础上，合作平民联盟（CCF）于1960年省选中主打全民公费医疗，并于1961年11月汤米·道格拉斯卸任省长、伍德罗·劳埃德接棒之际通过《医疗保险法》。1962年7月1日新法生效当天，省医师公会发起长达二十三天的罢诊抵制，居民团体则自发筹建社区合作诊所接应病患，最终于7月23日达成《萨斯卡通协议》，确立了北美首个覆盖门诊医师服务的全民公共医保制度。

items.rationale: Remove "this record does not establish..." and vividly narrate the 23-day doctors’ strike, community clinics and Saskatoon Agreement.

before.en:
The Marathon of Hope began near St John’s on 12 April 1980 as a planned coast-to-coast run for cancer research. Its public reach was built unevenly. Some Newfoundland communities offered support early, while the team encountered places where publicity and arrangements were limited. Terry Fox’s running depended on Doug Alward’s driving, his brother Darrell’s assistance, and practical help from many people along the way.

Charity organizers, business supporters and journalism widened the audience. The Canadian Cancer Society’s Bill Vigars and Toronto Star journalist Leslie Scrivener helped bring the campaign to public attention in Ontario. Such work connected a moving team with local gatherings, donations and a national media audience.

When Fox stopped near Thunder Bay on 1 September 1980, fundraising continued. A CTV telethon followed on 7 September, and by 1 February 1981 the campaign had reached his goal of roughly one dollar per Canadian. Fox died that June; the first annual Terry Fox Run took place later in 1981. The original run, the subsequent fundraising drive and later recurring events are connected but distinct stages. This record examines the organization behind an enduring public campaign, without drawing an invented complete route or treating money raised as a measured clinical outcome.
before.zh:
希望马拉松于1980年4月12日在圣约翰斯附近起跑，计划为癌症研究从一海岸跑向另一海岸。其公众影响并非同步形成。纽芬兰部分社区很早提供支持，团队也遇到宣传与接待安排不足的地方。特里·福克斯的长跑依赖道格·阿尔沃德驾车、弟弟达雷尔协助，以及沿途许多人的实际帮助。

慈善组织者、企业支持者与新闻报道扩大了受众。加拿大癌症协会的比尔·维加斯及《多伦多星报》记者莱斯利·斯克里夫纳，帮助运动在安大略获得公众关注。这些工作把流动团队与地方聚会、捐款及全国媒体受众连接起来。

福克斯1980年9月1日在桑德贝附近停跑后，募款仍持续。CTV于9月7日举办电视募款节目；到1981年2月1日，运动已达到大致每位加拿大人一元的目标。福克斯同年6月去世，首届年度特里·福克斯长跑于1981年稍后举行。原始长跑、后续募款与后来定期活动相互联系，却是不同阶段。本条考察持续性公共运动背后的组织工作，不虚构完整路线，也不把募得款项当作已测量的临床成效。

after.en: Dipping his prosthetic right leg into the Atlantic near St John’s, Newfoundland, on 12 April 1980, twenty-one-year-old cancer amputee Terry Fox set out to run a marathon a day across Canada for cancer research while friend Doug Alward drove their camper van and brother Darrell joined along the road. Early stretches through wind and rain drew sparse roadside crowds until grassroots volunteers, Canadian Cancer Society organizer Bill Vigars and *Toronto Star* reporter Leslie Scrivener carried the story nationwide across Quebec and Ontario. Forced to stop outside Thunder Bay on 1 September 1980 after 5,373 kilometres when osteosarcoma returned to his lungs, Fox saw a national telethon and public donations surpass his goal of one dollar for every Canadian—over $24 million—by February 1981, months before his death that June and the launch of the annual Terry Fox Run.
after.zh: 1980年4月12日，因骨肉瘤截去右腿的二十一岁青年特里·福克斯在纽芬兰圣约翰斯将义肢浸入大西洋海水，开启每天跑完一个马拉松里程横跨加拿大的“希望马拉松”，由好友道格·阿尔沃德驾驶宿营车相伴、弟弟达雷尔随后加入。起跑初期风冷人稀，直至沿途城镇义工、癌症协会组织者比尔·维加斯与《多伦多星报》记者莱斯利·斯克里夫纳的跟踪报道令全国动容。9月1日跑至安大略桑德贝城外（累计5373公里）时，癌细胞扩散双肺迫使他停下脚步，但全国电视义演与民众捐款接力推进，于1981年2月突破他许下的“每位国民捐一元”心愿；同年6月福克斯病逝后，一年一度的特里·福克斯义跑传承至今。

items.rationale: Cut "This record examines..." and "measured clinical outcome" meta-prose; tell the St John’s to Thunder Bay 5,373 km story directly.

before.en:
Later histories place Xia before Shang and associate its foundation with Yu the Great. The Met’s chronology lists Xia as unconfirmed, around 2100–1600 BCE. Those are conventional labels for the tradition, not independently established reign years.

The archaeological evidence asks a different question. Erlitou, near present-day Yanshi, preserves an urban center with large buildings, tombs and early bronze work. The museum describes a selected urban phase around 1700–1500 BCE and treats its possible connection with Xia cautiously. The cultural sequence and the named dynasty cannot simply be equated.

This entry pairs the transmitted dynasty sequence with an independently described archaeological place. It does not draw a Xia frontier, identify every Erlitou resident as a subject of Xia, or give the tradition the same evidentiary status as the inscriptions from late Shang Yin Xu.
before.zh:
传世史书将夏置于商以前，并把其建立与大禹相连。大都会博物馆年表把夏明确标为“未证实”，约前2100—前1600年。这是用于讨论传统的约定年代，不是已经独立确立的在位年数。

考古材料回答另一类问题：今偃师附近二里头有大型建筑、墓葬与早期青铜器。博物馆选述其约前1700—前1500年的城市阶段，并谨慎讨论可能的夏关联。考古文化序列不能直接等同于有名字的王朝。

本条将传世王朝次序与独立描述的考古地点并读，不绘制夏的边界，不把二里头所有居民认定为夏的臣民，也不把夏传统与晚商殷墟铭刻赋予相同证据地位。

after.en: Classical histories from Sima Qian’s *Shiji* onward place a hereditary Xia dynasty founded by flood-tamer Yu the Great ahead of the Shang, though museums such as the Metropolitan Museum list Xia (conventionally c. 2100–1600 BCE) as textually unconfirmed by contemporary writing. Near Yanshi in the Yi–Luo river basin of Henan, archaeologists excavating Erlitou (flourishing c. 1700–1500 BCE) uncovered rammed-earth palace enclosures, grid roadways, turquoise-inlaid dragon emblems and China’s earliest piece-mould bronze ritual vessels (*jue*)—revealing an unmistakable early state centre whose exact relationship to the named Xia house remains open in the absence of self-identifying inscriptions like late Shang oracle bones at Anyang.
after.zh: 自司马迁《史记》以来的传世文献将大禹开创的世袭夏朝置于商代之前，而大都会艺术博物馆等学术年表则将夏（习用约公元前2100—前1600年）标为尚无同时代自铭文字证实的传统纪年。在河南洛阳盆地偃师二里头遗址（兴盛于约公元前1700—前1500年），考古发掘揭露出井然的路网、夯土宫城基址、绿松石龙形器及中国最早的块范法青铜礼器（爵），展现出早期广域王权都邑的规模；但在缺乏晚商安阳殷墟甲骨文那样的自名文字之前，二里头考古文化与传世“夏”王族的对应关系仍留待审慎辨析。

items.rationale: Remove "This entry pairs..." and explain Sima Qian/Met convention, Erlitou palaces/turquoise dragon/bronze jue, and Anyang contrast directly.

before.en:
The iron pieces driven into a Mangaaka figure are traces of repeated encounters with a community. Such figures served as witnesses to vows and agreements and as instruments through which specialists addressed disputes. A sculptor made the wooden body; a nganga prepared and installed charged materials, and ritual action gave the assembled work its social role.

The Met's example, dated about 1880–1900, still carries ironwork but has lost parts of its original contents and attachments. Conservation studies compare wood, resins and other substances across related figures. Looking at materials therefore changes the question from “Who carved this?” to “Who helped make and use it?” The object connects Kongo authority with collective practice, while its altered condition reminds us that a museum sculpture is only part of the original ensemble.
before.zh:
钉入曼加卡像的铁件，留下了群体多次参与的痕迹。这类像见证誓言与约定，也让仪式专家借以处理争端。雕刻者制成木身，恩甘加专家配制、安置具有灵力意义的材料，再通过仪式使整件作品发挥社会作用。

大都会博物馆的此例约作于1880—1900年，仍保留铁件，却已失去部分原有内容物与附件。保护研究通过比较相关作品的木材、树脂等物质，重建制作方式。于是问题从“谁雕刻它”扩展为“谁参与制作和使用它”。这件作品把刚果地区的权威与集体实践相连，其改变后的状态也提醒人们，博物馆中的雕像只是原来组合的一部分。

after.en: Towering over a metre tall with hands braced on hips and chin thrust forward in judicial resolve, a Kongo *nkisi n’kondi* figure of the *Mangaaka* type enforced binding contracts, treaties and anti-harm oaths along the Chiloango River coast in late-nineteenth-century West-Central Africa. First sculpted in wood by a master carver (*ntadi*), the figure gained legal and spiritual force only when a ritual specialist (*nganga*) packed medicinal bundles (*bilongo*) into its resin-sealed belly cavity and litigants drove iron blades, wedges and nails into its torso to seal each sworn dispute—leaving surviving examples, like an 1880–1900 *Mangaaka* in the Metropolitan Museum stripped of its original raffia and medicine pack, bristling with dozens of communal iron pledges.
after.zh: 高逾一米、双手叉腰、下颌前探呈威严裁断之姿的刚果“曼加卡”威力雕像（nkisi n’kondi），在十九世纪末中非西部奇洛安戈河沿岸用于公证盟约、契约与止害誓言。木雕匠人先雕出躯干，再由仪式专家“恩甘加”将圣药包封入腹部树脂腔穴赋予灵力；每逢排解重大争端或缔结誓约，当事人便将铁刃、铁楔或长钉砸入木身立证——大都会艺术博物馆所藏一件约1880—1900年的曼加卡雕像虽已散失原有的拉菲草裙与腹腔药包，躯干上密布的铁件仍记录着昔日社群一次次庄严的公共盟誓。

items.rationale: Replace "Looking at materials therefore changes the question..." with how carver, nganga, bilongo and iron nails sealed Kongo oaths.

before.en: Hypatia taught mathematics and Neoplatonic philosophy in Alexandria, a city where intellectual, civic, and religious authority overlapped. Her students included Christians as well as people who shared her philosophical commitments. Surviving letters from Synesius reveal the respect a pupil could feel for her learning. Her own writings are poorly preserved: later references connect her to mathematical and astronomical commentaries, but precise claims about individual inventions or discoveries exceed the evidence. She was killed in 415 amid conflict involving the city’s prefect and patriarch. Her history is therefore both an account of scholarship and a lesson in how limited sources can become surrounded by powerful modern legends.
before.zh: 希帕蒂娅在亚历山大教授数学与新柏拉图主义哲学，当地的学术、公民和宗教权威彼此交织。她的学生包括基督徒，也包括认同其哲学立场的人。西奈修斯留存的书信显示学生对她学识的敬重。她的著作保存不佳，后世记录把她与数学和天文学注释联系起来，但把具体发明或发现归给她，常超出证据。415年，她在涉及城市长官与主教的冲突中遇害。她的经历既是学术史，也提醒我们有限史料如何被现代传说包围。

after.en: Daughter of the Alexandrian mathematician Theon, Hypatia lectured publicly in late-fourth- and early-fifth-century Alexandria on Plato, Aristotle, Diophantus’s algebra and Ptolemaic mathematical astronomy, drawing devoted Christian and pagan pupils alike—among them future bishop Synesius of Cyrene, whose letters ask her guidance on building an astrolabe and a hydrometer. Although none of her treatises survive intact behind later romantic legends of lone inventions, contemporary accounts agree that her standing as confidante to imperial prefect Orestes amid his bitter power struggle with Patriarch Cyril cost her life during Lent of 415, when a Christian mob dragged her from her carriage into the Caesareum church and murdered her.
after.zh: 作为亚历山大港数学家席恩之女，希帕蒂娅在四世纪末至五世纪初公开讲授柏拉图与亚里士多德哲学、丢番图代数学及托勒密数理天文学，门下汇聚基督徒与多神教徒学子——日后出任主教的昔兰尼人西奈修斯便在存世书信中向她请教星盘与比重计制作。她的原著虽未完整传世（后世文学常附会超出史料的孤立发明传说），但她作为帝国埃及长官奥雷斯特斯的座上智囊，卷入长官与亚历山大宗主教区利罗的激烈权力冲突，终在415年四旬斋期间被狂热暴徒拦车拖入凯撒里昂教堂残忍杀害。

items.rationale: Replace "a lesson in how limited sources..." with Theon, Diophantus/Ptolemy commentaries, Synesius’s astrolabe letters, Orestes and Cyril.

before.en: Known by a court nickname rather than a securely recorded personal name, Murasaki Shikibu wrote The Tale of Genji and a diary of Heian court life. She belonged to a lesser branch of the Fujiwara family and entered the service of Empress Shōshi around 1006. Her fiction examines relationships, status, time, and loss within an aristocratic society. It is an imaginative work, not a literal record of every court custom. Her diary offers another perspective on the conditions in which she wrote. The uncertainty surrounding the beginning and completion of Genji also reminds readers that major works can emerge through revision rather than a single dated act of creation.
before.zh: 紫式部以宫廷称呼留名，个人本名并无可靠记录。她写下《源氏物语》以及记述平安宫廷生活的日记。她出身藤原氏的旁支，约1006年进入彰子皇后的宫廷服务。小说在贵族社会中探讨关系、地位、时间与失去，是文学想象，而非每一项宫廷习俗的逐字记录。日记则提供她写作环境的另一种视角。《源氏物语》的起止创作时间并不明确，也提醒读者重要作品可能历经修订，而非诞生于一个可精确标定的时刻。

after.en: Born into a scholarly middle-ranking branch of the Fujiwara clan whose father sighed that her command of classical Chinese outshone her brother’s, the writer remembered by her court sobriquet Murasaki Shikibu entered Heian-kyō palace service around 1005–1006 as lady-in-waiting and tutor to young Empress Shōshi. Writing primarily in supple Japanese *kana* circulated chapter by chapter in bound booklets among aristocratic readers—and therefore revised over years without a single publication date—her fifty-four-chapter *Tale of Genji* traced desire, political marriage, seasonal mono no aware and generational sorrow across four reigns, while her surviving *Murasaki Shikibu Nikki* cast a wry, observant eye over court pageantry and literary rivals.
after.zh: 出身擅长汉学的中层贵族藤原氏旁支（其父曾叹惜她通晓汉籍胜过兄弟）、以宫廷女房名号“紫式部”传世的女作家，约于1005—1006年入平安京后宫侍奉年轻的中宫彰子。她以细腻灵动的假名文字写成五十四帖长篇小说《源氏物语》，当年以册页传抄形态在贵族读者间分卷流布、历经多年增订而无单一付梓日，在四代宫廷更迭中深描权门联姻、情爱执念与世事无常；其存世《紫式部日记》则以冷峻敏锐的笔触记下宫闱盛典背后的拘谨与同侪评骘。

items.rationale: Remove "reminds readers that major works..." and bring forward her Chinese learning, booklet circulation, Shōshi’s salon, and diary voice.

before.en: José Rizal was a physician and writer whose novels challenged abuses in the Spanish colonial Philippines. Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo exposed the relationships between power, education, religion, and social hierarchy through fiction. Exile in Dapitan did not end his public work; his life continued to connect medicine, teaching, and reform. Colonial authorities executed him in Manila in 1896. His death gave his writings new political force, although his own reformist position should not be treated as identical to every revolutionary programme that followed. Reading Rizal as both an author and a historical actor opens questions about censorship, empire, language, and the changing meaning of national heroes.
before.zh: 何塞·黎刹是一位医生与作家，其小说批判西班牙殖民统治下菲律宾的弊端。《不许犯我》和《起义者》通过文学揭示权力、教育、宗教与社会等级的关系。流放达皮丹并未结束其公共活动，他继续把医学、教学与改革联系起来。殖民当局于1896年在马尼拉处决他。他的死亡赋予作品新的政治影响，但不应把其改革立场等同于后来所有革命纲领。把黎刹同时视为作家与历史行动者，可以思考审查、帝国、语言，以及民族英雄含义的变化。

after.en: Trained as an ophthalmologist in Madrid, Paris and Heidelberg so he could restore his mother Teodora Alonso’s sight, Filipino polymath José Rizal turned European print shops into instruments of anticolonial critique with *Noli Me Tangere* (Berlin, 1887) and *El Filibusterismo* (Ghent, 1891)—dissecting friar land estates, racial humiliation and the dilemmas of peaceful reform versus armed revolt. Banished to Dapitan in Mindanao in 1892 after founding the civic *La Liga Filipina* in Manila, he built a town water system, ran a free clinic and school, and collected biological specimens before Spanish military judges executed him by firing squad at Bagumbayan on 30 December 1896, galvanizing an independence revolution far more radical than the parliamentary reforms he had personally advocated.
after.zh: 为治愈母亲眼疾赴马德里、巴黎与海德堡专攻眼科学的菲律宾博学者何塞·黎刹，在柏林与根特相继印行小说《社会毒瘤》（《不许犯我》，1887）与《起义者》（1891），犀利剖析西班牙修会庄园专横、种族歧视以及和平改良与武装起义的困局。1892年在马尼拉创立公民团体“菲律宾同盟”后即遭流放棉兰老岛达皮丹，他在谪居地修筑竹木引水渠、免费行医办学并采集自然标本；1896年12月30日殖民军法处将其枪决于马尼拉巴贡巴扬刑场，反而激起远超他生前宪政改良主张的全民族武装独立革命。

items.rationale: Remove "opens questions about censorship..." and add ophthalmology, Berlin/Ghent novels, La Liga Filipina, Dapitan waterworks and Bagumbayan 1896.

before.en:
Njinga ruled in a central African world transformed by Portuguese military expansion and the Atlantic traffic in enslaved people. After becoming ruler of Ndongo in 1624, she used diplomacy, religious affiliation and changing military alliances to defend political room for herself and her followers. Matamba became an important base, and relations with both Portuguese and Dutch powers were part of her strategy.

Her resistance to conquest should not be converted into a modern abolitionist biography. The commercial order in which she operated also involved slave trading and coercion. Holding these facts together explains the choices available to a seventeenth-century ruler more accurately than a simple heroic or villainous portrait. Accounts of her legitimacy and actions also differ with the purposes of their authors. The entry focuses on her political career through 1663 and connects it with Kongo, Lunda and the later colonial history of Angola.
before.zh:
恩津加统治的中非世界，受到葡萄牙军事扩张及大西洋被奴役者贸易的改变。1624年成为恩东戈统治者之后，她通过外交、宗教归属与变化的军事联盟，为自己和追随者争取政治空间。马坦巴成为重要基地，与葡萄牙及荷兰势力的关系也属于其策略。

不能把她抵抗征服的经历改写成现代废奴主义传记。她所处的商业秩序也包含奴隶贸易和强制。将这些事实并置，比简单的英雄或反派形象更能解释十七世纪统治者的选择。作者目的不同，对其合法性与行动的记载也有差异。本条关注她至1663年的政治生涯，并同刚果王国、隆达及后来安哥拉殖民史相连。

after.en: First entering history in 1622 at Luanda when—as envoy for her brother—she famously seated herself eye-to-eye with the Portuguese governor on a kneeling attendant’s back after he denied her a chair, Njinga Mbandi became *ngola* (ruler) of Ndongo in 1624 amid relentless Portuguese slave-raiding wars in west-central Africa. Driven inland, she conquered Matamba in the early 1630s, adopted Imbangala *kilombo* military initiation, allied with the Dutch West India Company when it seized Luanda in 1641, and later negotiated Capuchin Catholic diplomacy with Rome—deploying tributary slave trading as well as sanctuary for runaway soldiers to preserve Ndongo–Matamba’s sovereignty until dying undefeated in her eighties in December 1663.
after.zh: 1622年奉兄命赴罗安达谈判时，面对葡萄牙总督故意不设客座的羞辱，恩津加·姆班迪泰然坐上随从脊背与总督平视论理；1624年她在葡军疯狂掠奴的战火中继任恩东戈统治者（恩戈拉）。被迫东撤内陆后，她于1630年代初攻取马坦巴建立新基，吸纳伊姆班加拉军事营垒制度，1641年联手夺占罗安达的荷兰西印度公司夹击葡军，晚年又借重嘉布遣会修士与罗马教廷通使周旋——在十七世纪残酷的大西洋奴隶贸易格局中兼施武装庇护与商业折冲，捍卫恩东戈—马坦巴主权直至1663年12月以八旬高龄善终。

items.rationale: Replace "The entry focuses on..." with the iconic 1622 Luanda embassy, Matamba, Imbangala tactics, 1641 Dutch alliance, and complex sovereignty.

before.en:
Nana Asma’u was a scholar, poet and educator in the Sokoto world. She wrote in Arabic, Hausa and Fulfulde for different audiences, showing how language choice could link formal scholarship, teaching and relationships within a ruling circle. Her poetry was not only literary expression: it also transmitted religious and ethical knowledge, including to rural women.

Her work opens a history of education beyond the image of a school as a single permanent building. Texts, teachers, recitation and social networks could carry knowledge across communities. Modern study of her writings depends on manuscripts and the work of researchers including Jean Boyd, whose collections also have their own archival history. Reading Asma’u beside the caliphate makes women’s intellectual agency visible without assuming that one exceptional biography describes every woman’s access to education. Her life also connects political reform to the practical labor of teaching and remembering.
before.zh:
娜娜·阿斯玛乌是索科托世界的学者、诗人和教育者。她面向不同听众使用阿拉伯语、豪萨语和富拉语，显示语言选择如何连接正式学术、教学以及统治圈内部关系。诗歌不仅是文学表达，也传播宗教和伦理知识，包括面向乡村妇女的教学。

她的工作打开了超越固定校舍形象的教育史。文本、教师、吟诵与社会网络可以跨社区传递知识。今天研究其作品，依靠抄本以及让·博伊德等研究者的工作，而这些收藏本身也有档案史。将阿斯玛乌与哈里发国并读，可以看见妇女的知识行动，却不能假设一位杰出人物代表所有妇女接受教育的机会。她的生涯也把政治改革同教学和记忆的实际劳动相连。

after.en: Daughter of Sokoto founder Usman dan Fodio and twin sister in a household steeped in Saharan Islamic scholarship, Nana Asma’u (1793–1864) composed more than sixty surviving poetic, historical and medical works across Arabic, Hausa, Fulfulde and Tamajaq—switching metre and tongue so court jurists and non-literate village women alike could memorize history, law and prophetic ethics aloud. Beginning around 1830 she organized the *Yan Taru* (“The Associates”), training older women leaders (*jajis*) marked by distinctive *malfa* straw hats to walk outward across northern Nigerian villages teaching women and girls in their own compounds, a decentralized network documented through family manuscripts preserved into the twentieth century.
after.zh: 作为索科托哈里发国创建者奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥之女，成长于西非学术世家的娜娜·阿斯玛乌（1793—1864）用阿拉伯语、豪萨语、富拉语与图阿雷格语留下六十余篇诗作、史诗与医药训诫，依受众切换韵律与语种，使朝廷法学家与不识字的乡村妇女皆能借吟诵记取历史、教法与伦理。约1830年起她创立“扬塔鲁”（女学伴）教育网络，培训头戴标志性草帽的女导师（jaji）徒步走访尼日利亚北部各村落，深入家户庭院向妇女与女童传授学问，打破了学校必囿于砖墙学舍的成规。

items.rationale: Remove "without assuming that one exceptional biography..." and bring out Yan Taru, jajis, malfa hats and four languages!

before.en:
Born in Martinique under French colonial rule, Frantz Fanon trained as a psychiatrist and became a writer and participant in anticolonial politics. His work connected racial experience, language, mental life and political domination. Black Skin, White Masks, published in 1952, and The Wretched of the Earth, published in 1961, belong to different moments of a developing argument rather than forming a single timeless statement.

His work in Algeria and involvement with the FLN placed clinical questions beside the violence of colonial rule and liberation struggle. Later diplomatic and intellectual activity connected him with other African movements. Fanon’s arguments about violence and decolonization remain subjects of interpretation and criticism; a short biography should not turn them into instructions or assume that he spoke for every colonized population. Classifying this entry with Africa marks the Algerian and continental political phase while retaining his Caribbean origin and the wider routes through which his ideas developed.
before.zh:
弗朗茨·法农生于法国殖民统治下的马提尼克，受训成为精神科医生，后来参与反殖民政治并从事写作。他将种族经历、语言、精神生活与政治支配相连。1952年的《黑皮肤，白面具》和1961年的《全世界受苦的人》，属于思想发展中的不同阶段，而非同一套不变宣言。

在阿尔及利亚工作及参与民族解放阵线，使临床问题同殖民统治和解放斗争中的暴力并置。后来的外交与思想活动又连接其他非洲运动。其关于暴力和非殖民化的论述仍需解释和批评；短传不能把它们改成行动指令，也不能假定他代表每个被殖民群体。本条归入非洲，标记阿尔及利亚及大陆政治阶段，同时保留其加勒比出身与思想发展的广泛路径。

after.en: After slipping out of Vichy-controlled Martinique as a teenager to fight with Free French forces in North Africa and Europe, Frantz Fanon studied medicine and psychiatry in Lyon, publishing *Black Skin, White Masks* in 1952 on how colonial racism fractures language and selfhood. Appointed head of the psychiatric ward at Blida-Joinville Hospital in French-ruled Algeria in 1953, he reformed ward chains into social therapy before resigning in 1956 as treating traumatized French torturers and Algerian torture survivors side by side proved impossible—joining the Algerian FLN press in Tunis, serving as roving envoy to Nkrumah’s Accra across West Africa, and dictating *The Wretched of the Earth* in 1961 shortly before dying of leukemia at thirty-six.
after.zh: 少年时潜离维希政权控制下的马提尼克岛投身自由法国军队转战北非与欧洲后，弗朗茨·法农在里昂修习医学与精神病学，于1952年出版《黑皮肤，白面具》，剖析殖民种族主义对语言与心灵的撕裂。1953年赴法属阿尔及利亚主持卜利达精神病院病房改革，因无法忍受一边治疗受酷刑折磨的阿尔及利亚民众、一边医治施暴的殖民军警而于1956年愤然辞职，投身突尼斯的民族解放阵线（FLN）报刊，并任驻加纳阿克拉巡回大使联络西非反殖运动；1961年身患白血病弥留之际口述完成《全世界受苦的人》，年仅三十六岁辞世。

items.rationale: Cut "Classifying this entry with Africa..." and tell the Martinique->Lyon->Blida->Tunis->Accra life arc vividly!

before.en:
Pridi Banomyong helped lead the 1932 change from absolute monarchy and connected legal reform with education and public institutions. His role in founding Thammasat University in 1934 placed learning within the project of a new political order. Later participation in the Free Thai movement added wartime resistance to this institutional career.

His life also included political defeat and exile, so it should not be read as a continuous triumph of constitutional ideals. Biographical accounts produced by memorial institutions emphasize particular achievements; his own writings are primary evidence for arguments he made, not independent confirmation of every claim about his conduct. Reading those materials together connects the existing 1932 milestone to the people and institutions that worked through its unsettled consequences.
before.zh:
比里·帕侬荣参与领导1932年从绝对君主制向新秩序的转变，并将法律改革同教育及公共机构相连。1934年创办法政大学的角色，使学习进入新政治秩序的建设；后来参与自由泰运动，又为制度生涯增添战时抵抗。

其人生也包含政治挫败和流亡，不能读成宪政理想连续胜利的故事。纪念机构传记强调特定成就；本人的著作是其论证的第一手证据，却不能独立确认关于行为的每项断言。并读这些材料，可将已有1932年节点连接到处理其不稳定后果的人物与机构。

after.en: Returning to Bangkok with a Paris doctorate in law and political economy, Pridi Banomyong drafted the civilian manifesto for the *Khana Ratsadon* (People’s Party) revolution of June 1932 that ended Siam’s absolute monarchy, then founded the University of Moral and Political Sciences (Thammasat) in 1934 as an open-admission public university to educate citizens in constitutional law. During the Second World War, while serving as regent for the young monarch, he secretly directed the underground *Seri Thai* (Free Thai) resistance with Allied intelligence to preserve Thai sovereignty in 1945—before royalist and military coups forced him into decades of exile in China and France until his death near Paris in 1983.
after.zh: 获巴黎法学与政治经济学博士归国后，比里·帕侬荣起草“民党”政纲，参与领导1932年6月终结暹罗君主专制的立宪变革，并于1934年创办免试入学的法政大学（Thammasat），向普通民众普及宪政与法律教育。二战日军进驻期间，身为幼主摄政王的他秘密统率地下抗日组织“自由泰运动”配合盟军情报网，在1945年力保泰国免遭战败国占领处分；战后却因政变与王位疑案流亡中国与法国数十载，1983年客逝于巴黎近郊。

items.rationale: Remove "Reading those materials together connects..." and narrate 1932 Khana Ratsadon, 1934 Thammasat, Seri Thai, and exile in China/France.

before.en:
Songs attributed to Mirabai express devotion to Krishna through the language of intimate human relationships. Her remembered refusal to accept the expectations of a royal household became part of the meaning of this poetry. Bhakti expression could give listeners a vocabulary for belonging that did not depend entirely on courtly status or learned ritual authority.

Her biography reaches us through poetic, oral and later narrative traditions rather than a complete contemporary documentary record. Songs continued to circulate and change through performance and manuscript copying; not every poem bearing her name can be securely assigned to her. Reading this entry alongside women’s education and authorship elsewhere makes voice and transmission historical questions. Mirabai’s devotional language should not be treated as a literal travel diary or as proof that all women experienced equal freedom.
before.zh:
归于米拉拜的歌曲以亲密人际关系的语言表达对黑天的虔敬。人们记忆中她对王室家庭规范的抗拒，也构成诗歌意义的一部分。奉爱表达为听众提供归属的语言，不完全依赖宫廷地位或学识化的仪式权威。

其生平主要通过诗歌、口传与后世叙事留存，而非完整的同时代档案。歌曲在表演和抄写中继续流动变化，不能把署其名的每首诗都确定为她所作。与其他女性的教育和写作并读，可以把声音及传承当作历史问题；奉爱语言不应被当作逐日旅行记录，也不能证明所有女性拥有平等自由。

after.en: Born around the turn of the sixteenth century into a Rathore Rajput noble house at Merta and married into the Sisodia ruling court of Mewar at Chittorgarh, Mirabai spurned dynastic widowhood rules and caste seclusion to sing and dance openly among wandering *sant* ascetics in devotion to Krishna as her sole true spouse (*Giridhar Gopal*). Although almost no contemporary sixteenth-century court archive records her movements—and hundreds of vernacular *pad* lyrics later grew around her name across Rajasthani, Braj and Gujarati performance traditions—songs remembering poisoned cups sent by an angry brother-in-law and roads taken toward Vrindavan and Dwarka made her voice an enduring emblem of *bhakti* defiance.
after.zh: 约生于十六世纪初拉贾斯坦梅尔塔的拉ठો尔拉杰普特贵族之家、远嫁梅瓦尔王都奇托尔加尔王室的米拉拜，拒绝遵从王门礼法与种姓深闺禁锢，混迹云游苦行圣徒之间，高歌起舞奉黑天（克里希纳）为唯一夫君。尽管十六世纪宫廷档案几无其同时代文书留存，署其名号的数百首方言赞歌（pad）在拉贾斯坦语、布拉吉语与古吉拉特语传唱抄录中不断增益演变，但诗中无惧夫家毒酒迫害、毅然远走温达文与德瓦尔卡的身影，使她成为北印度虔诚派（bhakti）冲破门第藩篱的鲜活声音。

items.rationale: Remove "Reading this entry alongside..." and weave Merta, Chittorgarh, pad oral growth, and Vrindavan/Dwarka together directly.

before.en:
Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain learned Bengali and English at home while formal schooling was restricted for girls in her social setting. She became a writer and educationist whose work connected criticism of gendered exclusion with practical school organizing. Her literary imagination and her institutional work challenged the idea that women’s learning should remain confined within the household.

The 1905 publication of Sultana’s Dream and her school’s establishment after her husband’s death offer different kinds of evidence: one is a creative argument, the other an institution with teachers and pupils. Fiction should not be read as a literal plan of an existing society. Linking her to Ramabai and the Bengali-language entry shows that South Asian intellectual history includes women who addressed audiences across linguistic and religious settings, without assuming their projects or social positions were identical.
before.zh:
罗凯娅·萨哈瓦特·侯赛因在女孩正规教育受到限制的社会环境中，于家中学习孟加拉语和英语。她成为作家与教育者，把对性别排斥的批评同实际办学结合起来。文学想象与机构建设共同挑战女性学习应局限于家庭的观念。

1905年发表《苏丹娜之梦》与丈夫去世后创办学校，提供不同种类的证据：前者是创造性的论辩，后者是有师生参与的机构。小说不能当作既有社会的字面规划。与拉玛拜、孟加拉语条目相连，可显示南亚思想史中的女性如何跨语言和宗教环境发言，同时不假设她们的计划或社会位置完全相同。

after.en: Forbidden formal schooling by her conservative landlord father in Pairaband, Bengal—who feared educated girls would defy strict *purdah* seclusion—Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain studied Bengali and English late at night by candle stub with her elder brother Ibrahim Saber and later received encouragement from her civil-servant husband in Bhagalpur. In 1905 she published the witty English feminist utopia *Sultana’s Dream*, picturing “Ladyland” run peacefully on solar power and rain-harvesting while men stayed indoors; after bereavement in 1909 she moved to Calcutta in 1911 to build the Sakhawat Memorial Girls’ School door-to-door with covered horse carriages, founding the Bengali Muslim women’s association *Anjuman-e-Khawatin-e-Islam* in 1916 and campaigning until the night before her death in 1932.
after.zh: 在孟加拉パイ拉班德地主家庭因严守深闺礼法（普尔达）被父亲禁止入学的罗凯娅·萨哈瓦特·侯赛因，每夜待家人熟睡后借残烛微光随兄长偷学孟加拉文与英文，婚后又获开明丈夫支持发表政论。1905年她写出幽默辛辣的英文女性乌托邦小说《苏丹娜之梦》，畅想利用太阳能与云水科技、把男子关在内室而国泰民安的“女儿国”；1909年丧夫后，她于1911年在加尔各答用遮帷马车挨家接送女生创办萨哈瓦特纪念女校，并于1916年组建孟加拉穆斯林妇女协会，执笔办学直至1932年辞世前夜。

items.rationale: Replace "Linking her to Ramabai..." with candlelit study, solar-powered Ladyland, covered school carriages in Calcutta and Anjuman.

before.en:
Abai Kunanbaiuly wrote poetry, prose reflection and translations in a society shaped by Kazakh oral traditions and Russian imperial institutions. His learning involved several literary worlds rather than a choice between one local and one foreign culture. Writing and song offered ways to discuss conduct, education, inequality and the conditions of everyday life.

Modern commemorations make Abai a national cultural figure, but that later role should be distinguished from the circumstances in which he worked. A state biography foregrounds achievement and contains details that require comparison with other scholarship; this entry omits inconsistent family claims rather than repeating them. Linking his work with the history of Russian expansion keeps literary production within a changing political setting. It does not reduce his poetry to a direct statement of state policy or a prophecy of later independence.
before.zh:
阿拜·库南拜乌勒在哈萨克口传传统与俄国帝国制度共同塑造的社会中写作诗歌、散文思考和译作。学习涉及多个文学世界，并非在单一地方文化和单一外国文化之间作选择。写作与歌曲成为讨论行为、教育、不平等及日常生活条件的方式。

现代纪念把阿拜塑为民族文化人物，但这种后来的地位应同其工作环境区分。国家传记突出成就，部分细节仍需比较其他研究；本条略去不一致的家庭说法，而不重复它们。与俄国扩张史相连，可把文学置于变化的政治背景，不把诗歌缩成国家政策的直接表达或后来独立的预言。

after.en: Growing up in the Chingiztau foothills near Semipalatinsk where nomadic clan custom (*adat*) met Tsarist frontier administration and Tatar-staffed madrasas, Abai (Ibrahim) Kunanbaiuly mastered Chagatai, Persian and Arabic classics alongside Russian writers from Pushkin and Lermontov to Krylov, whom he met through exiled Russian Narodnik intellectuals in Semipalatinsk’s library.
